<a id="055"></a>
#### 055 · Research Lab / Group (`lab-group`)
**For:** university labs, research groups and small independent institutes.
**Templates:** front-page · page-people (by role + alumni) · archive-publication · archive-project · single-project · archive-news · page-join (openings) · page-resources (code, datasets, protocols) · page-presentations · page-contact (lab location)
**Patterns (~45):** lab mission paragraph, people grouped by role (PI / postdocs / graduate students / staff / honorary), alumni table (name / role and years / where they went), join us page with open positions and how to apply, publications list, projects with funding line, resources (GitHub repos, datasets, protocols), presentations and talks, news with dates, lab location and visiting directions, funders line.
**Content model:** companion `person` (role, start, end, next_position, photo, links), `publication`, `project` (funders, members), `resource` (type: code / dataset / protocol).
**Plugins:** Query Filter (publications by year and topic), Advanced Query Loop (current vs alumni by end date).
**Signature:** a people page that automatically moves members to an Alumni table once their end date passes, showing role, years and "where they went" (seen on: [Kording Lab: People](https://kordinglab.com/people/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Join us" page with current openings and what to include in an email (seen on: [Kording Lab: Join](https://kordinglab.com/join/))
- Resources page for code, datasets and protocols (seen on: [Kording Lab](https://kordinglab.com/resources))
- Pronouns and preferred contact on each person card
- Funders acknowledgement line with grant numbers on project pages
- "How to find the lab" block: building, floor, room, accessible entrance
**Real-world basis:** [Kording Lab: People](https://kordinglab.com/people/), [Kording Lab: Join us](https://kordinglab.com/join/), [Gershman Lab: People](https://gershmanlab.com/people.html), [Gershman Lab: Publications](https://gershmanlab.com/pubs.html), [al-folio: People](https://alshedivat.github.io/al-folio/people/)
**Style: Swiss lab-report grid**
- Type: Headings: Albert Sans 800; body: Albert Sans 400/18px; figure captions and metadata: IBM Plex Mono 400; figure numbers set as "Fig. 3"
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #101418 / accent #0F7B6C (lab-coat teal) / surface #EEF3F2 / line #101418
- Layout: 12-col grid with captions hanging in a 3-col margin; people as a dense 6-col portrait grid with name and role under each; alumni as a table; home page = one research figure full-bleed → projects → news list
- Imagery: real figures and microscopy/plots from the lab at native ratios with numbered captions; portraits in consistent square crops on one backdrop
- Motion: none except link underlines and focus; figure opens in core lightbox
- Why it fits now: labs are dropping university CMS templates for fast, self-run, figure-led sites; see [Kording Lab](https://kordinglab.com/people/)
**Style variations:** Lab Notebook: squared-paper surface, pen-blue headings · Poster Session: bold condensed type, big figures · Clean Room: white, hairlines, mono labels
**Refs:**
- [Kording Lab: People](https://kordinglab.com/people/): role groups plus an alumni table with "where they went", the exact signature
- [Kording Lab: Join us](https://kordinglab.com/join/): honest application guidance that saves the PI's inbox
- [Gershman Lab: People](https://gershmanlab.com/people.html): compact people page for a mid-sized lab

<a id="056"></a>
#### 056 · Digital Garden (`garden`)
**For:** IndieWeb people, researchers, designers and note-takers who "learn in public".
**Templates:** front-page (garden index) · archive-note · single-note · taxonomy-topic · taxonomy-type (essays / notes / patterns / talks) · page-now · page-about · page-garden-ethos
**Patterns (~30):** garden index filterable by type and topic, growth stage label (Seedling / Budding / Evergreen) with a legend, "Planted" and "Last tended" dates, backlinks list at the end of each note, hover previews for internal links, topic index (wiki-style nested list), "now" page with a date, "mentions around the web" (webmentions), small "what is a digital garden" explainer, RSS per type.
**Content model:** companion `note` (stage, planted, tended, type) + taxonomy `topic`; backlinks computed by the companion plugin on save.
**Plugins:** companion plugin (backlinks, wikilink parsing); optional Webmention plugin.
**Signature:** notes that show their growth stage, planted and last-tended dates, and an automatic backlinks list, with hover previews on internal links (seen on: [Maggie Appleton: garden history](https://maggieappleton.com/garden-history), [Gwern.net: About](https://gwern.net/about)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Stage legend page explaining Seedling / Budding / Evergreen (seen on: [Maggie Appleton: garden history](https://maggieappleton.com/garden-history))
- Filters by type and topic on the index (seen on: [Maggie Appleton: Garden](https://maggieappleton.com/garden))
- Wiki-style nested topic index for browsing without search (seen on: [Tom Critchlow: Wiki](https://tomcritchlow.com/wiki/))
- "Now" page with a visible "updated" date
- Full-text RSS for new and freshly tended notes
**Real-world basis:** [Maggie Appleton: Garden](https://maggieappleton.com/garden), [Maggie Appleton: garden history](https://maggieappleton.com/garden-history), [Andy Matuschak: Evergreen notes](https://notes.andymatuschak.org/z5E5QawiXCMbtNtupvxeoEX), [Tom Critchlow: Wiki](https://tomcritchlow.com/wiki/), [Gwern.net: About](https://gwern.net/about)
**Style: Hypertext revival**
- Type: Headings: Crimson Pro 600; body: Crimson Pro 400/20px, 64ch; metadata and stage labels: Courier Prime 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #111111 / links #C1270A (visible underline, hypertext red) / visited #7A2410 / surface #F3F1EE / line #BDB9B3
- Layout: reading column with a right-hand margin for sidenotes and backlinks on wide screens (Tufte-style); index as a dense list, not cards; underlines on every link; topic tree as nested lists
- Imagery: diagrams and sketches in the author's own hand; screenshots with 1px rules
- Motion: hover preview popovers open after 300ms with a 120ms fade; no scroll effects; previews disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (links still work)
- Why it fits now: dense, link-rich personal sites are back as a response to feeds and AI summaries; see [Gwern.net](https://gwern.net/about)
**Style variations:** Zettel: index-card surface, mono headings · Terminal: black on paper-white, all mono · Botanical: sage green links, serif
**Refs:**
- [Maggie Appleton: garden history](https://maggieappleton.com/garden-history): stage labels, planted/tended dates and a backlinks section on one note
- [Gwern.net: About](https://gwern.net/about): sidenotes and hover popups on links, the gold standard for previews
- [Tom Critchlow: Wiki](https://tomcritchlow.com/wiki/): simple nested topic wiki, a realistic garden for one person

<a id="057"></a>
#### 057 · Open-Source Project Home + Docs (`repo`)
**For:** small open-source projects and libraries that want a proper home and docs beyond a README.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-doc · single-doc (sidebar, on-this-page, prev/next) · archive-release (changelog) · page-community · page-sponsors · page-built-with (sites using it) · archive-blog
**Patterns (~40):** install command with copy button, one short code example on the home page, docs sidebar grouped by section (Introduction / Guide / Plugins / Reference), breadcrumb, "On this page" contents, version selector, code blocks with copy buttons, "Edit this page" on GitHub, "Other pages in this section" / prev-next links, changelog entries (version / date / breaking changes), sponsors list, "Built with" list of sites, community links (Discord, discussions), credits page.
**Content model:** hierarchical `doc` CPT (menu order = sidebar), `release` (version, date, breaking flag, notes), taxonomy `doc_version`.
**Plugins:** Code Block Pro.
**Signature:** docs pages with a hierarchy-generated sidebar, breadcrumb, "On this page" contents, version selector and an "Edit this page" link to the source file on GitHub (seen on: [Eleventy: Configuration](https://www.11ty.dev/docs/config/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Version selector that keeps you on the same page across versions (seen on: [Eleventy docs](https://www.11ty.dev/docs/config/))
- "Built with" page listing real sites that use the project (seen on: [Pico CSS: Built with](https://picocss.com/docs/built-with))
- Single-page docs option for Ctrl-F readers (seen on: [htmx: Documentation](https://htmx.org/docs/))
- Credits / contributors page (seen on: [Eleventy: Credits](https://www.11ty.dev/docs/credits/))
- Latest release number and date pulled into the header from the `release` CPT
**Real-world basis:** [Eleventy: Configuration](https://www.11ty.dev/docs/config/), [htmx: Documentation](https://htmx.org/docs/), [Pico CSS: Forms](https://picocss.com/docs/forms), [SQLite: Documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/docs.html)
**Style: Man-page monospace**
- Type: Headings: Red Hat Mono 700; body: Red Hat Text 400/18px; code: Red Hat Mono 400 (one superfamily, mono as the display voice)
- Palette: bg #FDFDFB / text #1A1A1A / accent #B35900 (amber, from old terminal phosphor) / surface #F1F0EC / line #1A1A1A / code bg #F1F0EC
- Layout: three columns (sidebar 240px / content 70ch / on-this-page 200px), collapsing to a drawer on mobile; section headings styled like man-page sections (NAME, SYNOPSIS) only in the reference docs; ASCII-style box diagrams for architecture; square corners throughout
- Imagery: almost none; terminal output as text, not screenshots
- Motion: none; copy buttons confirm with the word "Copied"
- Why it fits now: developers trust docs that look like tools, not landing pages; plain, fast doc sites are back; see [htmx](https://htmx.org/docs/)
**Style variations:** Dark Terminal: #111 bg, amber text · Paper Docs: serif body, mono headings · RFC: plain text, fixed width
**Refs:**
- [Eleventy: Configuration](https://www.11ty.dev/docs/config/): sidebar, breadcrumb, on-this-page, version selector and "Edit this page", all in one
- [htmx: Documentation](https://htmx.org/docs/): a single long docs page with personality and no framework chrome
- [Pico CSS: Forms](https://picocss.com/docs/forms): tidy component docs with live examples beside code

<a id="058"></a>
#### 058 · Recipe Site / Cookbook Author (`pantry`)
**For:** home cooks, cookbook authors and food writers who want recipes without pop-ups and life stories.
**Templates:** front-page · single-recipe · archive-recipe (browse by course / diet / ingredient / season) · taxonomy-diet · page-cookbooks · page-about · page-conversions (weights and temperatures)
**Patterns (~40):** "Jump to recipe" link at the top, recipe card (yield, active and total time, ingredients, method, notes), servings adjuster, US / metric toggle with weights in grams, print recipe link, recipe index by course, cuisine, diet (vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free), ingredient and fruit, headnote kept short, storage and make-ahead notes, substitutions, cookbook promo with Bookshop.org link, reader comments with "I made it" notes.
**Content model:** companion `recipe` (yield, times, ingredients structured, steps, diet, course, cuisine, season) with schema.org Recipe; or WP Recipe Maker.
**Plugins:** WP Recipe Maker (free) or the companion recipe block; Query Filter (course, diet).
**Signature:** a recipe card with an adjustable servings count, a US / metric switch and weights in grams, plus a print view, reached via a "Jump to recipe" link (seen on: [Minimalist Baker: GF flour blend](https://minimalistbaker.com/best-gluten-free-flour-blend/), [Smitten Kitchen: Ultimate banana bread](https://smittenkitchen.com/2020/03/ultimate-banana-bread/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Weights in grams next to cups, for bakers (seen on: [Smitten Kitchen](https://smittenkitchen.com/2020/03/ultimate-banana-bread/))
- Pan-size note and storage guidance inside the card (seen on: [Smitten Kitchen](https://smittenkitchen.com/2020/03/ultimate-banana-bread/))
- Recipe index by diet, course and ingredient (seen on: [Smitten Kitchen: Recipes](https://smittenkitchen.com/recipes/))
- Cook mode that keeps the screen awake (Screen Wake Lock API) and enlarges the steps
- Printable card with no images, ads or comments
**Real-world basis:** [Smitten Kitchen: Recipes index](https://smittenkitchen.com/recipes/), [Smitten Kitchen: Ultimate banana bread](https://smittenkitchen.com/2020/03/ultimate-banana-bread/), [Minimalist Baker: Apple butter cheesecake bars](https://minimalistbaker.com/apple-butter-cheesecake-bars-vegan-gf/), [Minimalist Baker: GF flour blend](https://minimalistbaker.com/best-gluten-free-flour-blend/)
**Style: Index-card kitchen editorial**
- Type: Headings: Arvo 700; body: Alegreya 400/19px; quantities and times: Courier Prime 700 (typewritten measurements)
- Palette: bg #EDF1F2 (kitchen-tile grey-blue) / text #1C1B19 / accent #C8341F (tomato) / surface #FFFFFF (the recipe card) / line #9FB3B8 (ruled-card blue)
- Layout: recipe card as a white panel with ruled blue lines behind the ingredient list; ingredients in a 4-col sticky column beside an 8-col method on desktop; archive as a text index grouped by course with one photo per group
- Imagery: overhead and 45° shots in daylight, 4:5 for recipes, 3:2 for steps; no props clutter
- Motion: step checkboxes strike through when ticked; the servings number changes without layout shift; static under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: readers reward cooks whose sites get to the recipe fast and read like a cookbook, not an ad feed; see [Smitten Kitchen](https://smittenkitchen.com/)
**Style variations:** Diner: white, red check rules · Test Kitchen: grey, mono headings · Larder: olive green, serif labels
**Refs:**
- [Smitten Kitchen: Ultimate banana bread](https://smittenkitchen.com/2020/03/ultimate-banana-bread/): WordPress recipe with jump link, gram weights, pan note and print
- [Minimalist Baker: GF flour blend](https://minimalistbaker.com/best-gluten-free-flour-blend/): WordPress recipe card with adjustable servings and a metric toggle
- [Smitten Kitchen: Recipes index](https://smittenkitchen.com/recipes/): dense, useful recipe index by course, diet and ingredient

### VIII. Independent commerce

<a id="059"></a>
#### 059 · Specialty Coffee Roaster (`roast`)
**For:** small-batch specialty roasters with a web shop, subscriptions and a few wholesale cafés.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (coffee) · single-product (coffee) · archive-product (equipment) · page-subscriptions · page-brew-guides · single-brew-guide · page-wholesale · page-cafes (locations)
**Patterns (~45):** coffee card (producer, region, variety, process, elevation, tasting notes), roast-day line ("Roasted Tuesdays, shipped Wednesdays"), bag sizes with per-size sold-out state, producer story with the washing station and its farmers, process notes in plain steps, subscription builder (coffee type × frequency: weekly / fortnightly / monthly / custom days), "fits through your letterbox" bag note, pause / skip / add a one-off explainer, brew guide per brewer (dose, water, temperature, grind, timed pour schedule), equipment shop (filters, baskets, water), gift card, wholesale enquiry, café locations and hours.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (origin, region, producer, variety, process, elevation, tasting notes); companion `brew_guide` (brewer, dose, water, temp, grind, steps with timestamps); `producer` (story, photos, coffees).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Subscriptions for WooCommerce (free), Product Filters (process, origin, tasting note), Jetpack Forms (wholesale).
**Signature:** brew guides per brewer that give dose, water temperature, grind and a timed pour schedule (0:00 bloom, 0:45 pour to 150g …), linked from each coffee (seen on: [Onyx Coffee Lab: Brew guides](https://onyxcoffeelab.com/pages/brew-guides)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Roast and dispatch days printed on every coffee (seen on: [Sey: Demeka Becha](https://www.seycoffee.com/collections/coffee/products/2026-demeka-becha-ethiopia))
- Subscription self-service note: change frequency, skip, pause, add a one-off (seen on: [Square Mile: Subscriptions](https://shop.squaremilecoffee.com/pages/coffee-subscriptions))
- "350g bag fits through a UK letterbox" packaging note (seen on: [Square Mile: Subscriptions](https://shop.squaremilecoffee.com/pages/coffee-subscriptions))
- Christmas last-roast and last-dispatch dates banner that switches itself off
- Wholesale price list PDF for cafés, updated per season
**Real-world basis:** [Onyx Coffee Lab: Brew guides](https://onyxcoffeelab.com/pages/brew-guides), [Sey: Coffee](https://www.seycoffee.com/collections/coffee), [Sey: Demeka Becha](https://www.seycoffee.com/collections/coffee/products/2026-demeka-becha-ethiopia), [Square Mile: Subscriptions](https://shop.squaremilecoffee.com/pages/coffee-subscriptions), [Colonna: Filter brewing](https://colonnacoffee.com/collections/accessories-filter-brewing)
**Style: Kraft-label utility**
- Type: Headings: Krona One 400 (wide, like a stamped bag label); body: Karla 400/18px; origin data and brew numbers: Azeret Mono 500, tabular
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1E1A16 / accent #1F6F4A (stamp green) / surface #D8C3A0 (kraft bag) / line #1E1A16
- Layout: each coffee page set out like a bag label: a boxed data table (origin / process / elevation / variety) in 1px black rules, tasting notes large beneath; shop grid 3 across with no cards, just photo, name, notes, price; brew guide steps as a numbered timeline because they are a real sequence
- Imagery: bags photographed flat on kraft at 4:5; farm and washing-station photos credited to the importer; no latte-art stock
- Motion: brew timer counts up in the step list (Interactivity API); nothing on scroll; the timer shows a static list under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: specialty roasters are trading moody hero videos for dense, data-first product pages; see [Sey](https://www.seycoffee.com/collections/coffee)
**Style variations:** Lab: white, mono everywhere, green data · Espresso Bar: dark roast brown, cream type · Seasonal: label colour changes per harvest
**Refs:**
- [Onyx Coffee Lab: Brew guides](https://onyxcoffeelab.com/pages/brew-guides): brewer-by-brewer recipes with dose, temperature, grind microns and timed pours
- [Sey: Demeka Becha](https://www.seycoffee.com/collections/coffee/products/2026-demeka-becha-ethiopia): producer-first product page with process steps, elevation and roast/ship days
- [Square Mile: Subscriptions](https://shop.squaremilecoffee.com/pages/coffee-subscriptions): clear subscription options, custom day intervals and letterbox-size bags

#### 060 · Independent Bookshop (`shelf`)
**For:** independent bookshops selling online alongside a physical shop, events and reading subscriptions.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · single-product · page-staff-picks (adult / kids & YA) · page-subscriptions · single-subscription · archive-event · single-event · page-signed-books · page-visit · page-sell-us-your-books (if second-hand)
**Patterns (~45):** staff picks with a first-person bookseller note and "read more", monthly bookseller's choice with archive, reading subscription explainer (questionnaire → hand-picked book each month), subscription lengths (3 / 6 / 11 months) and format (paperback / hardback), themed subscriptions (whodunit, children's, bedtime stories), signed first-editions club, gift voucher with "recipient fills in the questionnaire later", events list with author, date and ticket, signed books shelf, visit info and opening hours, "sell us your books" page.
**Content model:** Woo products (ISBN, format, signed flag); companion `pick` (bookseller, note, product relation, month); `event` (author, date, ticket product).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Subscriptions for WooCommerce, Advanced Query Loop (upcoming events, this month's picks), Jetpack Forms (subscription questionnaire).
**Signature:** a reading subscription driven by a questionnaire: the customer (or gift recipient) describes their reading, a named bookseller picks one book a month, with teaser clues to avoid duplicates (seen on: [Mr B's Emporium: Reading subscriptions](https://mrbsemporium.com/gifts/reading-subscriptions/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Staff picks updated monthly with an archive of past months (seen on: [Parnassus Books: Staff picks](https://parnassusbooks.net/staffpicksadult))
- Gift subscription where the giver only enters name and country (seen on: [Mr B's Emporium](https://mrbsemporium.com/gifts/reading-subscriptions/))
- Signed first-edition clubs by age band (seen on: [Parnassus Books: Subscriptions](https://parnassusbooks.net/subscriptions))
- "We ship to 60+ countries" line with a shipping-times table (seen on: [Mr B's Emporium](https://mrbsemporium.com/gifts/reading-subscriptions/))
- "Order by 18 Dec for Christmas" cut-off and in-shop gift-wrapping note
**Real-world basis:** [Mr B's Emporium: Reading subscriptions](https://mrbsemporium.com/gifts/reading-subscriptions/), [Mr B's Emporium: Events](https://mrbsemporium.com/events/), [Heywood Hill: Subscriptions](https://www.heywoodhill.com/subscriptions), [Parnassus Books: Staff picks](https://parnassusbooks.net/staffpicksadult), [Parnassus Books: Subscriptions](https://parnassusbooks.net/subscriptions)
**Style: Bookplate serif**
- Type: Headings: Almendra 700; body: Libre Baskerville 400/18px; shelf-talker notes: Nanum Pen Script 400 at 24px, only inside pick cards
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1A1714 / accent #7A1E2C (bookcloth maroon) / surface #FFF3B0 (shelf-talker card) / line #1A1714
- Layout: home page = this month's picks as shelf-talker cards (yellow card, handwritten note, cover) in an uneven row → events list → subscription explainer; shop in a 5-col cover grid with spines-out typographic list as an alternative view; thin double rules like bookplates
- Imagery: flat cover scans at 2:3; shop interior once, wide; booksellers photographed at the shelves
- Motion: none beyond link underlines; View Transition from pick to product
- Why it fits now: bookshops are leaning on personality and human curation against algorithmic retail; see [Heywood Hill](https://www.heywoodhill.com/)
**Style variations:** Stacks: white, black serif, maroon rules · Basement: dark green, cream type · Children's: bright yellow, rounded headings
**Refs:**
- [Mr B's Emporium: Reading subscriptions](https://mrbsemporium.com/gifts/reading-subscriptions/): WordPress indie bookshop; questionnaire-led subscriptions with gift flow
- [Parnassus Books: Staff picks](https://parnassusbooks.net/staffpicksadult): bookseller-written notes attached to buyable products, refreshed monthly
- [Heywood Hill: Subscriptions](https://www.heywoodhill.com/subscriptions): themed subscription products (Whodunit, Bedtime Stories) from a small London shop

#### 061 · Record Shop (`crate`)
**For:** independent record shops selling new and second-hand vinyl, CDs and cassettes online and in store.
**Templates:** front-page (latest arrivals) · Woo shop · archive-genre (new / used split) · single-product · page-latest-arrivals · page-sell-to-us · page-stores · page-events · page-shipping · page-returns
**Patterns (~40):** latest 100 arrivals list, genre crates split by format and condition (Classic Rock: new LP / used LP / used 7" / used CD), used-record product with media/sleeve grade pair (VG/VG+), pressing details (label, cat no, country, year, reissue), grading notes ("single sleeve, Bilbo run-out"), photos of the actual copy (front, back, label), audio clips on new releases, staff description, sell-to-us page (what we buy, bring it in, collection visits for large lots, ID required), store addresses and hours, events, shipping and returns.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (format, condition_media, condition_sleeve, label, cat_no, country, year, genre); products sold individually with stock 1 for used.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (genre, format, condition), Jetpack Forms (sell-to-us).
**Signature:** used records listed with a media/sleeve grade pair, grading notes, full pressing details and photos of the exact copy, browsed through genre crates split into new and used formats (seen on: [Flashback: Aladdin Sane](https://flashback.co.uk/products/david-bowie-aladdin-sane-1212129), [Flashback: Classic rock used LP](https://flashback.co.uk/collections/classic-rock-used-lp)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Grading guide page (M / NM / VG+ / VG / G) linked from every grade
- Sell-to-us page with "bring it in" hours, collection visits and "photo ID required" (seen on: [Flashback: Sell to us](https://flashback.co.uk/pages/sell-to-us))
- Latest arrivals list as the home page (seen on: [Honest Jon's: Latest 100 arrivals](https://www.honestjons.com/shop/Latest_100_arrivals))
- Audio clips on new-release pages (seen on: [Honest Jon's: Triptych](https://www.honestjons.com/shop/artist/Eliane_Radigue/release/Triptych))
- Record Store Day notice with shop rules, switched on for the date only
**Real-world basis:** [Flashback: Aladdin Sane](https://flashback.co.uk/products/david-bowie-aladdin-sane-1212129), [Flashback: Sell to us](https://flashback.co.uk/pages/sell-to-us), [Honest Jon's: Latest 100 arrivals](https://www.honestjons.com/shop/Latest_100_arrivals), [Honest Jon's: Triptych](https://www.honestjons.com/shop/artist/Eliane_Radigue/release/Triptych), [Reckless Records: Sell to us](https://reckless.com/wordpress/sell-to-us/)
**Style: Crate-dig catalogue**
- Type: Headings: Urbanist 900; body: Urbanist 400/18px; cat numbers, grades and prices: Spline Sans Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #111111 / accent #D90429 (price-gun red) / surface #FFD60A (sticker yellow, used for grade stickers only) / line #111111
- Layout: arrivals as a dense text list (artist / title / label / cat no / format / grade / price) with a small cover; genre crates as a tall index of dividers down the left; product page with copy photos at left and a ruled spec table at right; square corners
- Imagery: the actual copies photographed flat, square 1:1, including labels and run-out; no mock-up sleeves
- Motion: clips play inline; divider index highlights the current crate; static under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: serious record shops sell with lists and data, not banners; see [Honest Jon's](https://www.honestjons.com/)
**Style variations:** Import: white, Japanese obi-strip red band · Soul: warm brown, yellow stickers · Dub: black ink on grey, green grade marks
**Refs:**
- [Flashback: Aladdin Sane](https://flashback.co.uk/products/david-bowie-aladdin-sane-1212129): the used-record product page done right: grade pair, pressing data, copy photos
- [Honest Jon's: Latest 100 arrivals](https://www.honestjons.com/shop/Latest_100_arrivals): a list-first arrivals page loved by diggers
- [Reckless Records: Sell to us](https://reckless.com/wordpress/sell-to-us/): WordPress sell-to-us page from a long-running second-hand shop

<a id="062"></a>
#### 062 · Vintage & Second-Hand Clothing (`thrift`)
**For:** vintage shops and one-person resellers of one-off second-hand clothing.
**Templates:** front-page (new in) · Woo shop · archive-decade (40s … 00s, Y2K) · archive-brand · single-product · page-size-guide · page-stores · page-sell-to-us · page-shipping-returns
**Patterns (~40):** new-in grid, shop by decade (40s / 50s / 60s / 70s / 80s / 90s / 00s / Y2K) for women's and men's, shop by brand (Carhartt, Levi's, Barbour…), one-off product with label size in the title and real measurements in the description, measuring guide ("laid flat, pit to pit × 2"), condition and flaw notes with close-up photos, "only 1 left" / sold state, deadstock label, gift cards, store locations, sell-to-us or buying days.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (decade, brand, label_size, chest, length, shoulder, sleeve, waist, condition, flaws); stock 1, sold individually.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (decade, brand, size, category).
**Signature:** shop-by-decade collections for women's and men's plus a measuring guide that explains label size versus flat-laid measurements (seen on: [Rokit: Women's 70s](https://www.rokit.co.uk/collections/womens-vintage-clothing-70s), [Rokit: Size guide](https://www.rokit.co.uk/pages/size-guide-care)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Measurement block on every product (chest, shoulder, nape to hem, shoulder to cuff) (seen on: [The Vintage Showroom: Tour of duty jacket](https://thevintageshowroom.com/product/1950s-tour-of-duty-jacket/))
- "Compare with a garment you own" tip next to measurements (seen on: [Rokit: Size guide](https://www.rokit.co.uk/pages/size-guide-care))
- Flaw close-ups as the last gallery images, with a one-line flaw summary
- Sold items stay visible with a SOLD label, for provenance and search
- Gift cards for one-off stock (seen on: [Rokit](https://www.rokit.co.uk/products/gift-card))
**Real-world basis:** [Rokit: Women's 70s](https://www.rokit.co.uk/collections/womens-vintage-clothing-70s), [Rokit: Y2K](https://www.rokit.co.uk/collections/vintage-y2k-clothing), [Rokit: Size guide](https://www.rokit.co.uk/pages/size-guide-care), [The Vintage Showroom: Online store](https://thevintageshowroom.com/online-store/all/), [The Vintage Showroom: Tour of duty jacket](https://thevintageshowroom.com/product/1950s-tour-of-duty-jacket/)
**Style: Workwear catalogue**
- Type: Headings: Barlow Condensed 700; body: Barlow 400/18px; measurements and decade tags: Overpass Mono 500
- Palette: bg #F4F4F1 (canvas grey) / text #1D1F1C / accent #B5471B (swing-tag red) / surface #FFFFFF / line #1D1F1C
- Layout: product pages like an old workwear catalogue: garment photo large at left, a ruled measurement table at right, decade and brand as plain text labels; shop grid 4 across; decade index as a horizontal row of big condensed numerals (40s … Y2K)
- Imagery: garments shot flat or on a hanger against one grey wall, 4:5; detail shots of labels, stitching and wear
- Motion: none; hover on a product shows the second (back) image, which is a real view change, no zoom
- Why it fits now: the best vintage sellers present garments like archive pieces with dates and measurements; see [The Vintage Showroom](https://thevintageshowroom.com/online-store/all/)
**Style variations:** Y2K: silver-grey bg, pink tags · 70s: brown and mustard, rounded headings · Military: olive bg, stencil numbers
**Refs:**
- [Rokit: Size guide](https://www.rokit.co.uk/pages/size-guide-care): the plain explanation of flat-laid measurements every vintage shop needs
- [Rokit: Women's 70s](https://www.rokit.co.uk/collections/womens-vintage-clothing-70s): decade collections as the primary navigation
- [The Vintage Showroom: Tour of duty jacket](https://thevintageshowroom.com/product/1950s-tour-of-duty-jacket/): WooCommerce vintage product with dated title and four measurements

<a id="063"></a>
#### 063 · Plant Shop / Nursery (`leaf`)
**For:** independent plant shops and small nurseries delivering houseplants locally or nationally.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-product (by room / by light / pet-safe) · single-product (care summary) · page-care-library · single-care-guide · page-plant-care-services · page-gifts · page-delivery · page-workshops
**Patterns (~45):** filters by light (shade / light and shade / direct sun), care level ("almost un-killable" / easy / needs some love), pet and child safe, size bands in cm, room (bathroom, bedroom, kitchen…), product card badges (pet safe, flowering, rare, peat free), care summary on each product (light / water / humidity / pet safety), A–Z care library, low-light and pet-friendly collections, plant care services (repotting, plant doctor), gifting add-ons and gift message, delivery info, 30-day guarantee, workshops.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (light, care_level, pet_safe, size_band, room, height_cm, pot_size); companion `care_guide` (plant, light, water, humidity, toxicity) linked to products.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters, Jetpack Forms (plant doctor).
**Signature:** plant filters built on real-life questions: how much light, how much care ("almost un-killable"), pet and child safe, and which room, with size bands in centimetres (seen on: [Patch: Indoor plants](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plants-indoor-all/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- A–Z care library matched to the plant name on the packing slip (seen on: [The Sill: Care library](https://www.thesill.com/pages/care-library))
- "30-day happiness guarantee" and "ships in 1–2 days" lines on collections (seen on: [The Sill: Pet-friendly](https://www.thesill.com/collections/pet-friendly-plants))
- Plant care services: repotting and plant doctor (seen on: [Patch: Plant care services](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plant-care-services/))
- Cold-weather shipping pause notice for winter months
- Height shown against a hand or a chair in product photos
**Real-world basis:** [Patch: Indoor plants](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plants-indoor-all/), [Patch: Bathroom plants](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plants-indoor-bathroom/), [The Sill: Pet-friendly](https://www.thesill.com/collections/pet-friendly-plants), [The Sill: Care library](https://www.thesill.com/pages/care-library), [Leaf Envy: Low light](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/low-light)
**Style: Herbarium specimen label**
- Type: Headings: Spectral 500; body: Figtree 400/18px; Latin names in Spectral italic; care data: IBM Plex Mono 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF (herbarium sheet) / text #1F2A1F / accent #2F6B2F (leaf green) / surface #EEF2E8 / line #B9C4B0
- Layout: product page composed like a herbarium sheet: plant photo on a big white field, specimen label box bottom-right with Latin name, family, light, water, pet safety; shop grid 3 across with generous white; filters as a left column of plain checkboxes
- Imagery: plants shot against white at 4:5, whole plant and pot visible; care guides with leaf close-ups
- Motion: none; filter results update without layout shift
- Why it fits now: plant retail is moving from jungle-overload imagery to calm, specimen-like product pages with useful data; see [Patch](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plants-indoor-all/)
**Style variations:** Greenhouse: pale glass green, white type panels · Jungle: deep green bg, cream labels · Nursery: kraft surface, black stencil sizes
**Refs:**
- [Patch: Indoor plants](https://www.patchplants.com/collections/plants-indoor-all/): the most useful plant filters in the UK: light, care level, pet safe, room, size in cm
- [The Sill: Care library](https://www.thesill.com/pages/care-library): A–Z care guides as after-sale support
- [Leaf Envy: Low light](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/low-light): a small independent's version of problem-led collections ("plants for dark rooms")

#### 064 · Small-Batch Skincare & Soap (`lather`)
**For:** small skincare, soap and balm makers who formulate and make in-house.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-product (by skin type) · single-product (full ingredients) · page-ingredients (A–Z) · page-ingredients-we-avoid · page-allergy-friendly · page-refills · page-wholesale
**Patterns (~40):** shop by skin type (dry, sensitive, blemish-prone, dehydrated), product page with full INCI list, key ingredients with what they do, A–Z ingredient library with each entry linking to products, "ingredients we avoid" list, allergy-friendly guidance (nut-free, fragrance-free), certifications (organic, vegan) with certificate numbers, refill duos and refill scheme, bundles and sets, how to use, batch/made-on date, wholesale enquiry.
**Content model:** Woo products + companion `ingredient` (INCI, common name, origin, function, allergens) with a many-to-many relation to products; attributes (skin_type, fragrance_free, vegan).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (skin type, concern).
**Signature:** an A–Z ingredient library where each ingredient explains origin and function and links to every product that contains it (seen on: [Evolve Beauty: Ingredients library](https://www.evolvebeauty.com/en-eu/pages/skincare-ingredients-library)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Ingredients we avoid" page as a trust statement (seen on: [Odylique: Ingredients](https://odylique.co.uk/ingredients/))
- Allergy-friendly guidance page for sensitive customers (seen on: [Odylique: Allergy-friendly ingredients](https://odylique.co.uk/allergy-friendly-ingredients/))
- Refill duos priced below two full-size bottles (seen on: [Evolve Beauty: Refill duos](https://www.evolvebeauty.com/en-eu/collections/refill-duos))
- Made-on and best-before date on each batch, shown on the product page
- Printable INCI label sheet for stockists
**Real-world basis:** [Evolve Beauty: Ingredients library](https://www.evolvebeauty.com/en-eu/pages/skincare-ingredients-library), [Evolve Beauty: Refill duos](https://www.evolvebeauty.com/en-eu/collections/refill-duos), [Odylique: Ingredients](https://odylique.co.uk/ingredients/), [Odylique: Allergy-friendly](https://odylique.co.uk/allergy-friendly-ingredients/), [Pai Skincare: Dry skin](https://www.paiskincare.com/collections/dry-skin)
**Style: Apothecary clinical label**
- Type: Headings: Della Respira 400 (pharmacy-label contrast); body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 400/18px, chosen so long INCI lists stay readable; INCI names: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #151515 / accent #9C5A12 (amber glass) / surface #F3F1EE / line #151515
- Layout: product page with a label panel (name, size, batch, skin type) boxed in 1px black like a dispensary label; INCI list full width beneath in mono; ingredient library as an A–Z index with anchor letters; square corners, no shadows
- Imagery: bottles and bars on white or on one stone surface at 4:5; raw ingredients photographed as specimens
- Motion: none; A–Z anchors jump without smooth scroll under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: clean-label customers read ingredient lists; the design that wins is the one that makes them legible; see [Haeckels](https://www.haeckels.co.uk/)
**Style variations:** Clinic: pure white, black type, no accent · Botanical: sage bg, green-ink labels · Soap Kitchen: oat bg, brown stamp type
**Refs:**
- [Evolve Beauty: Ingredients library](https://www.evolvebeauty.com/en-eu/pages/skincare-ingredients-library): A–Z entries that link each ingredient to products, exactly the signature
- [Odylique: Allergy-friendly ingredients](https://odylique.co.uk/allergy-friendly-ingredients/): small family maker publishing allergy guidance as its own page
- [Pai Skincare: Dry skin](https://www.paiskincare.com/collections/dry-skin): shop-by-skin-type collections from an independent UK brand

#### 065 · Candle & Home Fragrance (`wick`)
**For:** small candle and home-fragrance makers who hand-pour and sell online and to stockists.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-scent-family (floral / fresh / gourmand / grounding) · single-product · page-scent-by-mood · page-sample-set · page-refills · page-candle-care · page-stockists · page-wholesale
**Patterns (~35):** scent family collections, shop by mood / room, product page with scent notes, scent family, burn time, wax, vessel and size, candle care (first burn full melt, trim wick to 5mm, 4-hour limit, stop at 10mm), sample / discovery set, refills and vessel reuse, scent layering sets, gift box note, stockists, wholesale.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (scent_family, notes, burn_hours, wax, vessel, size_ml, room); companion `stockist` for the map.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (scent family, room, size), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (stockists).
**Signature:** scent-family collections (floral / fresh / gourmand / grounding) with each product listing its notes, family, burn time and wax, plus a discovery sample set for choosing blind (seen on: [Earl of East: Uva candle](https://www.earlofeast.com/products/primavera-estate-uva-scented-candle-250ml), [Keap: Sample set](https://keapcandles.com/products/get-scent-to-home)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Candle care block on every product: first burn, wick trim, burn limit (seen on: [Earl of East: Uva candle](https://www.earlofeast.com/products/primavera-estate-uva-scented-candle-250ml))
- Shop by mood or room page (seen on: [Earl of East: Scent by mood](https://www.earlofeast.com/pages/scent-by-mood))
- Scent quiz for gift buyers (seen on: [Otherland: Scent quiz](https://www.otherland.com/pages/scentquiz))
- Refill and vessel-return scheme with a price per refill
- Christmas last-order dates and "ships in a printed gift box" note
**Real-world basis:** [Earl of East: Uva candle](https://www.earlofeast.com/products/primavera-estate-uva-scented-candle-250ml), [Earl of East: Scent by mood](https://www.earlofeast.com/pages/scent-by-mood), [Keap: Scents](https://keapcandles.com/pages/keap-scents), [Keap: Sample set](https://keapcandles.com/products/get-scent-to-home), [Otherland: Shop by scent](https://www.otherland.com/pages/shop-by-scent)
**Style: Quiet luxury mono**
- Type: Headings: Marcellus 400 (engraved capitals); body: Commissioner 400/18px; notes and burn data: Commissioner 300 small caps
- Palette: bg #EFECE8 (poured soy wax) / text #1C1A18 / accent #5B524A (smoke) / surface #FFFFFF / line #CFC9C2
- Layout: one product per screen on the home page, huge photo left, name and notes right; notes listed as a vertical stack (top / heart / base or listed notes) with burn time beneath; shop 3 across with wide gutters; no badges
- Imagery: vessels shot lit, in real rooms, 4:5; one ingredient still life per scent family
- Motion: slow cross-fade between lit and unlit photo on hover (a real view change), 250ms; none under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: fragrance makers are going quiet and tonal, letting materials and scent language lead; see [Earl of East: Scent by mood](https://www.earlofeast.com/pages/scent-by-mood)
**Style variations:** Amber: honey bg, dark brown type · Linen: white, grey-blue text · Smoke: charcoal bg, ash-white type
**Refs:**
- [Earl of East: Uva candle](https://www.earlofeast.com/products/primavera-estate-uva-scented-candle-250ml): notes, family, burn time, wax and a full candle-care block on one product page
- [Keap: Sample set](https://keapcandles.com/products/get-scent-to-home): discovery set that removes the "can't smell it online" objection
- [Earl of East: Scent by mood](https://www.earlofeast.com/pages/scent-by-mood): browsing by mood and room instead of by product type

#### 066 · Bakery Pre-Order & Pickup (`crumb`)
**For:** neighbourhood bakeries that take online orders for next-day collection alongside walk-in trade.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (this week's bake) · archive-product (bread / pastries / cake / savouries / groceries) · single-product · page-how-ordering-works · page-custom-cakes · page-classes · page-wholesale · page-visit
**Patterns (~40):** this week's bake by category (bread, pastries, cake, savouries, groceries), ordering rules ("order online until midnight the day before"), collection days and hours (Tue–Sat 7:00–15:00), "pre-paid? skip the queue" note, weekly menu refresh day, phone number for same-day orders, allergen table per product, custom cake enquiry with notice period, bread and pastry classes with gift certificates, gift cards, wholesale for cafés, visit info.
**Content model:** Woo products with attributes (allergens, category, available_days); options page for cut-off time, collection days and menu-refresh day.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce (Local Pickup), Order Delivery Date (Lite) for collection date, Jetpack Forms (cakes, wholesale).
**Signature:** a click-and-collect ordering page with a stated cut-off ("online orders until midnight the day before"), fixed collection days and hours, and a weekly menu that refreshes on a set day (seen on: [Hart's Bakery: Info](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/pages/info)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Pre-paid? Tell the counter and skip the queue" line (seen on: [Hart's Bakery: Info](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/pages/info))
- Same-day orders by phone, number shown next to the cut-off (seen on: [Hart's Bakery: Info](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/pages/info))
- Allergen matrix (gluten, milk, egg, nuts, sesame) per product and as a printable PDF
- Bread-class gift certificates (seen on: [e5 Bakehouse: Shop](https://e5bakehouse.com/shop))
- Holiday closure and Christmas order-by dates as scheduled notices
**Real-world basis:** [Hart's Bakery: Info](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/pages/info), [Hart's Bakery: Bread](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/collections/bread), [e5 Bakehouse: Sourdough class](https://e5bakehouse.com/class/sourdough-bread-class), [e5 Bakehouse: Bread](https://e5bakehouse.com/making/bread), [Pophams: Pre-order](https://pophams.slerp.com/order)
**Style: Riso bakery poster**
- Type: Headings: Coiny 400; body: Onest 400/18px; prices and times: Spline Sans Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1A1A1A / accent #FF48B0 (riso fluorescent pink) / accent-2 #0078BF (riso blue) / surface #FFE8F3 / line #1A1A1A
- Layout: this week's bake as a two-ink poster: category headings in pink, items and prices as a typeset list with dotted leaders; ordering rules in a boxed notice at the top; product photos small and square beside items; square corners throughout
- Imagery: bread and pastries shot on the bench in daylight, 1:1; optional two-colour riso-style duotone for headers
- Motion: none; the cut-off notice changes text automatically ("Orders for tomorrow close at midnight") from the options page
- Why it fits now: neighbourhood bakeries run bold, print-like identities with honest lists, not pastel templates; see [e5 Bakehouse](https://e5bakehouse.com/making/bread)
**Style variations:** Sourdough: flour white, black type, rye brown · Patisserie: pale pink, thin serif · Corner Bakery: yellow, red block letters
**Refs:**
- [Hart's Bakery: Info](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/pages/info): the ordering rules a pickup bakery really needs: cut-off, days, hours, skip-the-queue
- [Hart's Bakery: Bread](https://shop.hartsbakery.co.uk/collections/bread): weekly bread list as a simple collection
- [e5 Bakehouse: Sourdough class](https://e5bakehouse.com/class/sourdough-bread-class): classes and gift certificates as a second income line

#### 067 · Stationery & Paper Goods (`paper`)
**For:** independent stationery shops and small notebook makers selling paper, pens and desk objects.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-product (notebooks / pens / correspondence / diaries) · single-product · page-new-arrivals · page-dated-diaries (seasonal) · page-shop-visit · page-wholesale
**Patterns (~40):** notebook product with ruling options (dot grid 5mm / ruled 7mm / blank), paper spec line (gsm, acid-free, fountain-pen friendly, page count, size in mm or cm), preview image per ruling, cover colour swatches, "each notebook is handmade, slight variations" note, category index (notes, pens and pencils, erasers and sharpeners, clips and pins, mail, diaries and planners, perpetual calendars), new arrivals, dated diaries for next year, gift wrapping, shop visit and hours.

- Handmade-variation note next to the add-to-cart (seen on: [Choosing Keeping](https://choosingkeeping.com/products/black-moire-choosing-keeping-medium-notebook))
- Printable ruling samples (A5 PDF) so buyers can test with their own pen
- "Next year's diaries now in" seasonal banner from September, off in February
- Wholesale price list PDF for other shops
**Real-world basis:** [Baron Fig: Confidant](https://baronfig.com/en-nl/products/confidant-hardcover-notebook), [Choosing Keeping: Notebooks](https://choosingkeeping.com/collections/notebooks), [Choosing Keeping: Medium notebook](https://choosingkeeping.com/products/black-moire-choosing-keeping-medium-notebook), [Present & Correct: Notes](https://www.presentandcorrect.com/collections/notes), [Present & Correct: Diaries and planners](https://www.presentandcorrect.com/collections/diaries-planners)
**Style: Japanese stationery grid**
- Type: Headings: Zen Old Mincho 700 for product names; UI and body: Zen Kaku Gothic New 400/18px; specs: Zen Kaku Gothic New 500 with tabular figures
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #222222 / accent #1E88A8 (graph-paper cyan) / surface #F4F7F8 / line #BFD3DA
- Layout: strict 5mm-derived spacing scale; product grid 4 across with objects photographed small on large white fields, like a Tokyo stationery shop; spec table in hairlines under each product; category index as a plain two-column list
- Imagery: objects shot straight down on white at 1:1, open-notebook shots per ruling; no desk-flatlay lifestyle
- Motion: ruling preview swaps with a 150ms cross-fade; nothing else; instant under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: object-led stationery shops with catalogue-like grids are the reference for the category; see [Present & Correct](https://www.presentandcorrect.com/collections/notes)
**Style variations:** Kraft: brown paper surface, black labels · Letterpress: warm white, deep red impressions · Dot Grid: pale grey, cyan dots as rules
**Refs:**

- [Choosing Keeping: Medium notebook](https://choosingkeeping.com/products/black-moire-choosing-keeping-medium-notebook): small London shop, honest specs: gsm, pages, size, fountain-pen friendly

#### 068 · Bike Shop / Frame Builder (`spoke`)
**For:** small frame builders, independent bike brands and neighbourhood workshops.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (frames / completes / parts) · single-product (frame, with geometry) · page-size-guide · archive-build (customer builds) · single-build · page-workshop (service menu) · page-stockists · page-visit
**Patterns (~45):** frame page with geometry table (sizes × stack, reach, head angle, seat angle, BB drop, chainstay, fork length, rake, wheelbase), tubing and material line, tyre clearance, mounts list (bottle, cargo, rack, mudguard), frame and fork weight, pre-order dates for next batch, size guide, customer builds gallery, service menu (basic / commuter / full refurbishment) with prices and "parts extra", à la carte repair prices, walk-in workshop hours, WhatsApp or phone booking, second-hand stock note, stockists.
**Content model:** Woo products + companion `geometry` table (rows per size, columns per measurement) bound to the frame product; `build` (rider, frame, size, parts list, photos); `service` (name, price, includes).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Jetpack Forms (build submissions, service requests), optional Cal.com for workshop slots.
**Signature:** a frame geometry table (six sizes against stack, reach, angles, BB drop, chainstay, rake and wheelbase) on the product page, plus tubing, clearance and mounts (seen on: [Brother Cycles: Kepler](https://www.brothercycles.com/shop/frames/kepler/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Workshop price list with "parts extra where required" (seen on: [Brixton Cycles](https://www.brixtoncycles.co.uk/))
- Customer build gallery (seen on: [Crust Bikes: Peepshow](https://crustbikes.com/blogs/builds))
- Size guide page linked from every frame (seen on: [Brother Cycles: Size guide](https://www.brothercycles.com/support/size-guide/))
- "Workshop booked until 12 May" lead-time line updated by staff
- Printable service checklist for each package
**Real-world basis:** [Brother Cycles: Kepler](https://www.brothercycles.com/shop/frames/kepler/), [Brother Cycles: Size guide](https://www.brothercycles.com/support/size-guide/), [Crust Bikes: Frames](https://crustbikes.com/collections/frames), [Crust Bikes: Peepshow](https://crustbikes.com/blogs/builds), [Brixton Cycles](https://www.brixtoncycles.co.uk/)
**Style: Engineering drawing**
- Type: Headings: Encode Sans Expanded 700; body: Encode Sans 400/18px; geometry values: Cousine 400 tabular
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #14181B / accent #0057B8 (drawing-office blue) / surface #EEF2F5 / line #14181B
- Layout: frame page leads with a side-on frame photo, then the geometry table full width with the chosen size column highlighted; a line drawing of the frame with labelled dimensions (stack, reach) beside it; service menu as a priced list with dotted leaders; square corners
- Imagery: bikes side-on against a plain wall at 16:9; close crops of welds, lugs and dropouts
- Motion: hovering a table column highlights the matching dimension on the drawing; static under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: riders now compare geometry numbers before anything else, and small brands that publish them clearly win trust; see [Brother Cycles: Kepler](https://www.brothercycles.com/shop/frames/kepler/)
**Style variations:** Steel: grey bg, black type, blue lines · Gravel: sand bg, olive accents · Track: white, red race numbers
**Refs:**
- [Brother Cycles: Kepler](https://www.brothercycles.com/shop/frames/kepler/): WooCommerce frame page with a full geometry table and plain specs
- [Brixton Cycles](https://www.brixtoncycles.co.uk/): workers' co-op workshop with a transparent service price list
- [Crust Bikes: Peepshow](https://crustbikes.com/blogs/builds): customer build gallery that sells frames better than product shots

<a id="069"></a>
#### 069 · Natural Wine Shop (`skin-contact`)
**For:** small natural and low-intervention wine shops, often with a bar or tasting counter.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-producer · single-producer (story + all their wines) · single-product · page-subscriptions · page-membership · page-tastings · page-delivery
**Patterns (~40):** producer index by country and region, producer page (family story, farming, soils, all wines listed with grape, style, sold-out state), wine card (producer / region / grape / style), "funk scale" from "not a risk taker" to "drinker discretion advised", style filters (fruity & aromatic, earthy, powerful), monthly subscription (3 / 6 / 12 bottles, mixed / red / white), pause or cancel note, membership with discounts and early access, tastings and events, delivery zones, age confirmation.
**Content model:** Woo products + taxonomy `producer` (term meta: region, country, farming, story, photo); attributes (grape, style, funk_level, colour, vintage).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Subscriptions for WooCommerce, Age Gate, Product Filters (style, funk level, country).
**Signature:** producer pages that tell the grower's story and list all of their wines, with a 1–5 "funk level" on each bottle so customers can pick how adventurous to go (seen on: [Natural Wine Dealers: Abbazia San Giorgio](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/collections/abbazia-san-giorgio), [Natural Wine Dealers: "A bit of funk is alright"](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/collections/3-a-bit-of-funk-is-alright)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Monthly subscription with bottle counts and "pause or cancel any time" (seen on: [Forest Wines: Subscriptions](https://www.forestwines.com/collections/subscriptions))
- Membership with discounts, early cellar releases and priority tastings (seen on: [The Winemakers Club: Membership](https://www.thewinemakersclub.co.uk/pages/membership))
- Sold-out wines stay listed on the producer page with the next vintage date
- Tasting evenings with ticket numbers left
- Delivery zones with same-day local delivery by bike
**Real-world basis:** [Natural Wine Dealers: Producers](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/pages/natural-wine-producers), [Natural Wine Dealers: Abbazia San Giorgio](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/collections/abbazia-san-giorgio), [Forest Wines: Producers](https://www.forestwines.com/pages/producers), [Forest Wines: Cascina Tavijn](https://www.forestwines.com/collections/cascina-tavijn), [Tutto Wines: Ajola](https://tuttowines.com/producers/ajola/)
**Style: Wine-label collage in a strict grid**
- Type: Headings: Stardom 400 (Fontshare); body: Work Sans 400/18px; vintage, grape and funk level: DM Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FBFAF7 / text #1B1B1B / accent #E4572E (skin-contact orange) / surface #FFFFFF / line #1B1B1B; each producer page takes one extra colour from its labels
- Layout: shop grid 4 across where every tile is the real label, cropped square, with a strict typographic caption underneath (producer / wine / vintage / funk 1–5); producer pages in a 5/7 split (story left, wines right); funk scale drawn as five boxes, filled
- Imagery: label close-ups at 1:1, vineyard and cellar photos from the producer at 3:2, credited
- Motion: none beyond link underlines and a View Transition from grid to bottle
- Why it fits now: natural-wine buyers shop by grower and by label; the loud labels need a calm grid to stay usable; see [Natural Wine Dealers](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/pages/natural-wine-producers)
**Style variations:** Pét-Nat: pale pink bg, black type · Orange: amber bg, brown ink · Cellar: dark green bg, cream type
**Refs:**
- [Natural Wine Dealers: Abbazia San Giorgio](https://www.naturalwinedealers.com/collections/abbazia-san-giorgio): a producer page that lists every wine with grape, style and a funk level
- [Forest Wines: Producers](https://www.forestwines.com/pages/producers): small neighbourhood shop organising its whole range by grower
- [Tutto Wines: Ajola](https://tuttowines.com/producers/ajola/): the depth a producer story can have: hectares, soils, farming, the full list of wines

#### 070 · Tea Merchant (`leaf-tea`)
**For:** small loose-leaf tea merchants who buy direct from farms and sell online and from a shop.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (by type: black / green / oolong / white / pu-erh / herbal) · archive-product (by origin) · single-product (brewing + farmer) · page-subscriptions · page-brewing-guide · page-teaware · page-events · page-visit
**Patterns (~35):** tea product with brewing box (grams per cup, water temperature, time, number of infusions), farmer or co-operative and region, harvest date ("Early Spring 2026"), tasting notes, sizes (refill pouch / tin or postcard tin), shop by type and by country, teaware (brewers, caddies, utensils), subscription boxes by tea type, printable brewing guide (metric and imperial), tastings and events, bulk teas for cafés.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (type, origin, farmer, harvest, grams, temp_c, time, infusions); companion `farmer` (co-op, region, farm size, story).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Subscriptions for WooCommerce, Product Filters (type, origin).
**Signature:** a brewing box on every tea (grams per cup, water temperature, number of infusions) next to the farmer, region and harvest date (seen on: [Postcard Teas: Keemun Needles](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product/keemun-needles/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Printable brewing guide PDF in metric and imperial (seen on: [Rare Tea Company: Printable tea guide](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/printable-tea-guide))
- Refill pouch priced below the tin (seen on: [Postcard Teas: Keemun Needles](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product/keemun-needles/))
- Subscription boxes by tea type (seen on: [Rare Tea Company: Subscriptions](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/subscriptions))
- Steep timer on the brewing box (Interactivity API) that counts each infusion
- "New season first flush arriving in May" pre-order notice
**Real-world basis:** [Postcard Teas: Keemun Needles](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product/keemun-needles/), [Postcard Teas: China black teas](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product-category/teas/black-teas/china-black-teas/), [Postcard Teas: Events](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/events/), [Rare Tea Company: Printable tea guide](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/printable-tea-guide), [Rare Tea Company: Subscriptions](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/subscriptions)
**Style: Tea-chest stencil utility**
- Type: Headings: Stardos Stencil 700; body: Petrona 400/18px; brewing numbers: IBM Plex Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1E1C19 / accent #3D6B4F (sencha green) / surface #EDE6D9 (tea-chest plywood) / line #1E1C19
- Layout: product page with a stencilled "chest side" panel (origin, farmer, harvest) and a brewing box set as a three-cell table (grams / °C / infusions); shop by type as a plain list grouped under stencil headings; generous margins, square corners
- Imagery: dry leaf and wet leaf side by side at 1:1; farm portraits credited; teaware on a plain surface
- Motion: steep timer counts down inside the brewing box; nothing else moves; the timer shows plain text under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: tea buyers want farm, harvest and brewing facts up front, in a calm and specific layout; see [Postcard Teas](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product/keemun-needles/)
**Style variations:** Gongfu: dark wood bg, cream type · Matcha: pale green, black stencil · Chai: spice brown, orange labels
**Refs:**
- [Postcard Teas: Keemun Needles](https://www.postcardteas.com/site/product/keemun-needles/): WooCommerce tea page with brewing box, co-operative, harvest date and refill option
- [Rare Tea Company: Printable tea guide](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/printable-tea-guide): printable brewing guide in two unit systems
- [Rare Tea Company: Subscriptions](https://rareteacompany.com/pages/subscriptions): subscription boxes split by tea type

#### 071 · Digital Goods Store (`preset`)
**For:** sellers of Lightroom presets, LUTs, Procreate and Photoshop brushes, textures and templates.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (by app: Lightroom / Procreate / Photoshop / Affinity / Illustrator) · single-product (before/after, contents, compatibility) · page-license · page-free-downloads · page-bundle-builder · page-quiz · page-account-downloads
**Patterns (~40):** before/after sliders on the product page, "what's included" list (presets, tools, tutorial RAW files, manual), compatibility block (app versions, OS versions, mobile sync), collections by app and by look (light & airy, dark & moody, true to colour), license page in plain terms (units, print runs, client work, no resale), free sample pack with email, build-your-own bundle, "which pack is right for you" quiz, lifetime updates note, "all sales final" digital policy.
**Content model:** Woo downloadable products; companion `comparison` (before image, after image, caption) repeater bound to the product; attributes (app, look, version).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce (downloadable products), Jetpack Newsletter (free pack), Product Filters (app, look).
**Signature:** product pages with several before/after sliders on real photos, a complete contents list and an exact compatibility block (app versions, OS, mobile sync) (seen on: [Mastin Labs: Portra Pushed](https://mastinlabs.com/collections/dark-moody-lightroom-desktop-presets/products/portra-pushed-lightroom)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Plain-English license page with unit limits and what needs an extended license (seen on: [RetroSupply: License](https://www.retrosupply.co/pages/retrosupply-license))
- Free brush pack as the newsletter sign-up (seen on: [True Grit Texture Supply: Free brushes](https://www.truegrittexturesupply.com/pages/free-brushes-for-procreate-photoshop-affinity-clipstudio-and-more))
- Build-your-own bundle page (seen on: [Mastin Labs: Build your own bundle](https://mastinlabs.com/pages/build-your-own-lightroom-preset-bundle))
- "Which pack is right for you?" quiz (seen on: [Mastin Labs: Preset quiz](https://mastinlabs.com/pages/preset-quiz))
- Changelog per product with "free update" dates
**Real-world basis:** [Mastin Labs: Portra Pushed](https://mastinlabs.com/collections/dark-moody-lightroom-desktop-presets/products/portra-pushed-lightroom), [Mastin Labs: Preset quiz](https://mastinlabs.com/pages/preset-quiz), [True Grit Texture Supply: Procreate brushes](https://www.truegrittexturesupply.com/collections/procreate-brushes), [True Grit Texture Supply: License](https://www.truegrittexturesupply.com/pages/user-license-agreement-v2), [RetroSupply: License](https://www.retrosupply.co/pages/retrosupply-license)
**Style: File-browser OS revival**
- Type: Headings: Space Mono 700; body: Public Sans 400/18px; file names and versions: Space Mono 400
- Palette: bg #E8E8E4 (desktop grey) / text #111111 / accent #00897B (selection teal) / surface #FFFFFF (window) / line #111111
- Layout: products shown as "windows" with a 1px black frame and a title bar carrying the file name (PORTRA_PUSHED.xmp); contents listed as a file tree with sizes; license as a plain readme; shop grid of square thumbnails like a finder icon view with names beneath
- Imagery: real before/after photographs at 3:2; brush strokes scanned at high resolution on white
- Motion: before/after slider drags with keyboard support; no other motion; slider starts at 50% and stays static under prefers-reduced-motion
- Why it fits now: tool-makers selling to designers are borrowing desktop and file-system metaphors instead of glossy SaaS layouts; see [True Grit Texture Supply](https://www.truegrittexturesupply.com/collections/procreate-brushes)
**Style variations:** Finder: light grey, black frames · Darkroom: near-black bg, red safelight accent · Swatch: white, big colour chips
**Refs:**
- [Mastin Labs: Portra Pushed](https://mastinlabs.com/collections/dark-moody-lightroom-desktop-presets/products/portra-pushed-lightroom): multiple before/after sliders, contents list and exact compatibility
- [RetroSupply: License](https://www.retrosupply.co/pages/retrosupply-license): a license written for humans, with numbers
- [True Grit Texture Supply: License](https://www.truegrittexturesupply.com/pages/user-license-agreement-v2): versioned license agreement linked from every product

#### 072 · Wooden / Heirloom Toy Maker (`block`)
**For:** small workshops making wooden toys, name trains and games meant to last generations.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-product (by age / by type / by name) · single-product · page-guarantee (repair) · page-product-safety · page-caring-for-wood · page-custom-orders · page-visit-us · page-dealers
**Patterns (~35):** shop by age (baby 0–1 / toddler 1–3 / preschool 3–6 / 6+), shop by type, personalised name trains with letter builder, guarantee and repair page (send it back, we repair or replace), replacement loose parts for sale, product safety page (testing, finishes, choking-hazard warnings), caring for wooden toys, made-in location and wood source, open-ended play explainer, custom and bulk orders, factory shop / visit us, dealer locator, customer photo submissions.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (age_band, material, finish, made_in); companion `part` products linked to parent toys for replacements.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (age, type), Jetpack Forms (repair request, photo submission), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (dealers).
**Signature:** a repair guarantee page (return the toy and the workshop repairs or replaces broken parts; lost loose parts sold separately; worn toys restored to a safe state) with a repair request form (seen on: [Maple Landmark: Our guarantee](https://www.maplelandmark.com/guarantee)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Replacement loose parts as buyable products (seen on: [Maple Landmark: Our guarantee](https://www.maplelandmark.com/guarantee))
- Shop by age with a short note on what suits each stage (seen on: [GRIMM'S: Age-appropriate play](https://www.grimms.eu/pages/altersgerechtes-spielen))
- Caring for wooden toys guide (oil, cleaning, storage) as a printable card
- "Submit a photo" of your child's toy for a customer gallery (seen on: [Maple Landmark](https://www.maplelandmark.com/products-by-age))
- Christmas personalisation cut-off for name trains, off after the date
**Real-world basis:** [Maple Landmark: Our guarantee](https://www.maplelandmark.com/guarantee), [Maple Landmark: Products by age](https://www.maplelandmark.com/products-by-age), [Maple Landmark: Product safety](https://www.maplelandmark.com/product-safety-and-quality), [GRIMM'S: Age-appropriate play](https://www.grimms.eu/pages/altersgerechtes-spielen), [Wooden Story: Workshop](https://woodenstory.com/pages/workshop)
**Style: Bauhaus primary geometry**
- Type: Headings: League Spartan 800; body: Outfit 400/18px; age bands and dimensions: IBM Plex Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1A1A1A / accent #E53A2F (signal red, buttons and links only) / surface #F6C318 (yellow, used for age-band blocks) / line #1A1A1A
- Layout: home page = one toy photographed large on white → shop by age as four solid blocks (circle, square, triangle, arch cut from the page grid) → guarantee paragraph; product grid 3 across; square corners except the deliberate shape blocks
- Imagery: toys on white at 1:1 with a child's hand for scale in one shot per product; workshop photos of lathes and wood stock
- Motion: none; age blocks change colour on hover to confirm they are links
- Why it fits now: design-led toy makers draw on Bauhaus toy history with flat colour and simple forms; see [Naef Spiele](https://www.naefspiele.ch/)
**Style variations:** Montessori: natural wood tones, soft green · Nursery: pale blue, rounded headings · Workshop: kraft bg, black stamps
**Refs:**
- [Maple Landmark: Our guarantee](https://www.maplelandmark.com/guarantee): the honest repair promise, with limits, that an heirloom toy maker should publish
- [GRIMM'S: Age-appropriate play](https://www.grimms.eu/pages/altersgerechtes-spielen): age bands that link straight to filtered products
- [Maple Landmark: Products by age](https://www.maplelandmark.com/products-by-age): a small Vermont workshop's age-first navigation

#### 073 · Farm Shop / CSA Veg Box (`harvest`)
**For:** community-supported veg box schemes, market gardens and small organic farms.
**Templates:** front-page · page-veg-bags (sizes and prices) · page-pick-up-points (map) · page-how-it-works · page-whats-in-this-week · page-solidarity-pricing · Woo shop (extras) · page-our-growers · page-farm-diary · page-volunteer
**Patterns (~45):** bag sizes (small / medium / large, veg and/or fruit), pick-up points map with collection days and times, delivery area by district, "harvest Monday and Tuesday, packed Wednesday" rhythm, weekly email with what's in the bag, "see next week's items from Thursday", pause for holidays before a stated cut-off (donate or skip), solidarity pricing (pay less or pay a little extra), Healthy Start vouchers and pensioner discount, extras shop (eggs, bread, dry goods), growers list with miles from the city, volunteer days.
**Content model:** Woo subscriptions for bags; companion `pickup_point` (address, lat/lng, day, times, self-service); `grower` (farm, distance, produce); weekly `bag_contents` post.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Subscriptions for WooCommerce, Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (pick-up points), Order Delivery Date (Lite).
**Signature:** a pick-up points map with each point's collection day and times, next to clear bag sizes and a holiday-pause rule with its weekly cut-off (seen on: [OrganicLea: Box scheme](https://organiclea.org.uk/buy/the-box-scheme/), [Growing Communities: Veg schemes](https://growingcommunities.org/vegschemes)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Solidarity pricing: pay less if you need to, pay more to support others (seen on: [OrganicLea](https://organiclea.org.uk/buy/the-box-scheme/))
- Healthy Start vouchers and pensioner discount stated with prices (seen on: [Growing Communities](https://growingcommunities.org/vegschemes))
- Holiday pause cut-off ("by Tuesday evening the week before") with donate-your-bag option (seen on: [OrganicLea](https://organiclea.org.uk/buy/the-box-scheme/))
- Seasonal produce calendar (what's in the bag month by month)
- Recipe for an unfamiliar vegetable in each weekly email
**Real-world basis:** [OrganicLea: Box scheme](https://organiclea.org.uk/buy/the-box-scheme/), [Growing Communities: Veg schemes](https://growingcommunities.org/vegschemes), [Sutton Community Farm: Seasonal boxes](https://www.suttoncommunityfarm.org.uk/c/seasonal-boxes), [Sutton Community Farm: Small veg box](https://www.suttoncommunityfarm.org.uk/c/organic-vegboxes/small-veg-box-1)
**Style: Seed-packet letterpress**
- Type: Headings: Rokkitt 800; body: Vollkorn 400/19px; days, times and prices: IBM Plex Mono 500
- Palette: bg #F1ECDC (unbleached seed-packet paper) / text #20231A / accent #4E7A2C (allotment green) / surface #FFFFFF / line #20231A
- Layout: bag sizes as three seed-packet panels (name, contents, price, serves) in a row; pick-up map full width with a plain list of points beneath, grouped by day; this week's bag as a typeset list with the grower's name next to each item
- Imagery: produce on the packing table at 4:5; growers photographed in their fields, named; no stock baskets
- Motion: none; map pins open a text panel, no animated markers
- Why it fits now: food-growing projects present as community infrastructure, with plain rules and real faces, not lifestyle branding; see [Growing Communities](https://growingcommunities.org/vegschemes)
**Style variations:** Allotment: green bg, cream type · Market: white, chalkboard black headings · Winter Roots: beetroot red accent on grey
**Refs:**
- [OrganicLea: Box scheme](https://organiclea.org.uk/buy/the-box-scheme/): collection-only scheme with solidarity pricing and a clear pause rule
- [Growing Communities: Veg schemes](https://growingcommunities.org/vegschemes): 30 pick-up points, harvest-to-pack rhythm and discounts spelled out
- [Sutton Community Farm: Small veg box](https://www.suttoncommunityfarm.org.uk/c/organic-vegboxes/small-veg-box-1): a box product page from a community farm

#### 074 · Hand-Dyed Yarn & Patterns (`skein`)
**For:** independent hand-dyers and knitwear designers selling yarn, patterns and kits.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (by weight: lace / fingering / DK / aran) · archive-colourway · single-product (base + colourway) · archive-pattern · single-pattern · page-kits · page-clubs · page-colour-facts · page-pattern-gallery
**Patterns (~40):** yarn product (base name, fibre blend, 100g, metres and yards per skein), colourway grid on a base, shop by weight, colourway index with colour filter, knit kits (pattern + main and contrast colourways, size changes skein count), pattern pages (difficulty, needles, construction, yardage by size), yarn clubs and advent calendars, pre-order and dye-to-order lead times, colour facts page (no dye lots, alternate skeins, pre-wash brights), pattern gallery of finished knits, gift cards.
**Content model:** Woo variable products: attribute `base` (fibre, weight, metres) × attribute `colourway`; companion `pattern` (difficulty, needles, gauge, yardage per size, PDF) linked to kit products.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (weight, fibre, colour).
**Signature:** knit kits that pair a pattern with chosen colourways for main and contrast, where picking a size sets the number of skeins (seen on: [Qing Fibre: Mochi sweater kit](https://www.qingfibre.com/products/mochi-sweater-knit-kit-melted-baby-suri)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Colour facts page: no dye lots, alternate skeins, pre-wash brights, screens vary (seen on: [Kettle Yarn Co: Colour facts](https://www.kettleyarnco.co.uk/pages/colour-facts))
- Pre-order label with dye-to-order lead time (seen on: [Kettle Yarn Co: Beyul DK](https://www.kettleyarnco.co.uk/collections/dk/products/beyul-dk-auburn))
- Colour packs of four or five coordinated skeins (seen on: [Eden Cottage Yarns: Five-colour DK packs](https://www.edencottageyarns.co.uk/collections/five-colour-dk-yarn-packs))
- Patterns filtered by yarn weight (seen on: [Eden Cottage Yarns: Patterns for DK](https://www.edencottageyarns.co.uk/collections/patterns-for-dk-yarn))
- Yarn club sign-up window that opens and closes on dates
**Real-world basis:** [Qing Fibre: Mochi sweater kit](https://www.qingfibre.com/products/mochi-sweater-knit-kit-melted-baby-suri), [Qing Fibre: Colourways](https://www.qingfibre.com/pages/colourways), [Kettle Yarn Co: Colour facts](https://www.kettleyarnco.co.uk/pages/colour-facts), [Kettle Yarn Co: Beyul DK](https://www.kettleyarnco.co.uk/collections/dk/products/beyul-dk-auburn), [Eden Cottage Yarns: Five-colour DK packs](https://www.edencottageyarns.co.uk/collections/five-colour-dk-yarn-packs)
**Style: Knitting-chart grid**
- Type: Headings: Recursive Sans Casual 800; body: Recursive Sans Linear 400/18px; yardage, weights and needle sizes: Recursive Mono 400 (one variable superfamily, three voices)
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1D1A1F / accent #B0306A (magenta dye pot) / surface #F2EEF2 / line #D9D2DA
- Layout: colourways as a tight swatch grid of skein photos, 6 across, names beneath; product pages with a base spec table (fibre, weight, metres, yards, needles); kits laid out like a pattern cover: finished garment large, then yarn list with quantities per size in a chart-like table
- Imagery: skeins shot twisted on white at 1:1 in daylight, plus one knitted swatch per colourway; finished garments on real people at 4:5
- Motion: none; swatch hover shows the knitted swatch (a real second view)
- Why it fits now: indie dyers compete on colour and honest fibre info, shown in grids that let knitters compare; see [Qing Fibre: Colourways](https://www.qingfibre.com/pages/colourways)
**Style variations:** Speckle: white, multicolour flecks as dividers · Heather: oat bg, muted plum · Undyed: natural cream, brown ink only
**Refs:**
- [Qing Fibre: Mochi sweater kit](https://www.qingfibre.com/products/mochi-sweater-knit-kit-melted-baby-suri): pattern + two colourways + size-based quantities in one product
- [Kettle Yarn Co: Colour facts](https://www.kettleyarnco.co.uk/pages/colour-facts): the policy page every hand-dyer needs
- [Eden Cottage Yarns: Five-colour DK packs](https://www.edencottageyarns.co.uk/collections/five-colour-dk-yarn-packs): coordinated colour packs for colourwork projects

#### 075 · Hot Sauce / Small-Batch Pantry (`heat`)
**For:** small-batch hot sauce, chilli oil and condiment makers, and specialist hot sauce shops.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop · archive-product (by heat) · single-product · page-subscriptions · page-gift-packs · archive-recipe · page-stockists · page-wholesale
**Patterns (~35):** heat levels (mild / medium / hot / hottest) on every bottle and as a filter, flavour profile (fruit, garlic, salt, smoke, sweet, vinegar), dietary filters (vegan, gluten-free, no garlic), food pairings (wings, tacos, pizza, eggs), gift packs by price band, subscription club, recipes using the sauce, stockists list or map, wholesale for shops and restaurants, ingredients and allergens.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (heat_level, peppers, flavour_profile, diet, pairing); companion `recipe` linked to products; `stockist` (name, address, lat/lng).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (heat, flavour, diet), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (stockists), Subscriptions for WooCommerce.
**Signature:** heat level as a primary filter and a label on every bottle, with flavour profile and food-pairing filters beside it (seen on: [HEATONIST: All hot sauces](https://heatonist.com/collections/all-hot-sauces)).
