- Recipes that use each sauce, linked from the product (seen on: [Mic's Chilli: Recipes](https://www.micschilli.com/recipes))
- Gift packs by price band (seen on: [HEATONIST: Gift sets under $30](https://heatonist.com/collections/hot-sauce-gift-sets-under-30))
- Subscription club with a new sauce each month (seen on: [HEATONIST: Subscriptions](https://heatonist.com/collections/hot-ones-hot-sauce-subscriptions))
- Batch number and "best before" printed on the product page
**Real-world basis:** [HEATONIST: All hot sauces](https://heatonist.com/collections/all-hot-sauces), [HEATONIST: Subscriptions](https://heatonist.com/collections/hot-ones-hot-sauce-subscriptions), [Mic's Chilli: Stockists](https://www.micschilli.com/stockist), [Mic's Chilli: Recipes](https://www.micschilli.com/recipes), [Hot-Headz: Marie Sharp's gift set](https://hot-headz.com/hot-gifts/gift-packs/marie-sharps-3-pack-gift-set-sweet-heat/)
**Style: Bootleg-label maximalism**
- Type: Headings: Bungee 400; body: Sora 400/18px; heat levels and batch numbers: Martian Mono 700
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #140F0B / accent #E3120B (chilli red) / surface #FFD23F (label yellow) / line #140F0B
- Layout: bottles shown label-forward in a 4-col grid, each with a heat bar of four blocks filled to its level; product page with a big label crop, then a ruled table (peppers / heat / flavour / pairs with); recipes as a numbered method; loud colour only inside labels and heat bars, the rest stays white
- Imagery: bottles on white and on real food at 4:5; pepper close-ups
- Motion: none; heat filter updates results without layout shift
- Why it fits now: sauce buyers shop by heat and flavour; bold label graphics work when the grid around them is strict; see [HEATONIST](https://heatonist.com/collections/all-hot-sauces)
**Style variations:** Habanero: orange surface, black type · Fermented: olive and cream · Smoke: charcoal bg, ember red
**Refs:**
- [HEATONIST: All hot sauces](https://heatonist.com/collections/all-hot-sauces): heat, flavour profile, diet and pairing filters on one shop page
- [Mic's Chilli: Stockists](https://www.micschilli.com/stockist): a small maker's stockist list, the pattern every sauce brand needs

#### 076 · Skate / Surf Shop (`deck`)
**For:** independent skate shops with a physical store, a team and an online shop.

**Patterns (~40):** decks by brand and width, "free grip" on decks, completes for beginners and kids, undercarriage kits (trucks, wheels, bearings, bolts), truck size guide (deck width to truck axle), shoe sizes as filters, team riders page, video archive on the shop blog, events and contests, shop's own branded decks, store address and hours.
**Content model:** Woo attributes (deck_width, truck_size, wheel_size, brand, shoe_size); companion `rider` (name, stance, sponsor, clips); posts for videos.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Product Filters (width, brand, size), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (local spots, optional).
**Signature:** a truck size guide that matches deck width to truck size, linked to undercarriage kits that bundle trucks, wheels, bearings and bolts for a first setup (seen on: [Welcome Skate Store: Truck size guide](https://welcomeleeds.com/pages/truck-size-guide), [Welcome Skate Store: Undercarriage kits](https://welcomeleeds.com/collections/skateboard-undercarriage-kits)).

#### 077 · Florist (`stem`)
**For:** independent florists with a shop, local delivery, weddings and workshops.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (bouquets / plants / dried) · single-product · page-delivery (zones, cut-offs) · page-subscriptions · page-weddings · archive-wedding (real weddings) · page-workshops · page-visit
**Patterns (~40):** bouquet cards in sizes (e.g. delicate / charming / abundant / magnificent), "order by 4pm for same-day London delivery, next day nationwide" line, delivery charges by zone, click and collect from the shop, gift message at checkout, "florist's choice, substitutions made if unavailable" note, flower subscription (weekly or monthly, prepaid or rolling, with savings), wedding enquiry and real-wedding stories, workshops calendar with gift vouchers, late or urgent orders "call us" line.
**Content model:** Woo products (size variations); delivery settings via Order Delivery Date; companion `wedding` (venue, season, flowers used, photographer credit); `workshop` (date, places left, price).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Order Delivery Date (Lite), Subscriptions for WooCommerce, Jetpack Forms (weddings).
**Signature:** a same-day cut-off stated on every product ("order by 4pm for same-day London delivery, next day nationwide") that drives the delivery-date picker, plus a gift-message field at checkout (seen on: [Wild at Heart: London flower delivery](https://wildatheart.com/pages/london-flower-delivery)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Missed the cut-off? Call us" line with the shop phone number (seen on: [Wild at Heart](https://wildatheart.com/pages/london-flower-delivery))
- Subscription with prepaid and rolling options and the saving stated (seen on: [Wild at Heart: Bouquet subscriptions](https://wildatheart.com/products/bouquet-subscriptions))
- Substitution policy in one sentence under every bouquet (seen on: [Wild at Heart](https://wildatheart.com/products/bouquet-subscriptions))
- Mother's Day and Valentine's cut-off banners with their own dates, off afterwards
- Flower care card (trim stems, change water, keep from fruit) as a printable insert
**Real-world basis:** [Wild at Heart: London flower delivery](https://wildatheart.com/pages/london-flower-delivery), [Wild at Heart: Bouquet subscriptions](https://wildatheart.com/products/bouquet-subscriptions), [Grace & Thorn: Workshops](https://graceandthorn.com/pages/workshops), [Grace & Thorn: Bespoke weddings](https://graceandthorn.com/pages/bespoke-weddings), [Rebel Rebel: Wedding flowers](https://www.rebelrebel.co.uk/wedding-flowers)
**Style: Seasonal still-life editorial**
- Type: Headings: Alice 400; body: Lora 400/19px; prices, cut-offs and sizes: Rethink Sans 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1C1D19 / accent #7A2E4A (dark peony) / surface #EFEAE4 (backdrop paper) / line #1C1D19
- Layout: bouquets as large portrait images, 2 across on desktop, with name, size and price beneath in one line; the cut-off line sits directly under the price; weddings as long editorial stories with captions naming each flower; workshops as a dated list
- Imagery: bouquets shot as still lifes against one coloured paper backdrop per season at 4:5; real weddings credited to photographers
- Motion: none; the delivery-date picker greys out days after the cut-off
- Why it fits now: florists are selling with seasonal photography and plain service rules rather than stock "luxury" templates; see [Wild at Heart](https://wildatheart.com/pages/london-flower-delivery)
**Style variations:** Dried: sand bg, brown ink · Studio: white, black headings, one colour per season · Night: near-black bg for evening arrangements, ivory type
**Refs:**
- [Wild at Heart: London flower delivery](https://wildatheart.com/pages/london-flower-delivery): the cut-off rule, same-day and next-day areas, and a phone fallback, all in plain words
- [Wild at Heart: Bouquet subscriptions](https://wildatheart.com/products/bouquet-subscriptions): subscription options with sizes, prepaid savings and gift messages
- [Grace & Thorn: Workshops](https://graceandthorn.com/pages/workshops): workshops as a second product line for an independent florist

#### 078 · Pet Goods Maker (`good-dog`)
**For:** small makers of dog beds, collars, leads and accessories.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (beds / collars and leads / crate bedding / blankets) · single-product · page-bed-size-guide · page-collar-measuring-guide · page-care (washing) · page-customer-reviews · page-meet-the-team · page-press
**Patterns (~35):** bed size guide with measuring method ("nose to base of tail, top of head to floor, × 1.25"), collar measuring guide (measure an existing collar buckle to hole, or measure the neck), breed-specific cuts (sighthound collars), crate bedding by crate size, fabric collections, washing instructions, customer reviews with photos, meet the team, press page, international shipping, returns and exchanges.
**Content model:** Woo variable products (size, fabric, colour); attributes (length_cm, width_cm, fits_crate, neck_range_cm); companion `pet_photo` (dog name, breed, product) for the customer wall.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Jetpack Forms (photo submissions, bespoke collar enquiries).
**Signature:** measuring guides that turn the dog's own measurements into a size (bed: nose to tail and head to floor, multiplied by 1.25; collar: measure an existing collar from buckle to hole) linked from every product (seen on: [Charley Chau: Dog bed size guide](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/dog-bed-size-guide), [Charley Chau: Measuring for a collar](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/how-to-measure-for-a-leather-dog-collar)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Breed-specific cuts, such as sighthound collars (seen on: [Charley Chau: Measuring for a collar](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/how-to-measure-for-a-leather-dog-collar))
- Washing guide for beds and covers (seen on: [Charley Chau: How to wash a dog bed](https://www.charleychau.com/blogs/blog-offers/tips-on-how-to-wash-a-dog-bed-in-a-washing-machine))
- Customer reviews page with dog photos (seen on: [Charley Chau: Customer reviews](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/customer-reviews))
- Crate bedding sized to named crate models (seen on: [Charley Chau: Crate bedding](https://www.charleychau.com/collections/bedding-for-dog-crates))
- Engraved name tag with a character-limit preview and a "made in 5 working days" lead time
**Real-world basis:** [Charley Chau: Dog bed size guide](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/dog-bed-size-guide), [Charley Chau: Measuring for a collar](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/how-to-measure-for-a-leather-dog-collar), [Charley Chau: Customer reviews](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/customer-reviews), [Ruffwear: How to fit](https://ruffwear.com/pages/how-to-fit), [Lords & Labradors: Shop by breed](https://www.lordsandlabradors.co.uk/pages/shop-by-breed)
**Style: Saddlery workshop**
- Type: Headings: Darker Grotesque 900; body: Mulish 400/18px; sizes and measurements: Fragment Mono 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1B1B1B / accent #8A4B2A (bridle-leather tan) / surface #EFEBE6 / line #1B1B1B
- Layout: product page with a measuring diagram (dog silhouette with labelled lines) beside the size table; shop grid 3 across; customer dog wall as a dense 6-col grid of square photos with dog name and breed; square corners
- Imagery: products in use with real dogs at home, 4:5; leather and fabric close-ups; no studio dogs in costumes
- Motion: none; size table highlights the recommended row once measurements are entered
- Why it fits now: pet owners buy on fit and durability; guides and real dogs do more than lifestyle styling; see [Charley Chau](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/dog-bed-size-guide)
**Style variations:** Leather: tan bg panels, dark brown type · Rope: navy and white, nautical stripe rules · Park: grass green, cream labels
**Refs:**
- [Charley Chau: Dog bed size guide](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/dog-bed-size-guide): a measuring method instead of a vague size chart
- [Charley Chau: Measuring for a collar](https://www.charleychau.com/pages/how-to-measure-for-a-leather-dog-collar): two measuring methods, with breed-specific collar cuts
- [Ruffwear: How to fit](https://ruffwear.com/pages/how-to-fit): fitting guidance for harnesses and gear by girth

<a id="079"></a>
#### 079 · Refill / Zero-Waste Shop (`refill`)
**For:** zero-waste and refill grocery shops selling loose food, cleaning and toiletries by weight.
**Templates:** front-page · Woo shop (per 100g) · single-product · page-how-it-works · page-our-solution (supply chain) · page-delivery-area · page-visit · page-seasonal-box
**Patterns (~35):** price per 100g in the product name and price line, "enter your postcode to start shopping" gate for local delivery, click and collect or local delivery (city area only), bring-your-own-container steps (weigh, fill, pay by weight), shop containers and paper bags, "free to a good home" jar shelf, allergen line per bulk item ("may contain traces of…"), supply-chain transparency (share of paper, plastic and returnable packaging from suppliers), opening hours with closed day, seasonal veg box add-on.
**Content model:** Woo products sold by 100g units with a companion `unit_price` binding; attributes (origin, organic, allergens); options for delivery postcodes.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Order Delivery Date (Lite).
**Signature:** loose goods priced per 100g with a postcode gate that limits online orders to the local delivery area or click and collect (seen on: [The Clean Kilo: Cashews per 100g](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/product/cashews-per-100g/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- How-to-shop steps: weigh the empty jar, fill, pay by weight (seen on: [Precycle: How to shop at zero-waste stores](https://www.precyclenyc.com/news/2023/2/6/how-to-shop-at-bulk-grocery-stores))
- Supply-chain packaging breakdown as a trust statement (seen on: [The Clean Kilo: Our solution](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/our-solution/))
- "Free to a good home" container shelf mentioned on the visit page (seen on: [The Clean Kilo](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/our-solution/))
- Allergen and cross-contamination line on every bulk product (seen on: [The Clean Kilo: Cashews](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/product/cashews-per-100g/))
- Printable price list for the shop wall generated from product prices
**Real-world basis:** [The Clean Kilo: Shop](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/shop/), [The Clean Kilo: Cashews per 100g](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/product/cashews-per-100g/), [The Clean Kilo: Our solution](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/our-solution/), [Precycle: How to shop](https://www.precyclenyc.com/news/2023/2/6/how-to-shop-at-bulk-grocery-stores)
**Style: Bulk-bin stencil signage**
- Type: Headings: Saira Stencil One 400; body: Inclusive Sans 400/18px; unit prices: B612 Mono 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1F241F / accent #005A8C (bin-label blue) / surface #EEF3F6 / line #1F241F
- Layout: shop as a long list like the wall of bins: name, origin, price per 100g, add; photos optional and small; how-it-works as a real numbered sequence (weigh / fill / pay); visit page with hours as a table
- Imagery: dispensers and jars in the actual shop, 3:2; product close-ups in the shop's own jars
- Motion: none
- Why it fits now: refill shops are local utilities; a list-first shop reads like the bins in store and loads fast on a phone; see [The Clean Kilo](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/shop/)
**Style variations:** Market: kraft surface, black stencil · Laboratory: white, blue-grey labels · Pantry: pale green, dark olive type
**Refs:**
- [The Clean Kilo: Cashews per 100g](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/bournvillestore/product/cashews-per-100g/): WooCommerce refill shop with per-100g pricing and a postcode gate
- [The Clean Kilo: Our solution](https://thecleankilo.co.uk/our-solution/): an honest account of where the packaging goes
- [Precycle: How to shop](https://www.precyclenyc.com/news/2023/2/6/how-to-shop-at-bulk-grocery-stores): first-visit guide for new refill customers

<a id="080"></a>
#### 080 · Outdoor Gear Repair & Resale (`patch`)
**For:** independent outdoor gear repair workshops, including mail-in repair and refurbished resale.
**Templates:** front-page · page-repairs (what we repair, price list) · page-send-a-repair (mail-in form and address) · page-price-inquiry · page-wash-and-reproof · Woo shop (refurbished gear, spares) · page-diy-repair (kits and guides) · page-visit
**Patterns (~40):** what we repair (jackets, packs, tents, sleeping bags, waders), repair price list (zip slider, full zip, patch, down top-up), wash and reproof prices, mail-in repair form, "include your contact details and order number" packing note, outbound postage paid by customer / return free, typical turnaround ("1 to 2 weeks"), emails on receipt and completion, price inquiry form before sending, authorised repair centre badges (e.g. waterproof membrane makers), spares and repair kits shop, in-store repair desk hours, recycling of unrepairable gear.
**Content model:** companion `repair_service` (item type, price from, turnaround); Woo products for spares and refurbished items with attribute `condition`; Jetpack Forms entries for repair tickets.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Jetpack Forms (repair form, price inquiry).
**Signature:** a mail-in repair flow: price list, a price-inquiry form before posting, a repair form with the workshop address, and a stated turnaround with email updates on receipt and on completion (seen on: [Rainy Pass Repair](https://www.rainypass.com/), [Alpkit: Repair station](https://alpkit.com/pages/repair-station)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Repair price list with "from" prices by job (seen on: [Alpkit: Repair station](https://alpkit.com/pages/repair-station))
- Price inquiry before sending (seen on: [Rainy Pass Repair: Price inquiry](https://rainypass.com/price-inquiry/))
- Spares and self-repair kits (seen on: [Alpkit: Spares and repairs](https://alpkit.com/collections/spares-parts-repairs-and-replacements))
- "Winter backlog: currently 3 weeks" turnaround line updated by staff
- Recycling option for gear that can't be repaired (seen on: [Rainy Pass Repair](https://www.rainypass.com/))
**Real-world basis:** [Rainy Pass Repair](https://www.rainypass.com/), [Rainy Pass Repair: Price inquiry](https://rainypass.com/price-inquiry/), [Alpkit: Repair station](https://alpkit.com/pages/repair-station), [Alpkit: Reduce, reuse, repair, recycle](https://alpkit.com/pages/reduce-reuse-repair-recycle), [Alpkit: Spares and repairs](https://alpkit.com/collections/spares-parts-repairs-and-replacements)
**Style: Workshop job-ticket**
- Type: Headings: Oswald 600; body: Source Sans 3 400/18px; ticket numbers and prices: IBM Plex Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1A1D1A / accent #C8102E (alpine rescue red) / surface #F0F1EE / line #1A1D1A
- Layout: repair page built like a job ticket: item, fault, price from, turnaround in ruled rows; mail-in steps as a true numbered sequence; refurbished shop grid 3 across with condition line; no decorative contour backgrounds
- Imagery: before and after photos of real repairs at 1:1 (torn shell, patched shell), workshop benches and sewing machines
- Motion: none
- Why it fits now: repair is mainstream outdoor culture now; customers want prices and turnaround first; see [Alpkit: Repair station](https://alpkit.com/pages/repair-station)
**Style variations:** Alpine: white, red, black · Trail: olive surface, orange tickets · Workshop: kraft bg, stencil numbers
**Refs:**
- [Alpkit: Repair station](https://alpkit.com/pages/repair-station): price list, postal addresses and in-store repair desks
- [Rainy Pass Repair](https://www.rainypass.com/): independent Seattle workshop with mail-in repair form and turnaround stated
- [Rainy Pass Repair: Price inquiry](https://rainypass.com/price-inquiry/): quote before you post, which saves both sides time

#### 081 · Board-Game Shop & Café (`meeple`)
**For:** board-game cafés with a play library, table bookings, a bar/kitchen and a retail shop.
**Templates:** front-page · page-game-library (search and filter) · single-game · page-book-a-table · page-menu · page-events · Woo shop · page-new-releases · page-visit
**Patterns (~45):** game library search with filters (venue, player count range, category), per-game page with players, play time, category and which venue has it, board game guides (how to play), table booking with cover charge and time slots, food and drink menu, events (learn-to-play nights, tournaments), shop categories (family, party, co-op, deduction, card, RPG), weekly new releases post, clearance games, gift cards.
**Content model:** companion `game` (players_min, players_max, play_time, complexity, category, venue, guide link); Woo products for retail with a shared `game` relation.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Query Filter (players, time, category, venue), Cal.com or external booking embed.
**Signature:** a searchable library of 1,000+ games filterable by player count, category and venue, with a how-to-play guide per game (seen on: [Draughts: Game library](https://games.draughtslondon.com/), [Draughts: Board game guides](https://draughtslondon.com/board-game-guides/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Weekly "new releases" post (seen on: [Thirsty Meeples: New releases](https://thirstymeeples.co.uk/blogs/game-talk/new-releases-21-september-2026))
- Table booking page stating cover charge and session length (seen on: [Draughts: Book a table](https://draughtslondon.com/book/))
- Library availability per location (seen on: [Snakes & Lattes: Library](https://www.snakesandlattes.com/library))
- "Game guru on shift" line so newcomers know someone will teach them
- Accessibility notes: step-free entrance, large-print rule cards, quieter weekday sessions
**Real-world basis:** [Draughts: Game library](https://games.draughtslondon.com/), [Draughts: Board game guides](https://draughtslondon.com/board-game-guides/), [Draughts: Book a table](https://draughtslondon.com/book/), [Thirsty Meeples: Café](https://thirstymeeples.co.uk/pages/thirsty-meeples-board-game-caf), [Snakes & Lattes: Library](https://www.snakesandlattes.com/library)
**Style: Rulebook slab**
- Type: Headings: Bitter 800; body: Bitter 400/18px; player counts and times: Victor Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #1E1B18 / accent #D1495B (meeple red) / surface #E6EEF5 (card-table blue-grey) / line #1E1B18
- Layout: library as a dense table-like list (title / players / time / weight / venue) with small box art, switchable to a box-art grid; game page styled like a rulebook page with "Players 2–4 · 45 min · Ages 10+" set in mono; square corners
- Imagery: box art at native ratio; photos of tables mid-game from above at 3:2
- Motion: none; filters update results in place
- Why it fits now: board-game cafés sell the library as much as the coffee; a searchable, rulebook-clear list is the product; see [Draughts](https://games.draughtslondon.com/)
**Style variations:** Tabletop: green felt surface, cream type · Arcade: black bg, pixel headings · Card: white, suit-red and black only
**Refs:**
- [Draughts: Game library](https://games.draughtslondon.com/): 1,000+ games filterable by players, category and venue
- [Draughts: Board game guides](https://draughtslondon.com/board-game-guides/): WordPress how-to-play guides that also bring in search traffic
- [Thirsty Meeples: New releases](https://thirstymeeples.co.uk/blogs/game-talk/new-releases-21-september-2026): a weekly new-releases habit from an Oxford café-shop

<a id="082"></a>
#### 082 · Creator Merch Drop Store (`drop`)
**For:** podcasters, YouTubers, streamers and small bands selling limited runs of merch.
**Templates:** front-page (current drop) · Woo shop · single-product · page-in-production (pre-orders) · page-size-guide · page-shipping · page-faq
**Patterns (~30):** current drop with end date, limited-edition items showing "N remaining", sold-out state kept visible, pre-order items marked "In production" with a batch ship window ("First batch: 26–31 Oct"), "missed out? pre-order for the second batch" note, size guide with flat measurements, shipping by region with times, "ships separately from other items" note, restock email sign-up, bundles (tee + record).
**Content model:** Woo products with stock management; companion meta `production_status` (in production / shipping / sold out), `batch_window`, `drop_end`.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Jetpack Newsletter (restock and drop alerts).
**Signature:** limited items that show how many are left ("6 remaining") and pre-orders labelled "In production" with a batch ship window, instead of a fake countdown (seen on: [Khruangbin: Live at Sydney Opera House](https://khruangbin.bandcamp.com/album/khruangbin-live-at-sydney-opera-house), [Limited Run Games: in-production item](https://limitedrungames.com/en-eu/collections/all-in-production/products/30-a-playstation-retrospective-hardcover)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Missed out? Pre-order the second batch" line on sold-out items (seen on: [Limited Run Games](https://limitedrungames.com/en-eu/collections/all-in-production/products/30-a-playstation-retrospective-hardcover))
- Sold-out items stay on the merch page as a record of past drops (seen on: [Heavenly Recordings: Merch](https://heavenly.bandcamp.com/merch))
- Region-specific editions ("excluding North and South America") (seen on: [Khruangbin: Christmas Time Is Here](https://khruangbin.bandcamp.com/album/christmas-time-is-here-excluding-n-s-america))
- Size guide in flat centimetres and inches with a "compare with a tee you own" tip
- "Pre-order items ship separately" checkout note
**Real-world basis:** [Khruangbin: Live at Sydney Opera House](https://khruangbin.bandcamp.com/album/khruangbin-live-at-sydney-opera-house), [Khruangbin: Merch](https://khruangbin.bandcamp.com/merch), [Heavenly Recordings: Merch](https://heavenly.bandcamp.com/merch), [Limited Run Games: in-production item](https://limitedrungames.com/en-eu/collections/all-in-production/products/30-a-playstation-retrospective-hardcover), [Fangamer: Collections](https://www.fangamer.com/collections)
**Style: Streetwear drop mono**
- Type: Headings: Dela Gothic One 400; body: Geologica 400/18px; stock counts and dates: Sometype Mono 500
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #000000 / accent #E10600 (drop red, used for "remaining" and sold-out only) / surface #FFE500 (tag yellow) / line #000000
- Layout: one product per screen on the drop page, full-bleed photo, name, price and "N remaining" in huge mono; shop grid 2 across on mobile, 4 on desktop; size guide as a plain table
- Imagery: garments on real people from the community, flash photography at 4:5; flat lays for detail
- Motion: none; the remaining count updates on page load only
- Why it fits now: creator merch sells on scarcity that is real and stated, not on fake timers; see [Limited Run Games](https://limitedrungames.com/en-eu/collections/all-in-production/products/30-a-playstation-retrospective-hardcover)
**Style variations:** Box Logo: red box, white bold type · Tour Tee: black bg, city list in white · Merch Table: kraft surface, marker-pen prices
**Refs:**
- [Khruangbin: Live at Sydney Opera House](https://khruangbin.bandcamp.com/album/khruangbin-live-at-sydney-opera-house): a real "N remaining" count on a limited edition
- [Limited Run Games: in-production item](https://limitedrungames.com/en-eu/collections/all-in-production/products/30-a-playstation-retrospective-hardcover): production status and batch ship windows for pre-orders
- [Heavenly Recordings: Merch](https://heavenly.bandcamp.com/merch): an independent label's merch page where sold-out items stay visible

### IX. Food & hospitality

<a id="083"></a>
#### 083 · Neighbourhood Restaurant (`table`)
**For:** independent neighbourhood restaurants, bistros and chop houses with a menu that changes often.
**Templates:** front-page · page-menus · page-bookings · page-private-room · page-vouchers · page-about (history, chef) · page-visit (kitchen hours, address)
**Patterns (~40):** menus page with dated PDF downloads (Food / Drinks / Wine list, "26th September"), menu dated on the web page too, kitchen hours by day (lunch and dinner separately), booking embed, private room with capacity and set menus, gift vouchers (monetary and experience), address, phone and email in the header or footer, mailing list, history paragraph (founded year, head chef), allergen note ("please tell us about allergies"), walk-in policy.
**Content model:** companion `menu` (type: food / drinks / wine, date, PDF, sections with dishes, dietary tags); kitchen hours as structured data (LocalBusiness / Restaurant schema).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce (vouchers) or an external voucher link, reservations embed, Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap.
**Signature:** a menus page where each menu carries its date and a PDF download, updated daily or weekly from one menu block (seen on: [Brawn: Menus](https://www.brawn.co/restaurant/menus/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Kitchen hours split into lunch and dinner by day (seen on: [The Quality Chop House: Menus](https://thequalitychophouse.com/menus))
- Private room page with capacity and set menus (seen on: [The Quality Chop House: The Private Room](https://thequalitychophouse.com/the-private))
- Gift vouchers by amount (seen on: [The Quality Chop House: Vouchers](https://thequalitychophouse.giftpro.co.uk/vouchers/monetary-voucher/))
- "Closed for summer 4–18 August" notice with start and end dates
- Printable A4 menu view generated from the menu block, with allergen key
**Real-world basis:** [Brawn: Menus](https://www.brawn.co/restaurant/menus/), [Brawn: Private hire](https://www.brawn.co/private-hire/), [The Quality Chop House: Menus](https://thequalitychophouse.com/menus), [The Quality Chop House: The Private Room](https://thequalitychophouse.com/the-private), [St. JOHN: Private events](https://stjohnrestaurant.com/pages/private-events)
**Style: Typewritten daily menu**
- Type: Headings: Gelasio 700; menu body: Cutive Mono 400/18px (the typed daily sheet); UI and hours: Gelasio 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF (butcher-paper white) / text #1A1A1A / accent #8C1C13 (claret) / surface #F2F0EC / line #1A1A1A
- Layout: the menu page is the home page's centre: today's menu set like a typed sheet (date at top, sections, prices right-aligned), 60ch wide; kitchen hours and booking beside it on desktop, below on mobile; no hero image carousel
- Imagery: dining room and plates in natural light at 3:2, one photo per section at most
- Motion: none
- Why it fits now: the best neighbourhood restaurants publish a dated menu and little else; see [Brawn](https://www.brawn.co/restaurant/menus/)
**Style variations:** Bistro: white, red claret, serif · Canteen: pale green surface, black mono · Izakaya: dark wood bg, cream type
**Refs:**
- [Brawn: Menus](https://www.brawn.co/restaurant/menus/): WordPress restaurant with dated Food, Drinks and Wine PDFs
- [The Quality Chop House: Menus](https://thequalitychophouse.com/menus): WordPress; kitchen hours by service, vouchers and private room linked from the menu page
- [St. JOHN: Private events](https://stjohnrestaurant.com/pages/private-events): private dining written plainly by a benchmark London restaurant

<a id="084"></a>
#### 084 · Café / Coffee Bar (`cup`)
**For:** independent cafés and small coffee groups with one to five locations.
**Templates:** front-page · page-locations · single-location (hours, menu, notes) · page-menu · page-catering · page-courses · page-gift-cards · page-jobs
**Patterns (~35):** location list with address and hours per shop, "card payments only" and dogs-welcome notes, weekly food menu dated per location ("Eastcastle Street menu, 21st September"), drinks menu with milk options and prices, suppliers named (bakery, dairy, oat), reusable cup scheme, booking rules for groups, catering to offices, coffee courses, gift cards, loyalty or rewards, jobs.
**Content model:** companion `location` (address, lat/lng, hours per day, payment, dogs, seating, booking policy) with a dated `menu` per location.
**Plugins:** Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap, Jetpack Forms (catering, jobs).
**Signature:** a location page per café with its own opening hours, payment and dog policy, and its own dated weekly menu (seen on: [Kaffeine: Eastcastle Street](https://kaffeine.co.uk/location/15-eastcastle-street/), [Monmouth: Our shops](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Card payments only" and closed-Sunday lines per shop (seen on: [Monmouth: Our shops](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops))
- Suppliers named: bakery, dairy, oat milk (seen on: [Monmouth: Our shops](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops))
- Group-booking and walk-in rules per site (seen on: [Ozone: Locations](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/locations))
- "Open now / closes at 5pm" line computed from each location's hours
- Bank holiday hours notice that switches on and off by date
**Real-world basis:** [Kaffeine: Eastcastle Street](https://kaffeine.co.uk/location/15-eastcastle-street/), [Monmouth: Our shops](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops), [Ozone: Locations](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/locations), [Prufrock: Menu](https://prufrockcoffee.com/menu), [Workshop Coffee: Belgravia](https://workshopcoffee.com/pages/belgravia)
**Style: Letterboard café signage**
- Type: Headings: League Gothic 400, uppercase; body: Rethink Sans 400/18px; hours and prices: DM Mono 400
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF / text #111111 / surface #151515 (letterboard, white type on it) / accent #D9A441 (brass, only on the dark board) / line #111111
- Layout: drinks menu set on a black letterboard panel with white condensed caps and prices; locations as a stacked list (name, address, hours table, notes) rather than cards; food menu dated at the top
- Imagery: counters, cups and pastries in each shop at 3:2; one exterior per location so people can find the door
- Motion: none
- Why it fits now: coffee groups keep sites small and useful: where, when, what's on today; see [Monmouth Coffee](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops)
**Style variations:** Nordic: white, pale wood surface, grey type · Diner: red and cream, chrome rules · Roastery: brown kraft, black letterboard
**Refs:**
- [Kaffeine: Eastcastle Street](https://kaffeine.co.uk/location/15-eastcastle-street/): one page per shop with hours and a dated weekly menu
- [Monmouth: Our shops](https://www.monmouthcoffee.co.uk/our-shops): WordPress; three shops, hours, "card payments only" and suppliers on one plain page
- [Ozone: Locations](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/locations): different kinds of site (eatery vs espresso bar) explained, with booking and dog policies

<a id="085"></a>
#### 085 · Supper Club / Pop-up Dinners (`supper`)
**For:** a chef or pair of home cooks running a monthly ticketed dinner in borrowed venues (a pub upstairs, a gallery, their own flat) for 12–60 guests.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-event (upcoming editions) · single-event (one dinner) · page-private-hire · page-about (the cook's story) · page-gift-vouchers (Woo) · page-press · page-faq
**Patterns (~35):** upcoming-editions list (date / venue / neighbourhood / "Buy tickets"), single-edition page (menu in courses, time 19:00–23:00, full venue address, drinks partner), "Registration is closed" state on past or full dinners, "What is a supper club?" explainer for first-timers, collaboration edition card (guest brand or chef), private hire enquiry form, "As seen in" press row with real publication names, newsletter sign-up for first access to tickets, gift voucher card, dietary requirements note.
**Content model:** companion `event` (date, start/end time, venue name, venue address, price per seat, capacity, status: on sale / sold out / closed, edition number, collaborator), menu as a bound course list.
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar + Event Tickets (paid tickets through WooCommerce), WooCommerce (gift vouchers), Jetpack Forms (private hire), Jetpack Newsletter.
**Signature:** every dinner is an "edition" with its own page: a named menu in four or more courses, the venue for that night, and a ticket button that flips to "Registration is closed" once seats go (seen on: [Khao Suppers](https://www.khaosuppers.com/event-details/chalo-jamva-september-edition-2)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Tickets released 6–8 weeks ahead" note plus a newsletter box for first access (seen on: [Kitchen Theory](https://www.kitchen-theory.com/supper-club-london/))
- Gift vouchers for a seat at a future dinner, redeemable against any edition (seen on: [Kitchen Theory](https://www.kitchen-theory.com/supper-club-gift-vouchers/))
- Dietary and allergy field on the ticket form, with a plain statement of what the kitchen can and cannot adapt
- "Getting there" block per venue: nearest station, step-free access yes/no, where to wait if you arrive early
- schema.org Event markup on each edition so dates show in search
**Style: Editorial serif revival (menu card)**
- Type: Headings: Kalnia 400 at clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 8rem), tracking 0; body: Newsreader 400/18px, line-height 1.55; labels (course numbers, prices, times): Martian Mono 400 at 14px, sentence case.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF (tablecloth), text #1B1B1B, accent #7A1F2B (claret, links and the ticket button), surface #EEECE8 (menu card), line #1B1B1B.
- Layout: a single 64ch reading column for the menu, set like a printed card, with course names on the left and one-line descriptions hanging right; the upcoming-editions list is a table (date / venue / price / button), 1px rules, 0 radius on cards and 2px on buttons. Header is the club's name only, with the nav in the footer.
- Imagery: available-light photos of the actual table mid-service, 4:5 crops, no retouching; one full-bleed image per edition.
- Motion: none on scroll. The ticket button changes fill on hover (100ms), View Transitions between the editions list and a single edition; reduced motion disables the transition.
- Why it fits now: independent food and design print has moved back to plain serif menus and documentary photography over glossy food shots, as on [Apartamento](https://www.apartamentomagazine.com).
**Style variations:** Candle: #1B1B1B bg, #F2EFE8 text · Linen: #EEECE8 bg, claret links · Market: white bg, #2F5D3A green accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Khao Suppers: supper clubs](https://www.khaosuppers.com/book-supper-clubs), [Khao Suppers: one edition](https://www.khaosuppers.com/event-details/chalo-jamva-september-edition-2), [Kitchen Theory: supper club](https://www.kitchen-theory.com/supper-club-london/), [Eatwith: London supper clubs](https://www.eatwith.com/l/destinations/london/dinners)
**Refs:**
- [Khao Suppers: September edition](https://www.khaosuppers.com/event-details/chalo-jamva-september-edition-2): an edition page that tells you the region of the food, the venue, the time and the course count before asking for money.
- [Kitchen Theory: supper club](https://www.kitchen-theory.com/supper-club-london/): states the price per seat, how far ahead tickets go on sale, and links straight to booking.
- [Kitchen Theory: gift vouchers](https://www.kitchen-theory.com/supper-club-gift-vouchers/): a separate voucher page for a product that sells out.

<a id="086"></a>
#### 086 · Food Truck (`truck`)
**For:** a one- or two-truck operator who trades at fixed weekly pitches and makes most of the money from private catering bookings.
**Templates:** front-page (this week's schedule) · page-menu · page-catering · page-book-the-truck · page-about · page-press · page-contact
**Patterns (~35):** "This week" schedule block (day / neighbourhood / street address / hours), book-the-truck form (event date, number of guests, event address, budget), catering occasions list (weddings, corporate, birthdays, film shoots), menu board with prices, vegetarian and gluten-free guide, catering menu packages, "where we've been" events gallery, press quotes, truck spec (length, power needs, service window side).
**Content model:** companion `stop` (date, start/end time, place name, address, lat/long, note such as "21+ venue"), menu items as posts with price and dietary tags.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms, Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap, Advanced Query Loop (show only this week's and future stops).
**Signature:** a weekly schedule on the home page: date range heading, then each day's stops with address and serving hours, auto-hiding past days (seen on: [Kogi BBQ](https://kogibbq.com/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Book-the-truck form with the fields caterers actually ask for: event date, guest count, address, city and phone (seen on: [Taco Bus](https://taco-bus.com/taco-bus-food-truck/))
- Separate catering menu page with per-head packages (seen on: [Rasta Taco](https://rastataco.com/catering-menu))
- A dietary guide written as a post, for vegetarians and gluten-free eaters (seen on: [Taco Bus](https://taco-bus.com/vegetarians-guide-to-taco-bus/))
- "Weather call" notice bar: the owner flips "Cancelled today: rain" from a phone and it expires at midnight
- Truck spec card for event planners: footprint, generator or hook-up, minimum guest count
**Style: Street signwriting**
- Type: Headings: Sigmar 400 at clamp(3rem, 10vw, 9rem) (a typeface built for signage); body: Figtree 400/18px; times and prices: Chivo Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFD400 (truck yellow), text #111111, accent #E63B2E (sauce red, buttons), surface #FFFFFF (schedule cards), line #111111.
- Layout: the schedule is the hero: a full-width yellow block with one row per day, day name set huge on the left and the address on the right. Hard 3px black borders, 0 radius on blocks, 999px only on the "Book the truck" button. Sticky bottom bar on mobile with "Today: [place]" and a map link.
- Imagery: flash photos of food in hands at night and the truck in its real spot, square crops, high contrast, no plated studio shots.
- Motion: none on scroll. Today's row is highlighted by date, not animated; map pins open on tap. Reduced motion changes nothing because nothing moves.
- Why it fits now: street-food brands lean on signwriter lettering and hard flat colour instead of polished restaurant templates, as on [Kogi BBQ](https://kogibbq.com/).
**Style variations:** Night market: #111111 bg, yellow type · Chalk: #2B2B2B bg, white Sigmar · Paper bag: #D9C3A0 bg, red accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Kogi BBQ: schedule and booking](https://kogibbq.com/), [Kogi BBQ: catering](https://kogibbq.com/catering/), [Taco Bus: hire the bus](https://taco-bus.com/taco-bus-food-truck/), [Rasta Taco: our truck](https://rastataco.com/our-truck), [Rasta Taco: get a quote](https://rastataco.com/get-a-quote)
**Refs:**
- [Kogi BBQ: home schedule](https://kogibbq.com/): the week's stops as plain text with addresses and hours, right under a "book Kogi for your event" pitch.
- [Taco Bus: food truck hire](https://taco-bus.com/taco-bus-food-truck/): a short pitch followed by a booking form that captures date, headcount and address.
- [Rasta Taco: catering menu](https://rastataco.com/catering-menu): a catering menu kept separate from the street menu.

#### 087 · Cocktail / Natural Wine Bar (`pour`)
**For:** a small bar with a changing by-the-glass list, meet-the-winemaker nights and a few seats for walk-ins.
**Templates:** front-page · page-wine (current list) · page-food · page-reservations · page-events · single-event · page-private-parties · page-gift-vouchers (Woo) · page-shop
**Patterns (~40):** wine list by the glass and bottle (producer / region / grape / skin contact or not / price), "list updated" date and downloadable PDF, food menu, reservations embed (Resy, OpenTable or similar), walk-ins note, "Meet the winemaker" event card, private parties enquiry, gift vouchers, bar hours vs kitchen hours, age statement, small shop (books, merch, tinned fish).
**Content model:** companion `wine` (producer, region, grape, style: orange / red / white / pét-nat / rosé, glass price, bottle price, on list yes/no), `event`.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce (vouchers and shop), The Events Calendar, Age Gate (only where local rules want it), Jetpack Forms.
**Signature:** a dated wine list: the current by-the-glass and bottle list rendered from `wine` posts, with the date it was last changed and a PDF of the printed version beside it (seen on: [The Ten Bells](https://tenbellsnyc.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Wine-List-12-19-25.pdf)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Separate bar hours and kitchen hours on each location page (seen on: [Noble Rot Lambs Conduit](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/restaurant/lambs-conduit))
- Gift vouchers redeemable across sites (seen on: [Noble Rot Lambs Conduit](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/restaurant/lambs-conduit))
- Private party enquiry page with capacity and minimum spend (seen on: [The Ten Bells](https://tenbellsnyc.com/private-parties-at-the-ten-bells/))
- "Open now / closed today" line in the header driven by the opening hours
- Bilingual toggle for tourist-heavy bars (seen on: [Bar Brutal](https://www.barbrutal.com))
**Style: Natural-wine label illustration**
- Type: Headings: Basteleur Bold (Velvetyne) at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Literata 400/18px; list columns (region, price): Overpass Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #F4F2EC (paper), text #1F1F1F, accent #D6336C (pink, the only link colour), surface #FFE800 (event cards), line #1F1F1F.
- Layout: the wine list is a long typeset page with sections by style and hanging prices; each style section opens with a single hand-drawn illustration in the manner of a natural-wine label. Buttons 0 radius, images 0 radius, event cards 6px.
- Imagery: commissioned line drawings or riso-printed illustrations, plus grainy photos of the bar at night; no bottle-shot packshots.
- Motion: none on scroll. Illustrations swap on hover in the style index (instant, no easing); reduced motion keeps the first frame.
- Why it fits now: natural wine is sold through illustrated labels and magazine-style voice rather than luxury-bar gloss, as on [Noble Rot's magazine](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/shop/magazine).
**Style variations:** Skin contact: #E9A15B bg, black type · Cellar: #1F1F1F bg, pink accent · Pét-nat: #FFE800 bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [The Ten Bells: wine events](https://tenbellsnyc.com/wine-events/), [The Ten Bells: private parties](https://tenbellsnyc.com/private-parties-at-the-ten-bells/), [Noble Rot: Lambs Conduit](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/restaurant/lambs-conduit), [Noble Rot: private dining](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/private-dining), [Bar Brutal](https://www.barbrutal.com)
**Refs:**
- [The Ten Bells: wine list PDF](https://tenbellsnyc.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Wine-List-12-19-25.pdf): a date in the file name, updated with the list, is the simplest honest "last changed" signal.
- [Noble Rot: Lambs Conduit](https://www.noblerot.co.uk/restaurant/lambs-conduit): one location page holds the food menu, wine list, events, vouchers and separate bar hours.
- [Bar Brutal](https://www.barbrutal.com): a bar site that doubles as a shop for tins and a cookbook, in two languages.

#### 088 · Craft Brewery Taproom (`taproom`)
**For:** a small brewery whose taproom opens Wednesday to Sunday, with a changing draught list, cans to go and a kitchen residency.
**Templates:** front-page · page-taproom (on tap now) · archive-beer · single-beer · page-events · page-book-a-table · page-shop (Woo) · page-beer-club · page-trade
**Patterns (~40):** "Beers currently on tap" list (name / hops / style / ABV), draught menu "updated" date, opening hours with bank-holiday hours, bookings rule ("4 or more, form below"), kitchen residency card, events list (tastings, quiz, launches), core range grid, beer club subscription, cans to go and click-and-collect, age check, trade enquiry.
**Content model:** companion `beer` (style, ABV, hops, format: cask / keg / can, on tap yes/no, batch date), `event`.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce + Subscriptions for WooCommerce (beer club), Age Gate, The Events Calendar, Jetpack Forms.
**Signature:** a live tap list: staff tick "on tap" on each beer from a phone, and the taproom page shows the list with ABV and a "Draught menu updated [date]" line (seen on: [The Kernel Brewery](https://www.thekernelbrewery.com/tap.php)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Booking rules spelled out: groups of 4+ by form, Saturdays only for 20–30 people (seen on: [The Kernel Brewery](https://www.thekernelbrewery.com/tap.php))
- Beer club subscription with a monthly mixed box (seen on: [Cloudwater](https://cloudwaterbrew.co/collections/cloudwater-beer-club))
- Location page with daily hours, number of draft lines and "order for pickup" (seen on: [Other Half: Centre Street](https://otherhalfbrewing.com/location/centre-street/))
- Printable A4 tap list for the bar wall, generated from the same data
- Allergen line per beer (contains gluten, lactose, vegan yes/no)
**Style: Utility label system**
- Type: Headings: Economica 700 at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 8rem), uppercase for beer names only; body: Public Sans 400/18px; tap list: Courier Prime 400/18px.
- Palette: bg #D9C3A0 (brown paper), text #1A1A1A, accent #C4281C (stamp red, prices and the updated date), surface #FFFFFF (label), line #1A1A1A.
- Layout: the tap list is set like a printed stock sheet: one beer per line, style and ABV in columns, no cards. Each beer page looks like the brewery's plain paper label. 0 radius everywhere except the age-check dialog (4px).
- Imagery: plain photos of cans and the room on overcast days, no bokeh pint shots; label artwork shown flat.
- Motion: none. The "updated" date is static text. Reduced motion is the default state.
- Why it fits now: the strongest small-brewery sites are the plainest ones, with typed lists and paper labels, as on [The Kernel Brewery](https://www.thekernelbrewery.com/tap.php).
**Style variations:** Cask: #F5F1E8 bg, red stamps · Stout: #1A1A1A bg, paper text · Hop: #DDE8C3 bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [The Kernel: tap room](https://www.thekernelbrewery.com/tap.php), [Cloudwater: events](https://cloudwaterbrew.co/blogs/events-at-cloudwater-tastings-parties-pub-games), [Cloudwater: beer club](https://cloudwaterbrew.co/collections/cloudwater-beer-club), [Other Half: Centre Street](https://otherhalfbrewing.com/location/centre-street/), [Other Half: our beers](https://otherhalfbrewing.com/our-beers/)
**Refs:**
- [The Kernel Brewery: tap room](https://www.thekernelbrewery.com/tap.php): hours, booking rules, kitchen residency and a dated tap list with ABV on one page.
- [Other Half: Centre Street](https://otherhalfbrewing.com/location/centre-street/): a location page with directions from the subway, daily hours and what is served.
- [Cloudwater: beer club](https://cloudwaterbrew.co/collections/cloudwater-beer-club): how a brewery sells a recurring mixed box.

<a id="089"></a>
#### 089 · Micro-Distillery (`still`)
**For:** a small gin, whiskey or brandy distillery with a tasting room, paid tours and bottles sold on site.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-spirit · single-spirit · page-visit · page-tours · page-private-barrel · page-events · page-cocktails (recipes) · page-stockists · page-shop (Woo)
**Patterns (~40):** spirit card (category / botanicals or mash bill / ABV / bottle size / price), tasting room hours, tour booking (price per person, group limit, "book 24 hours ahead"), private barrel experience, cocktail recipe card, "where to buy" locator, the makers (distiller profiles), batch or lot release notice, age check with date of birth, trade support.
**Content model:** companion `spirit` (category, ABV, botanicals, cask, lot number, release date), `recipe` (spirit used, method), `stockist` (name, address, lat/long).
**Plugins:** WooCommerce, Age Gate, Cal.com embed (tours), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (stockists), Query Filter (spirits by category).
**Signature:** a tour booking page that states the price, the group limit and the booking cut-off, with the calendar embedded below and full slots removed (seen on: [Two James](https://twojames.com/tours/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Release notice bar: "Lot 26 of the single malt is now available at the distillery" with an end date (seen on: [St. George Spirits](https://stgeorgespirits.com/visit))
- Spirit locator by address for bottles in shops and bars (seen on: [St. George Spirits](https://stgeorgespirits.com/spirit-locator))
- Maker profile pages for the distillers (seen on: [St. George Spirits](https://stgeorgespirits.com/people/lance))
- Private barrel programme page for groups and companies (seen on: [Two James](https://twojames.com/private-barrel-experience/))
- Designated-driver note and a non-alcoholic option on tour listings
**Style: American apothecary label**
- Type: Headings: Holtwood One SC 400 at clamp(4rem, 12vw, 10rem), uppercase; body: Lora 400/18px; lot numbers and ABV: IBM Plex Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FAFAF7 (label stock), text #151515, accent #1E3B2F (bottle green), surface #A88A3D (brass, small rules and seals only), line #151515.
- Layout: each spirit page is a label: a tall condensed name, then a ruled box with ABV, botanicals and lot number. The spirits archive is a shelf of bottles in a strict row, category filter above. Cards 0 radius, the age-check dialog 2px, buttons 0.
- Imagery: bottles shot straight-on against a plain wall; the still room photographed as working machinery.
- Motion: none on scroll. The age gate appears once and is remembered; hover on a bottle shows its lot number (no zoom). Reduced motion unchanged.
- Why it fits now: craft spirits sell provenance, and condensed gothic plus a book serif reads as a label rather than a luxury brand, as on [St. George Spirits](https://stgeorgespirits.com/spirits/gin).
**Style variations:** Barrel: #3B2A1E bg, brass rules · Botanical: #E7EFE6 bg, green type · Proof: #151515 bg, label-white text.
**Real-world basis:** [Two James: tours](https://twojames.com/tours/), [Two James: private barrel](https://twojames.com/private-barrel-experience/), [St. George: visit](https://stgeorgespirits.com/visit), [St. George: spirit locator](https://stgeorgespirits.com/spirit-locator), [Cotswolds Distillery](https://www.cotswoldsdistillery.com)
**Refs:**
- [Two James: tours](https://twojames.com/tours/): $35, 20 people, book 24 hours ahead; everything a visitor needs above the booking button.
- [St. George Spirits: visit](https://stgeorgespirits.com/visit): tasting room hours, walk-in policy and reservation link in one short page.
- [St. George Spirits: gin](https://stgeorgespirits.com/spirits/gin): a category page that sets the label-like type system.

<a id="090"></a>
#### 090 · Cooking School (`whisk`)
**For:** an independent cookery school with one teaching kitchen running adult classes, kids' terms, parties and corporate team days.
**Templates:** front-page · page-calendar · archive-class · single-class · page-children · page-parties (hen / stag / birthday) · page-corporate · page-kitchen-hire · page-gift-vouchers (Woo) · archive-recipe
**Patterns (~45):** month calendar with class name, start time and price per day, "Not available" for private bookings, class page (cuisine / what you'll cook / duration / price / places left), children and teens terms (6-week blocks), party packages, corporate team building, kitchen hire, gift vouchers, recipes from past classes, teacher profiles, FAQ (what to wear, allergies, can I bring wine).
**Content model:** companion `event` used as class (cuisine, audience: adults / children / teens, start, duration, price, capacity, places left), `recipe`, `person` (teacher).
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar + Event Tickets (Woo tickets), WooCommerce (vouchers), Query Filter (by audience, cuisine, price).
**Signature:** a class calendar with price per class in each cell and private bookings shown as "Not available", plus a filterable list view of the same classes (seen on: [Cooking It](https://cookingit.co.uk/calendar)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Gift vouchers for any class, with a printable card (seen on: [Cooking It](https://cookingit.co.uk/gift-vouchers))
- Teacher pages per cuisine, written in the teacher's voice (seen on: [The League of Kitchens](https://www.leagueofkitchens.com/instructors/lebanese-cooking-with-jeanette))
- Skill-based masterclass pages (knife skills, pastry) alongside cuisine classes (seen on: [Leiths](https://leiths.com/culinary-masterclasses/culinary-masterclass-knife-skills/))
- "Places left" counter from ticket stock, switching to "Join waitlist" at zero
- "What to bring / what to wear" block with allergy and step-free access information
**Style: Test-kitchen index card**
- Type: Headings: Gabarito 800 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Source Serif 4 400/18px; times, weights and prices: JetBrains Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #202020, accent #C8341B (tomato, used for "Book" and places-left), surface #FFE7A3 (butter, recipe cards), line #B8D4E8 (index-card blue rule).
- Layout: the calendar is a real month grid with thin blue rules; class pages are laid out like a recipe card: ingredients-style list of what you'll cook on the left, practical info on the right. Cards 4px radius, buttons 0, photos 0.
- Imagery: overhead shots of students' hands at the bench, taken during class; no chef-in-whites stock.
- Motion: calendar month changes use a View Transition slide; hover on a class shows places left. Reduced motion swaps to an instant change.
- Why it fits now: recipe sites that people actually cook from use clear cards, measurements in mono and real kitchen photos, as on [NYT Cooking](https://cooking.nytimes.com).
**Style variations:** Pastry: #FFE7A3 bg, brown type · Night class: #202020 bg, butter accent · Kids: #B8D4E8 bg, tomato accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Cooking It: calendar](https://cookingit.co.uk/calendar), [Cooking It: vouchers](https://cookingit.co.uk/gift-vouchers), [The League of Kitchens: how it works](https://www.leagueofkitchens.com/how-it-works), [The League of Kitchens: instructor](https://www.leagueofkitchens.com/instructors/lebanese-cooking-with-jeanette), [Leiths: knife skills masterclass](https://leiths.com/culinary-masterclasses/culinary-masterclass-knife-skills/)
**Refs:**
- [Cooking It: class calendar](https://cookingit.co.uk/calendar): price in the grid, private bookings shown honestly, and a pointer to a filterable list.
- [The League of Kitchens: Lebanese with Jeanette](https://www.leagueofkitchens.com/instructors/lebanese-cooking-with-jeanette): a class sold through the person teaching it.

#### 091 · Guesthouse / B&B (`stay`)
**For:** owners of a 2–6 room B&B in a period house who want direct bookings instead of paying platform commission.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-room · single-room · page-breakfast · page-house-and-garden · page-location · page-local-area · page-qa · page-reviews · page-access-statement
**Patterns (~40):** room page (bed size / en-suite type / view / what's in the room / price per night / single occupancy price), minimum stay rule, breakfast page (hours, local suppliers named, vegetarian and vegan options), house and garden gallery, directions and parking, local area guide (walks, beaches, gardens), recommended restaurants list, Q&A, guest reviews, access statement, direct booking widget.
**Content model:** MotoPress accommodation types for rooms; companion `place` (name, type: restaurant / walk / beach, distance, note) for the local guide.
**Plugins:** MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite, Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap.
**Signature:** one page per room with a plain inventory of what's in it and two prices (double and single occupancy), next to a direct booking calendar (seen on: [Ivy House Cornwall](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/rooms-rates/bedroom-one/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Minimum-stay rule with an exception note ("single nights Sun–Thu for a £20 supplement") (seen on: [Coswarth House](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/rooms.html))
- Breakfast page naming the local butcher, dairy and eggs, with serving times (seen on: [Ivy House Cornwall](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/breakfast/))
- Access statement page (steps, bathroom layout, parking distance) (seen on: [Coswarth House](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/access-statement.html))
- The owners' own restaurant recommendations (seen on: [Coswarth House](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/restaurants.html))
- "Book direct and save" note that explains the platform commission in one sentence
**Style: Quiet editorial**
- Type: Headings: Ovo 400 at clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6.5rem); body: Hanken Grotesk 400/18px; room facts: Hanken Grotesk 600 small caps.
- Palette: bg #EEEBE4 (limewash), text #2A2926, accent #4F7A70 (sea-glass green, links and booking), surface #FFFFFF (booking panel), line #CFCAC0.
- Layout: magazine spread per room: one large photo, then a two-column block with the description left and a facts list right. Rooms archive as a short vertical list, not a grid. Images 0 radius, booking panel 2px, buttons 0.
- Imagery: rooms photographed in morning light with the window visible, 3:2; breakfast shot on the actual table; no drone shots.
- Motion: View Transitions from room list to room page (the photo carries over). Nothing on scroll. Reduced motion: instant navigation.
- Why it fits now: small hospitality has moved toward slow, magazine-like pages with generous space and real light, as on [Kinfolk](https://www.kinfolk.com).
**Style variations:** Coast: #E6EEF0 bg, navy text · Farmhouse: #F3EFE6 bg, moss accent · Townhouse: #2A2926 bg, limewash text.
**Real-world basis:** [Ivy House: bedroom one](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/rooms-rates/bedroom-one/), [Ivy House: breakfast](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/breakfast/), [Ivy House: Q&A](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/qa/), [Coswarth House: rooms](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/rooms.html), [Coswarth House: access statement](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/access-statement.html)
**Refs:**
- [Ivy House Cornwall: bedroom one](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/rooms-rates/bedroom-one/): an honest room inventory and two prices, nothing more.
- [Coswarth House: rooms](https://www.coswarthhouse.com/rooms.html): minimum stay, supplement and "all rooms include" in one block.
- [Ivy House Cornwall: breakfast](https://ivyhousecornwall.co.uk/breakfast/): suppliers named by type and place, serving times, dietary options.

#### 092 · Cabin / Glamping Rental (`cabin`)
**For:** a family or small operator with 2–10 cabins, domes or shepherd's huts on their own land, often with shared dining, sauna or events.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-cabin · single-cabin · page-dining · page-spa · archive-event (feasts, retreats) · page-getting-here · page-faq · page-gift-vouchers (Woo)
**Patterns (~40):** cabin page with a "Basics" block (location on the site / sleeps / bedrooms / dogs / hot tub / wood burner), guest quote, cluster map of the site, shared facilities (sauna, fire pit, communal kitchen), dining nights, special events and holiday weeks (half-term, winter feast), "getting here" with last-mile directions, what to bring, check-in and check-out times, gift vouchers.
**Content model:** MotoPress accommodation types for cabins with companion meta (sleeps, bedrooms, dogs allowed, hot tub, off-grid yes/no); companion `event` for feasts and retreats.
**Plugins:** MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite, The Events Calendar, WooCommerce (vouchers), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap.
**Signature:** a "Basics" block at the top of every cabin page: where it sits on the site, how many it sleeps, bedroom split and a guest quote, bound from meta so it stays consistent across all cabins (seen on: [fforest: coast cabins](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/cabins)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Special events list tied to dates (half-term weeks, feasts with guest chefs) (seen on: [fforest: special events](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/special-events))
- Filter cabins by what people search for: hot tub, dogs, sauna (seen on: [Kip Hideaways: outdoor baths and hot tubs](https://www.kiphideaways.com/collections/outdoor-baths-hot-tubs/))
- "Last 2 miles" photo directions for places the satnav gets wrong
- "What to bring" checklist (torch, wellies, food for the first night) as a printable PDF
- Off-grid notice: no Wi-Fi, patchy signal, where the nearest shop is
**Style: Warm Scandi minimal**
- Type: Headings: Kumbh Sans 700 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Crimson Pro 400/19px; basics labels: Red Hat Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #F4F1EC (birch), text #1E1E1C, accent #20352B (pine, buttons and links), surface #DCE1DD (fog, basics block), line #1E1E1C; one warm highlight #D6892B for event dates only.
- Layout: long single column with full-bleed landscape photos between short text blocks; the basics block is a two-column spec list with hairlines. Cabin archive as a list with one wide photo each. Images 0 radius, buttons 3px, basics block 0.
- Imagery: wide landscape crops (21:9) of the cabin in its setting, dusk interiors with the stove lit, no people posing.
- Motion: View Transitions between cabins; photos do not zoom or parallax. Reduced motion disables the transition.
- Why it fits now: independent outdoor stays sell quiet, place-led stories rather than hotel-booking layouts, as on [fforest](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/cabins).
**Style variations:** Winter: #20352B bg, birch text · Moor: #E3E0D6 bg, peat-brown accent · Coast: #E6EEF0 bg, pine accent.
**Real-world basis:** [fforest: cabins](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/cabins), [fforest: special events](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/special-events), [Kip Hideaways: Frith Cabin](https://www.kiphideaways.com/hideaways/frith-cabin/), [Kip Hideaways: hot tubs](https://www.kiphideaways.com/collections/outdoor-baths-hot-tubs/), [Canopy & Stars: cabins](https://www.canopyandstars.co.uk/glamping/cabins/)
**Refs:**
- [fforest: cabins](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/cabins): the "Basics" format and guest quote at the top of the page.
- [fforest: special events](https://www.coldatnight.co.uk/special-events): holiday weeks and feasts sold as dated events next to the accommodation.
- [Kip Hideaways: outdoor baths and hot tubs](https://www.kiphideaways.com/collections/outdoor-baths-hot-tubs/): the filters guests actually use.

#### 093 · Independent Hostel (`bunk`)
**For:** an owner-run hostel or bunkhouse (15–60 beds) for walkers, cyclists and backpackers, taking individual and whole-hostel group bookings.
**Templates:** front-page · page-rooms · page-tariff-and-terms · page-group-bookings · page-facilities (kitchen, laundry, drying room) · page-local-area · page-faq · page-reviews · page-find-us
**Patterns (~35):** rooms list (dorm size 2–12 beds, private rooms, accessible en-suite dorm), "price includes" list (linen, kitchen use, hot showers, drying room), tariff table, group booking rules (deposit, balance due 30 days before), whole-hostel hire card (sleeps 18, dining room), facilities (coin laundry, bike shed, parking), local walks and routes, FAQ ("can I self-cater?", "can I camp?"), reviews, find us.
**Content model:** MotoPress accommodation types for dorms and private rooms; companion `route` (name, distance, ascent, start point) for walks and rides.
**Plugins:** MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite, Jetpack Forms (group enquiries), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap.
**Signature:** a tariff-and-terms page that lists exactly what the bed price includes and the group booking deposit rules, in plain language, next to the booking search (seen on: [Portree Independent Hostel](https://www.hostelskye.co.uk/tariff-and-terms.html)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Whole-hostel group booking page with capacity, room count and example groups (seen on: [Moffat Independent Hostel](https://www.moffathostel.com/group-bookings/))
- Facilities list with drying room, bike shed and free parking (seen on: [Inveraray Hostel](https://www.inverarayhostel.co.uk/accommodation/))
- Laundry page with how it works and cost (seen on: [Portree Independent Hostel](https://www.hostelskye.co.uk/laundry.html))
- "Beds left tonight" line from availability, for walk-ins deciding at the bus stop
- House rules in plain language plus a translated summary in two or three languages
**Style: Soft neo-brutalism (hard shadows, pastel fills)**
- Type: Headings: Paytone One 400 at clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/18px (readable for tired, non-native readers); tariff table: Atkinson Hyperlegible 700 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #FFD84D (sun, primary buttons), surface #B8F2D0 (mint, room cards), second surface #9AD1FF (sky, facilities), line #111111.
- Layout: chunky blocks with 2px black borders and 4px offset hard shadows (no blur); room cards 8px radius, buttons 4px, photos 0. Home page leads with price-from and "Book a bed", then the facts that matter: kitchen, drying room, location.
- Imagery: phone-quality photos of the real kitchen, dorms and view, square crops; hand-drawn route maps.
- Motion: buttons press down 2px on click (shadow shrinks), 80ms; no scroll animation. Reduced motion removes the press offset.
- Why it fits now: friendly, chunky interfaces with hard shadows read as honest and low-cost without looking cheap, as on [Gumroad](https://gumroad.com).
**Style variations:** Bothy: #E6E1D8 bg, black shadows · Night bus: #111111 bg, sun accent · Coast: #9AD1FF bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Portree Hostel: our rooms](https://www.hostelskye.co.uk/our-rooms.html), [Portree Hostel: tariff and terms](https://www.hostelskye.co.uk/tariff-and-terms.html), [Moffat Hostel: group bookings](https://www.moffathostel.com/group-bookings/), [Inveraray Hostel: accommodation](https://www.inverarayhostel.co.uk/accommodation/), [Inveraray Hostel: our ethos](https://www.inverarayhostel.co.uk/our-ethos/)
**Refs:**
- [Portree Independent Hostel: tariff and terms](https://www.hostelskye.co.uk/tariff-and-terms.html): what the price includes, and group deposit rules.
- [Moffat Independent Hostel: group bookings](https://www.moffathostel.com/group-bookings/): selling the whole building to clubs and retreats.
- [Inveraray Hostel: accommodation](https://www.inverarayhostel.co.uk/accommodation/): facilities and FAQ answers on the same page as booking.

#### 094 · Small Campsite (`pitch`)
**For:** a farm or woodland campsite with named fields, fire pits and a handful of bell tents or yurts, run by the family who lives there.
**Templates:** front-page · page-camping-areas · single-field · page-glamping · page-campsite-map · page-facilities · page-calendar · page-food-vans · page-camp-fires · page-faq · page-directions
**Patterns (~45):** camping areas (each field with character: "quiet family field", "near the barn"), campsite map, pitch types (grass pitch, fire pit pitch, bell tent), glamping units (yurt, shepherd's hut, wagon), camping calendar (open weekends, events), food vans by day, camp fire rules and firewood sales, facilities (toilets and showers, shop, wifi, recycling), "before you book" honesty note, wildlife and livestock notes, directions.
**Content model:** MotoPress accommodation types for pitches and glamping units; companion `area` (field name, character, fire pits, car access, dogs), `event`.
**Plugins:** MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite, The Events Calendar, Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap.
**Signature:** named camping areas, each with its own description, rules and photo, so families can pick the quiet field and groups the one by the barn (seen on: [Wowo: camping areas](https://wowo.co.uk/camping-areas/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Before you book" note that says who the site is not for (seen on: [Wonderful Wilderness](https://www.wonderfulwilderness.com/pitches))
- Food vans schedule by day (seen on: [Wowo: food vans](https://wowo.co.uk/food-vans/))
- Camp fire rules and firewood prices on one page (seen on: [Wowo: camp fires](https://wowo.co.uk/camp-fires/))
- Wild camping FAQ covering livestock, dark skies and wildlife (seen on: [Wonderful Wilderness: FAQs](https://www.wonderfulwilderness.com/wildcampingfaqs))
- What3words or grid reference for the gate, printable arrival sheet
**Style: Ordnance Survey map legend**
- Type: Headings: Rajdhani 700 at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 8rem); body: Public Sans 400/18px; grid references and pitch numbers: Martian Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1C1C1C, accent #D9832E (contour orange, links and pitch numbers), surface #E4F0D8 (woodland tint), second #2E86C1 (water blue, streams and showers only), line #1C1C1C.
- Layout: the site map is the home page's centrepiece: an illustrated plan in OS-map style with numbered fields, and a key down the side that doubles as navigation. Field pages follow a map-sheet layout: title panel, scale bar, notes. Cards 0 radius, buttons 2px, the map key 0.
- Imagery: honest photos of each field at different times of day, tents included; symbol set drawn in the style of map legends (tap, fire, toilet, shop).
- Motion: hovering a field in the key highlights it on the map (fill change, no animation); View Transitions from map to field page. Reduced motion: instant.
- Why it fits now: map-legend graphics are a strong, practical language for outdoor brands, and the source is well known to UK campers, as on [Ordnance Survey](https://www.ordnancesurvey.co.uk).
**Style variations:** Moorland: #EDE5CF bg, brown contours · Night sky: #0F1A2B bg, orange accent · Meadow: #E4F0D8 bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Wowo: camping areas](https://wowo.co.uk/camping-areas/), [Wowo: calendar](https://wowo.co.uk/calendar/), [Wowo: camp fires](https://wowo.co.uk/camp-fires/), [Wonderful Wilderness: pitches](https://www.wonderfulwilderness.com/pitches), [Wonderful Wilderness: FAQs](https://www.wonderfulwilderness.com/wildcampingfaqs)
**Refs:**
- [Wowo: camping areas](https://wowo.co.uk/camping-areas/): fields described by their feel and who they suit.
- [Wonderful Wilderness: pitches](https://www.wonderfulwilderness.com/pitches): an honest "this may not be for you" note before booking.
- [Wowo: food vans](https://wowo.co.uk/food-vans/): which van is on which day, so campers can plan meals.

#### 095 · Catering Company (`platter`)
**For:** an independent event caterer (5–30 staff) doing weddings, private dinners, office lunches and film-crew catering.
**Templates:** front-page · page-events (private / corporate / weddings / crew) · archive-case-study · single-case-study · page-menus · page-venues · page-sustainability · page-suppliers · page-order-online (Woo) · page-enquire
**Patterns (~45):** event type sections with what's included (food, drink, staffing, styling), case study (venue / guest count / format / menu excerpt / photos), sample menus by season, canapé list, venues we work at, suppliers named with location, sustainability commitments, brochure PDF, office lunch order online (boxed meals, platters), enquiry brief form (date, guests, venue, budget, dietary needs), team.
**Content model:** companion `case_study` (venue, guests, event type, season), `venue` (name, area, capacity), `supplier` (name, what they supply, distance); Woo products for delivered lunches.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce + Order Delivery Date (Lite) (office lunches), Jetpack Forms (event brief with file upload for floor plans), Query Filter (case studies by event type).
**Signature:** case studies written as event records: the venue, guest count and format, followed by what was served, filterable by event type (seen on: [Social Pantry](https://socialpantry.co.uk/case-studies/lucia-davids-stylish-wallace-collection-wedding/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Seasonal menu preview with its own date window ("available 1 October–31 January") (seen on: [Eden Caterers](https://www.edencaterers.london))
- Downloadable brochure for planners and venues (seen on: [Caiger & Co](https://www.caigerandcocatering.co.uk/2024-brochure))
- Suppliers page naming the farms, bakers and fishmongers (seen on: [Social Pantry](https://socialpantry.co.uk/about-us/suppliers/))
- Ordering cut-off note for delivered lunches ("order by 2pm for next-day delivery")
- Allergen matrix per menu as a printable PDF, and dietary counts in the enquiry form
**Style: Austere kitchen white**
- Type: Headings: Frank Ruhl Libre 500 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Karla 400/18px; menu prices and guest counts: Karla 600 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #5B6B2E (olive, links and "Start your brief"), surface #EDEDED (menu cards), line #111111.
- Layout: menus set centred in the old printed way, but the site grid is asymmetric: a narrow left column of event types and a wide right column of case-study photos. No cards on the home page, just type and pictures. Menu cards 0 radius, buttons 0, form fields 2px.
- Imagery: food on the pass and in service at real venues, tight crops, daylight; staff shown working, not posing.
- Motion: none on scroll; case-study filter updates the list with a View Transition. Reduced motion: instant swap.
- Why it fits now: the most respected British food brands use white space, black type and no decoration, as on [St. JOHN](https://stjohnrestaurant.com).
**Style variations:** Marquee: #F2F2EF bg, olive accent · Service: #111111 bg, white type · Garden: #E8EDE0 bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Social Pantry: Wallace Collection wedding](https://socialpantry.co.uk/case-studies/lucia-davids-stylish-wallace-collection-wedding/), [Social Pantry: suppliers](https://socialpantry.co.uk/about-us/suppliers/), [Caiger & Co: events](https://www.caigerandcocatering.co.uk/our-events), [Caiger & Co: wedding pop-up](https://www.caigerandcocatering.co.uk/wedding-popup), [Eden Caterers](https://www.edencaterers.london)
**Refs:**
- [Social Pantry: Wallace Collection wedding](https://socialpantry.co.uk/case-studies/lucia-davids-stylish-wallace-collection-wedding/): a case study that gives the venue, 120 guests and the menu.
- [Caiger & Co: events](https://www.caigerandcocatering.co.uk/our-events): event types each with what's included and a "start your brief" link.
- [Eden Caterers](https://www.edencaterers.london): order-online menus for office catering alongside event work.

**For:** a one- or two-shop gelateria that churns daily, changes specials monthly and sells tubs for delivery and events.

**Patterns (~35):** "[Month] gelato menu" with Specials and Classics sections, flavour line (name + one-line description, vegan marker), tub sizes for delivery or collection, find us with hours, events and catering form, gift voucher, allergen information page, "vote a flavour back" poll, story of the maker, newsletter for when specials drop.
**Content model:** companion `flavour` (type: special / classic / sorbet, vegan yes/no, allergens, month, in cabinet yes/no); Woo products for tubs.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce + Order Delivery Date (Lite), Jetpack Forms (events and catering), Jetpack Newsletter.

- Weather-aware hours note ("open late while it's over 25°C") as a scheduled notice
- Printable A4 flavour board generated from the month's list, for the shop window
**Style: Italian shop-sign colour blocks**
- Type: Headings: Caprasimo 400 at clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 9rem); body: Onest 400/18px; prices and allergen codes: Onest 600 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FFFDF8 (fior di latte), text #2B1B17 (chocolate), accent #9E1B32 (amarena, buttons), surface #B9D98A (pistachio, specials), second surface #FFD95E (lemon, classics), line #2B1B17.
- Layout: the monthly menu is the home page: two big colour blocks (Specials, Classics) with flavours as a typeset list, not cards. Flavour names large, descriptions in brackets as on a shop ticket. Blocks 0 radius, buttons 999px, tub product images 0.
- Imagery: top-down shots of the actual cabinet trays, tight crops of texture, shop front in daylight.
- Motion: hovering a flavour shows its allergen codes inline (no movement); month switch uses a View Transition. Reduced motion: instant.
- Why it fits now: small gelaterias sell the month's list as the main content, set in playful type on flat colour, as on [Gelupo](https://gelupo.com/).
**Style variations:** Sorbetto: #FFD95E bg, amarena type · Notte: #2B1B17 bg, pistachio accent · Stracciatella: #FFFFFF bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Gelupo: monthly menu](https://gelupo.com/), [Gelupo: allergen info](https://www.gelupo.com/pages/allergen-info), [Gelato Messina: classic flavours](https://www.gelatomessina.com/collections/classic-flavours), [Gelato Messina: specials](https://specials.gelatomessina.com), [Bi-Rite Creamery: ice cream menu](https://biritemarket.com/creamery/ice-cream/)
**Refs:**
