### X. Trades & home services

<a id="097"></a>
#### 097 · Plumber & Heating Engineer (`pipe`)
**For:** a Gas Safe registered sole trader or small firm (1–6 engineers) doing boiler repairs, servicing, installs and emergency call-outs across a set of postcodes.
**Templates:** front-page · page-emergency · page-boiler-servicing · page-boiler-repair · page-boiler-replacement · page-landlord-gas-safety · page-prices · page-areas · single-area · page-reviews · page-quote
**Patterns (~50):** emergency call-out bar (24/7, tap-to-call, WhatsApp), accreditation badge row (Gas Safe number, City & Guilds, manufacturer approved installer), price guide table ("Annual boiler service from £60", "CP12 from £..") with a guide-price disclaimer, quote form with urgency ("ASAP: no heating or hot water / within 7 days / within a month") and property type, service-area postcode checker, area pages by town, boiler brands serviced, review embed (Google, Checkatrade), what's included in a service, finance note.
**Content model:** companion `service` (name, from-price, duration, what's included), `area` (town, postcode districts, response time).
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (quote form with photo upload), Cal.com embed (service bookings).
**Signature:** a quote form that asks how urgent the job is in the customer's words ("ASAP: I have no heating or hot water") and what kind of property it is, so emergencies are triaged before the phone rings (seen on: [Merseyside Central Heating](https://merseysidecentralheating.co.uk/emergency-plumber/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Guide price table with an honest note that the exact price is confirmed in writing first (seen on: [Affordable Response](https://affordableresponse.co.uk/boiler-servicing-leicester.html))
- Postcode checker built from the `area` list: "Yes, we cover LE2" or "No, try the Gas Safe Register"
- "What to do while you wait" guide: find the stopcock, turn off the gas at the meter, call the gas emergency line
- "Currently booking 3 days ahead" lead-time line the owner updates from a phone
- Gas Safe card number shown with a link to check it on the register
**Style: Swiss neo-grotesk index**
- Type: Headings: Bespoke Sans 700 (Fontshare) at clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 10rem), tracking -0.01em; body: Bespoke Sans 400/18px; prices and Gas Safe number: IBM Plex Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #0E0E0E, accent #E30613 (hot: emergency bar and call buttons), second accent #0057B8 (cold: links and booking), surface #F2F2F2 (price table rows), line #0E0E0E.
- Layout: strict 12-column grid with a visible left index of services (numbered because it is a price list); the phone number is set as big as the logo. Emergency bar full-width red at the top. 0 radius on everything except form inputs (2px).
- Imagery: close photos of real installs (pipework, manifolds, the boiler cupboard after the job), black and white with the red or blue accent on labels; no smiling-van stock.
- Motion: none on scroll; the call button inverts on press. Reduced motion unchanged.
- Why it fits now: a Swiss grid makes a price list look trustworthy and very unlike the usual trade template, as on [Swissted](https://www.swissted.com).
**Style variations:** Night rate: #0E0E0E bg, red accent · Copper: #FFFFFF bg, #B5651D accent · Cold feed: #E8F0FA bg, blue accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Merseyside Central Heating: emergency plumber](https://merseysidecentralheating.co.uk/emergency-plumber/), [Merseyside Central Heating: boiler servicing](https://merseysidecentralheating.co.uk/boiler-servicing/), [Affordable Response: boiler servicing](https://affordableresponse.co.uk/boiler-servicing-leicester.html), [Affordable Response: emergency plumber](https://affordableresponse.co.uk/emergency-plumber-leicester.html), [Culbertson Renewables: areas we cover](https://www.culbertsonrenewables.co.uk/areas)
**Refs:**
- [Merseyside Central Heating: emergency plumber](https://merseysidecentralheating.co.uk/emergency-plumber/): the urgency options in the quote form.
- [Affordable Response: boiler servicing](https://affordableresponse.co.uk/boiler-servicing-leicester.html): trust strip (Gas Safe, 24/7, fixed price), "from £60" and the guide-price disclaimer.
- [Culbertson Renewables: areas](https://www.culbertsonrenewables.co.uk/areas): coverage by council area with the postcodes listed.

#### 098 · Electrician & Solar Installer (`volt`)
**For:** a small NICEIC-registered, MCS-certified firm fitting solar PV, batteries and EV chargers alongside everyday electrical work.
**Templates:** front-page · page-solar-and-battery · page-ev-chargers · page-electrical · page-how-it-works (survey to switch-on) · archive-case-study · single-case-study · page-areas · page-grants · page-faq · page-survey
**Patterns (~45):** accreditation row (NICEIC, MCS, RECC, TrustMark, with numbers), "journey to solar" steps (survey, proposal pack, install, commissioning), case study (system size in kW, panels, battery, location, what the customer wanted), battery retrofit page, EV charger install, solar faults and bird protection, grants and funding explainer, areas we cover, book a free survey form with photo upload (roof, fuse board), savings estimate request, FAQ.
**Content model:** companion `case_study` (system size kW, panel count, battery kWh, roof type, location, year), `area`.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (survey request with file upload), Query Filter (case studies by service).
**Signature:** case studies titled by system size and place ("7.2kW residential install, Sherwood") with a spec box, so homeowners find a job like theirs (seen on: [Spectrum Energy Systems](https://spectrumenergysystems.co.uk/case-studies/7-2kw-residential-solar-installation-sherwood-nottingham/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "What's in the proposal pack" list after the survey (system plan, performance report, quote, warranty info) (seen on: [Lawgrove Energy](https://www.lawgrove.co.uk/journeytosolar))
- Grants explainer page for the customer's nation or region (seen on: [Culbertson Renewables](https://www.culbertsonrenewables.co.uk/guides/home-energy-scotland-grant))
- "Already have solar? Add a battery" page for retrofit customers (seen on: [Whitstable Solar](https://www.whitstablesolar.co.uk/need-a-battery/))
- 14-day cooling-off and workmanship warranty stated in plain words
- Fuse-board photo guide: "send us these three photos" to speed up EV charger quotes
**Style: Dither / 1-bit (low-tech solar)**
- Type: Headings: Lekton 700 at clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: IBM Plex Sans 400/18px; system specs: Lekton 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #000000, accent #FFC400 (sun, buttons and kW figures), wire colours used as rules only: #7B4A2A (live brown), #1F5AA6 (neutral blue), #3A7D2C (earth green); line #000000.
- Layout: a plain document-like page with a narrow reading column and wide spec tables; case studies as a list sorted by kW. Photos dithered to 1-bit to load fast (a real selling point for an energy firm). Buttons 0 radius, tables 0, form inputs 2px.
- Imagery: dithered photos of real roofs and inverter cupboards, with the original colour photo on click; simple line diagrams of panel to inverter to battery.
- Motion: none. Dithered images swap to colour on click, not hover. Reduced motion unchanged.
- Why it fits now: dithered, low-energy web design is a recognised style tied to solar power, as on [Low-tech Magazine's solar site](https://solar.lowtechmagazine.com).
**Style variations:** Overcast: #E5E5E5 bg, black type · Night: #000000 bg, sun accent · Earth: #FFFFFF bg, green accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Spectrum Energy Systems: 7.2kW case study](https://spectrumenergysystems.co.uk/case-studies/7-2kw-residential-solar-installation-sherwood-nottingham/), [Lawgrove Energy: journey to solar](https://www.lawgrove.co.uk/journeytosolar), [Lawgrove Energy: case studies](https://www.lawgrove.co.uk/our-work), [Culbertson Renewables: projects](https://www.culbertsonrenewables.co.uk/projects), [Whitstable Solar: need a battery?](https://www.whitstablesolar.co.uk/need-a-battery/)
**Refs:**
- [Lawgrove Energy: journey to solar](https://www.lawgrove.co.uk/journeytosolar): survey, proposal pack and install explained as real steps.
- [Spectrum Energy Systems: 7.2kW case study](https://spectrumenergysystems.co.uk/case-studies/7-2kw-residential-solar-installation-sherwood-nottingham/): a case study named by size and place.
- [Culbertson Renewables: grant guide](https://www.culbertsonrenewables.co.uk/guides/home-energy-scotland-grant): funding explained by the installer.

#### 099 · Carpenter / Joiner (`dovetail`)
**For:** a joinery workshop (1–8 makers) building kitchens, staircases, wardrobes and alcove units to measure.
**Templates:** front-page · page-kitchens · page-staircases · page-wardrobes · page-alcoves-and-shelving · page-doors-and-windows · archive-project · single-project · page-design (how we work) · page-workshop (visit us) · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** portfolio filtered by type (kitchens, wardrobes, wine rooms, staircases, offices), project page (room / timber / finish / architect or designer credit), staircase types explained (cut string, helix, curved), design process (site visit, drawings, sign-off, make, fit), workshop open-hours and "come and see us" invitation, timber and finish swatches, review embed, area served (radius from the workshop), quote form with room photos and rough dimensions.
**Content model:** companion `project` (type, timber, finish, location, architect credit, year), `service`.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (file upload for photos and drawings), Query Filter (projects by type).
**Signature:** a portfolio filtered by the thing you want built (kitchens, wardrobes, wine rooms, stairs), each project credited with timber, finish and the architect where there was one (seen on: [Winchcombe Farm Designs](https://www.staircasejoinery.co.uk/staircases)).

- "Visit the workshop" block with address and opening hours (seen on: [Jackdaw Joinery](https://jackdawjoinery.co.uk/portfolio))
- Design process page so clients know drawings come before prices (seen on: [Jackdaw Joinery](https://jackdawjoinery.co.uk/design))
- Timber and finish sample request (oak, walnut, painted) with a posted swatch pack
- "Current lead time: 10–12 weeks from sign-off" line
- Care sheet PDF for oiled and painted finishes, handed over at fitting
**Style: Workshop catalogue**
- Type: Headings: Zilla Slab 600 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Libre Franklin 400/18px; timber specs and dimensions: JetBrains Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #F1EBDD (sawdust), text #1E1B18, accent #2F4B5C (steel blue, links and buttons), surface #FFFFFF (spec sheets), line #1E1B18, highlight #C9A46B (oak, rules only).
- Layout: catalogue pages: a large photo, then a spec table (timber, finish, dimensions, time to make). Portfolio as a two-column list with type labels, filter along the top. Photos 0 radius, spec tables 0, buttons 2px.
- Imagery: close-ups of joints, end grain and hardware; finished rooms shot square-on; one workshop photo per project.
- Motion: filter changes use a View Transition; no hover zoom. Reduced motion: instant.
- Why it fits now: shoppers trust makers who look like a well-run workshop rather than a showroom, a tone set by [Labour and Wait](https://www.labourandwait.co.uk).
**Style variations:** Walnut: #2B211B bg, oak text · Painted: #E4E8E3 bg, steel accent · Birch ply: #F6F1E6 bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Jackdaw Joinery: portfolio](https://jackdawjoinery.co.uk/portfolio), [Jackdaw Joinery: kitchens](https://jackdawjoinery.co.uk/kitchens), [Winchcombe Farm Designs: staircases](https://www.staircasejoinery.co.uk/staircases), [Independent Joinery](https://independentjoinery.com), [Northampton Joinery](https://northamptonjoinery.com)
**Refs:**

#### 100 · Builder / Renovation Contractor (`rebuild`)
**For:** a small design-and-build or renovation firm doing extensions, loft conversions and full refurbishments in one city.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-project · single-project · page-extensions · page-loft-conversions · page-refurbishment · page-how-we-work · page-cost-guide · page-guarantee · page-areas · page-contact
**Patterns (~50):** project page (postcode district, project type, completion period, the brief, work delivered list, photos), filterable portfolio (kitchens, bathrooms, extensions, renovation, loft), before/after slider, cost calculator or typical project fees, how we work (stages), workmanship guarantee, accreditation row (FMB, TrustMark, insurance), areas we cover, opening times, review embed (Houzz, Google, Checkatrade), book a call.
**Content model:** companion `project` (type, postcode district, year, budget band, duration, before images, after images).
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms, Query Filter (project type), Cal.com (site visit or 20-minute call).
**Signature:** an extension cost calculator that returns a low / expected / high range with build cost, fees, contingency and VAT shown separately (seen on: [Better Homes Studio](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/extension-calculator)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Project pages that start with postcode and type ("E7, side return extension") and list the work delivered (seen on: [Better Homes Studio](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/portfolio/ava-e7))
- Typical project fees by size and scope (seen on: [Model Projects](https://www.modelprojects.co.uk/model-projects-typical-projects))
- Written workmanship guarantee page (seen on: [Better Homes Studio](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/our-guarantee))
- Before/after slider block on each project, using the companion block and two bound images
- "Now booking starts from March" capacity line
**Style: Site-hoarding grid**
- Type: Headings: Alumni Sans 900 (condensed by design) at clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 10rem); body: Public Sans 400/18px; postcodes, dates and costs: Chivo Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #FF6A13 (hi-vis orange, buttons and the calculator result), surface #E3C79A (plywood, project facts), second #BDBDB8 (concrete), line #111111.
- Layout: postcode-first project list set like a site board ("E7 / Side return / 2025–26"). Before/after slider full width with a hard vertical handle. Calculator in a plywood-coloured panel. 0 radius on panels and images, 2px on inputs.
- Imagery: before and after from the same tripod position; progress shots of steels and roof lights; no CGI.
- Motion: the before/after handle drags with no easing; calculator result appears without animation. Reduced motion: slider becomes two stacked images.
- Why it fits now: architecture and building studios use hoarding-style graphics and plain type to show process, as on [Assemble](https://www.assemblestudio.co.uk).
**Style variations:** Night works: #111111 bg, orange accent · Concrete: #BDBDB8 bg, black type · Blueprint: #1F3A5F bg, white type.
**Real-world basis:** [Better Homes Studio: extension calculator](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/extension-calculator), [Better Homes Studio: Ava E7](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/portfolio/ava-e7), [Urban Design Build: portfolio](https://urbandesignbuild.co.uk/portfolio/), [Model Projects: typical projects](https://www.modelprojects.co.uk/model-projects-typical-projects)
**Refs:**
- [Better Homes Studio: extension calculator](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/extension-calculator): a transparent range with costs broken out.
- [Better Homes Studio: Ava E7](https://www.bhstudio.co.uk/portfolio/ava-e7): postcode, type, completion period, brief and work delivered.
- [Urban Design Build: portfolio](https://urbandesignbuild.co.uk/portfolio/): portfolio filters by kitchens, bathrooms, extensions, renovation and loft.

#### 101 · Painter & Decorator (`coat`)
**For:** a painter and decorator (solo to a crew of five) doing interiors, exteriors, hand-painted kitchens and period properties.
**Templates:** front-page · page-interior · page-exterior · page-hand-painted-kitchens · page-heritage · archive-project · single-project · page-prices · page-process · page-areas · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** project page with before/after, colours used (brand and colour name), prices guide ("what painters in [city] charge"), process (visit, quote, prep, protect, paint, snag), heritage and listed-building work, hand-painted kitchen page, area pages by neighbourhood, team ("who will be in your home"), review embed, quote form with room photos, brochure for architects and designers.
**Content model:** companion `project` (rooms, surfaces, paint brand, colour names, finish, before images, after images), `area`.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (photo upload), Query Filter.
**Signature:** a project page that lists the exact paint colours and finishes used, shown as swatches, with a before/after slider above (the colour-listing idea is standard on specialist sites; seen on: [Traditional Painter: projects](https://traditionalpainter.com/kitchen-painting-projects)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- An honest "what painters charge here" guide page (seen on: [Bristol Painters](https://bristolpainters.org.uk/painter-costs-bristol/))
- Brochure for architects and designers (seen on: [The Good Painter](https://thegoodpainter.co.uk/brochure/))
- "Meet the painters" cards so customers know who will be in their home (seen on: [Traditional Painter](https://traditionalpainter.com/meet-the-painters))
- Printable room-by-room colour schedule the client keeps for touch-ups
- Exterior season note: "booking exterior work for April–September"
**Style: Colour-card system**
- Type: Headings: Gambetta 600 (Fontshare) at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: General Sans 400/18px (Fontshare); colour codes: Martian Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1D1D1B, accent #2E3B4E (deep blue, links and buttons), surface #F0EEE9 (dust sheet), line #1D1D1B; each project adds its own swatches from meta.
- Layout: every project reads like a colour card: a row of rectangular chips with name and code, then the photos. Home page is a grid of big swatches taken from real jobs, each linking to its project. Chips 0 radius, photos 0, buttons 2px.
- Imagery: rooms photographed straight-on in daylight so colours are accurate; detail shots of cut-in lines and panelling.
- Motion: the before/after slider only; chip hover shows the colour name at larger size. Reduced motion: slider becomes stacked images.
- Why it fits now: paint makers themselves sell through large flat swatch grids and named colours, as on [Farrow & Ball's colour index](https://www.farrow-ball.com/paint/all-paint-colours).
**Style variations:** Limewash: #EDE9E1 bg, blue accent · Dark room: #1D1D1B bg, white chips · Primer: #FFFFFF bg, #D8D6D0 rules.
**Real-world basis:** [Traditional Painter: kitchen painting projects](https://traditionalpainter.com/kitchen-painting-projects), [Bristol Painters: painter costs](https://bristolpainters.org.uk/painter-costs-bristol/), [Bristol Painters: our process](https://bristolpainters.org.uk/our-painting-process/), [The Good Painter: heritage](https://thegoodpainter.co.uk/heritage-painting-and-decorating/)
**Refs:**
- [Bristol Painters: painter costs](https://bristolpainters.org.uk/painter-costs-bristol/): pricing explained openly for a local market.
- [Traditional Painter: projects](https://traditionalpainter.com/kitchen-painting-projects): kitchen transformations presented as case studies.
- [The Good Painter: heritage](https://thegoodpainter.co.uk/heritage-painting-and-decorating/): a separate page for period and heritage work.

#### 102 · Roofer (`slate`)
**For:** a family roofing firm specialising in slate, lead, copper and heritage repairs, alongside everyday leaks and gutters.
**Templates:** front-page · page-slate · page-leadwork · page-copper · page-repairs-and-maintenance · archive-project · single-project · page-service-areas · page-faq · page-apprenticeships · page-pay-online
**Patterns (~40):** featured project (building / place / material / what was done / year), projects sortable by material and by building type, services by material, maintenance and repair, service areas, storm damage call-out bar, accreditation row (NFRC, CompetentRoofer, heritage body membership), review embed, apprenticeship programme, pay an invoice online, quote form with photos from the ground or a drone.
**Content model:** companion `project` (building type: church / house / civic / commercial, material, place, year, listed yes/no).
**Plugins:** Query Filter (material, building type), Jetpack Forms, WooCommerce (invoice payment as a simple "pay any amount" product).
**Signature:** a project archive you can sort by material and by building type ("Slate / Church"), each project page naming the building and the work done (seen on: [The Durable Slate Company](https://www.durableslate.com/roofing-project/cedarville-opera-house/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Pay-online page for invoices (seen on: [The Durable Slate Company](https://www.durableslate.com/pay-online/))
- Apprenticeship programme page (seen on: [The Durable Slate Company](https://www.durableslate.com/employment/apprenticeship-program/))
- "Storm damage: temporary cover within 24 hours" notice switched on during storm warnings
- Roof-check photo guide: what to photograph from the ground before calling
- Listed-building note: consent, lime mortar, matching reclaimed slate
**Style: Architectural monograph**
- Type: Headings: Unna 400 at clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 8rem); body: Work Sans 400/18px; project data: Work Sans 500 small caps.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #16191C, accent #3F4A52 (slate, links and buttons), surface #E6E8EA (lead grey tint), line #8C9196; moss #6B7A3A for the "listed building" marker only.
- Layout: monograph spreads: a full-bleed roof photo, then a narrow text column and a data column (material, building, year). Project archive as a text index with a thumbnail on hover. Photos 0 radius, buttons 0, form inputs 2px.
- Imagery: roofs shot from scaffold height, details of slate courses, lead rolls and copper patina; black and white for archive photos.
- Motion: index thumbnails appear on hover with no transition; View Transitions into projects. Reduced motion: thumbnails shown inline.
- Why it fits now: heritage trades gain trust by presenting their work the way architects do, with a plain index and big photographs, as on [6a architects](https://www.6a.co.uk).
**Style variations:** Lead: #8C9196 bg, white type · Copper: #FFFFFF bg, #4E8C7A verdigris accent · Rain: #16191C bg, slate-tint type.
**Real-world basis:** [Jenkins Slate Masters: portfolio](https://www.jenkinsslatemasters.com/portfolio/), [Jenkins Slate Masters: services](https://www.jenkinsslatemasters.com/services/), [Durable Slate: Cedarville Opera House](https://www.durableslate.com/roofing-project/cedarville-opera-house/), [Durable Slate: service areas](https://www.durableslate.com/service-areas/), [Historical Slate Roofing: gallery](https://historicalslateroofing.com/gallery)
**Refs:**
- [Durable Slate: Cedarville Opera House](https://www.durableslate.com/roofing-project/cedarville-opera-house/): project pages tagged by material and building type.
- [Jenkins Slate Masters: portfolio](https://www.jenkinsslatemasters.com/portfolio/): each project named by building and place, with what makes it notable.

#### 103 · Landscaper / Gardener (`mow`)
**For:** a landscaping and garden maintenance business (2–15 people) doing hard landscaping, planting and regular maintenance rounds.
**Templates:** front-page · page-garden-design · page-hard-landscaping · page-maintenance · archive-project · single-project · page-areas · page-seasonal-calendar · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** project page (garden type / size / materials / plants / before and after), services split into design, hardscapes (patios, walls, paths) and lawn and garden care, maintenance programme (visits per year, what's included), seasonal jobs calendar, areas covered, online bill pay for regular clients, office hours, review embed, quote form with garden photos and rough size.
**Content model:** companion `project` (garden type, size m², materials, key plants, before images, after images), `service` (maintenance plan visits, season).
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (photos), Query Filter, WooCommerce + Subscriptions for WooCommerce (maintenance plans paid monthly).
**Signature:** a maintenance programme page that explains a year-round plan and lets regular clients pay their bill online (seen on: [Donnellan & Sons Landscaping](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/lawn-maintenance-programs)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Hardscape services split by material (patios, walls, walkways) (seen on: [Donnellan & Sons](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/hardscapes))
- Office hours in the header for a business that works outdoors all day (seen on: [Donnellan & Sons](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/lawn-maintenance-programs))
- Plant list per project with Latin names, printable for the client, plus a local native-plant guide (seen on: [Johnson's Landscaping](https://jlsinc.net/a-guide-to-over-60-native-plants-in-d-c-and-the-md-suburbs/))
- Instant ballpark pricing for simple jobs such as turfing, patios and paths (seen on: [Johnson's Landscaping](https://jlsinc.net/instant-pricing/sod-estimates/))
- "Fully booked for spring, taking autumn planting" capacity line
**Style: Grainy organic editorial**
- Type: Headings: Erode 500 (Fontshare) at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Satoshi 400/18px (Fontshare); plant names: Erode italic.
- Palette: bg #F3F1EC (chalk), text #1E2419, accent #4F6B3A (leaf, links and buttons), surface #C9D6DC (sky, maintenance panel), line #3B2F26 (bark).
- Layout: editorial pages with large garden photos and captions; projects laid out as a sequence (before, making, after) rather than a gallery grid. Seasonal calendar as a 12-row table. Photos 0 radius, buttons 2px, calendar 0.
- Imagery: film-grain photos across seasons, plants in close-up, the finished garden a year after planting; no AI renders.
- Motion: none on scroll; before/after slider on project pages. Reduced motion: stacked images.
- Why it fits now: garden studios present planting as slow editorial work with seasonal photography, as on [Dan Pearson Studio](https://www.danpearsonstudio.com).
**Style variations:** Winter: #1E2419 bg, chalk text · Meadow: #EEF0E2 bg, leaf accent · Clay: #E7DED3 bg, bark text.
**Real-world basis:** [Donnellan & Sons: lawn maintenance programmes](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/lawn-maintenance-programs), [Donnellan & Sons: hardscapes](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/hardscapes), [Donnellan & Sons: portfolio](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/portfolio), [Roger's Gardens Landscape: referrals](https://www.rogersgardenslandscape.com), [Johnson's Landscaping: before and after](https://jlsinc.net/photo-gallery/before-after/), [Johnson's Landscaping: instant pricing](https://jlsinc.net/instant-pricing/sod-estimates/)
**Refs:**
- [Donnellan & Sons: lawn maintenance programmes](https://www.donnellanlandscaping.com/services/lawn-maintenance-programs): a maintenance plan explained, with bill pay and hours in the header.
- [Johnson's Landscaping: before and after](https://jlsinc.net/photo-gallery/before-after/): a dedicated before-and-after gallery next to galleries by type and by recent project.
- [Roger's Gardens Landscape](https://www.rogersgardenslandscape.com): a plain referral page with named designers and their specialisms, a model for a sole trader's "who does what".

#### 104 · Arborist / Tree Surgeon (`canopy`)
**For:** an ARB Approved or similarly accredited tree surgery firm doing domestic and commercial work, with firewood sales on the side.
**Templates:** front-page · page-tree-surgery (pruning, crown reduction, felling, pollarding, stump grinding) · page-commercial · page-consultancy (surveys, reports) · archive-project · page-areas · page-tpo-guidance · page-logs · page-emergency · page-get-a-quote
**Patterns (~45):** services list by operation (crown reduction, thinning, lifting, felling, pollarding, stump grinding, hedge work), ARB Approved Contractor badge with a link to the directory, areas covered, emergency storm damage call-out, Tree Preservation Order and conservation area guidance, logs and firewood price list with delivery areas, gallery sorted by operation, bio-security statement, hours of work, quote form with tree photos, team with qualifications.
**Content model:** companion `service` (operation, description, when to do it), `area`, Woo products for log loads.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (photos), WooCommerce + Order Delivery Date (Lite) (firewood).
**Signature:** a TPO and conservation-area guidance page written by the firm, explaining when the council must be asked before work starts (seen on: [The Tree Doctors](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/tree-preservation-orders-tpo-guidance/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Logs and firewood page with prices from £90 and delivery areas (seen on: [The Tree Doctors](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/logs/))
- Bio-security statement (cleaning kit between sites to stop disease spread) (seen on: [Acme Tree Services](https://www.acmetreeservices.co.uk/bio-security/))
- ARB Approved page linking to the association's directory (seen on: [The Tree Doctors](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/arb-approved/))
- Bird nesting season note (March–August) on felling and hedge work
- "Your legal obligations as a tree owner" page (seen on: [Acme Tree Services](https://www.acmetreeservices.co.uk/arboriculture/legal-obligations-for-tree-owners/))
**Style: Field-guide plates**
- Type: Headings: Enriqueta 700 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7rem); body: Alegreya Sans 400/18px; Latin names and operation codes: Chivo Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1F2A1F, accent #FF7A00 (chainsaw-safety orange, emergency and quote buttons only), surface #C8D5B9 (lichen), line #1F4D2B (canopy green).
- Layout: each operation is a field-guide plate: a line drawing of the tree before and after the cut, then when to do it and what it costs. Services as a two-column index. Plates 0 radius, buttons 0, form inputs 2px.
- Imagery: line illustrations of crown reduction, lifting and pollarding; photos of climbers at work with ropes visible; no stock forest scenes.
- Motion: none on scroll. Plates show the "after" drawing on tap. Reduced motion: both drawings side by side.
- Why it fits now: nature charities and conservation groups have made clear, drawn field-guide graphics part of how people learn about trees, as on the [Woodland Trust](https://www.woodlandtrust.org.uk).
**Style variations:** Winter canopy: #1F2A1F bg, lichen text · Hi-vis: #FFFFFF bg, orange headings · Bark: #4A3B2F bg, white type.
**Real-world basis:** [Artemis Tree Services: areas covered](https://www.artemistreeservices.com/areas-covered/), [Artemis Tree Services: pollarding](https://www.artemistreeservices.com/service/tree-surgeons/tree-pollarding/), [Acme Tree Services: hours of work](https://www.acmetreeservices.co.uk/about-us/hours-of-work/), [The Tree Doctors: logs](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/logs/), [The Tree Doctors: TPO guidance](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/tree-preservation-orders-tpo-guidance/)
**Refs:**
- [The Tree Doctors: TPO guidance](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/tree-preservation-orders-tpo-guidance/): the legal question every customer should ask, answered by the firm.
- [Artemis Tree Services: pollarding](https://www.artemistreeservices.com/service/tree-surgeons/tree-pollarding/): one page per operation, a structure the theme copies.
- [The Tree Doctors: logs and firewood](https://thetreedoctors.co.uk/logs/): a side line sold with a price and delivery area.

#### 105 · Locksmith (`key`)
**For:** an MLA-approved or licensed independent locksmith doing lockouts, lock changes, uPVC repairs and landlord work across a few boroughs or suburbs.
**Templates:** front-page · page-emergency-lockout · page-lock-changes · page-upvc-repairs · page-burglary-repairs · page-landlords-and-agents · page-car-locksmith · page-prices · page-areas · single-area · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** giant tap-to-call number, licence and insurance line in the header, MLA or trade-body badge with a link to the member listing, services list (non-destructive entry, lock replacement, uPVC lock repairs, burglary repairs, emergency boarding up, eviction and repossession work), landlord and letting agent page, price guide with call-out charge, areas we cover by town, DBS-checked note, review embed, security advice.
**Content model:** companion `service` (name, from-price, emergency yes/no), `area` (town, postcode districts, typical arrival time).
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms, none else.
**Signature:** a licence number and insurance statement fixed in the header next to the phone number, so a panicked caller sees proof before calling (seen on: [Master Locksmith STL](https://masterlocksmithstl.com/emergency-locksmith-service/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Trade-body member listing linked from the badge (seen on: [Master Locksmiths Association: Lardner Locksmiths](https://www.locksmiths.co.uk/find-a-locksmith/lardner-locksmiths-croydon/))
- Landlord and letting agent page for evictions and lock changes between tenants (seen on: [Lardner Locksmiths](https://www.lardnerlocksmiths.com/eviction-locksmith-croydon/))
- Emergency boarding-up service after a break-in (seen on: [Lardner Locksmiths](https://www.lardnerlocksmiths.com/emergency-boarding-up-croydon/))
- "Typical prices" table with call-out and out-of-hours rates, so rogue-trader pricing is easy to spot
- "Is this really your locksmith?" note: the real van, the real face, the real number
**Style: Public-information utility**
- Type: Headings: Ruda 800 at clamp(3.5rem, 12vw, 11rem) (phone number and page titles); body: Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/19px; licence and prices: Atkinson Hyperlegible 700 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #0B0C0C, accent #FFDD00 (key-cutting yellow, the call bar and focus states), surface #F3F2F1, line #0B0C0C, brass #B08D57 for the badge row only.
- Layout: government-service simplicity: one column, 70ch, the call bar sticky on mobile, services as a plain list with prices, no hero image. Buttons 0 radius, inputs 0 with 2px black border, focus as a thick yellow outline.
- Imagery: the locksmith's own van and face, lock hardware close-ups; no hooded-burglar stock.
- Motion: none at all. Reduced motion identical.
- Why it fits now: the clearest emergency interfaces are public-service ones, with large type, yellow focus and plain lists, as documented in the [GOV.UK Design System](https://design-system.service.gov.uk).
**Style variations:** Night call: #0B0C0C bg, yellow type · Brass: #FFFFFF bg, brass rules · Steel: #D9DCDF bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Lardner Locksmiths: non-destructive entry](https://www.lardnerlocksmiths.com/non-destructive-entry-croydon/), [Lardner Locksmiths: eviction locksmith](https://www.lardnerlocksmiths.com/eviction-locksmith-croydon/), [Master Locksmith STL: emergency service](https://masterlocksmithstl.com/emergency-locksmith-service/), [Master Locksmiths Association: locksmith prices](https://www.locksmiths.co.uk/locksmith-prices/)
**Refs:**
- [Master Locksmith STL: emergency service](https://masterlocksmithstl.com/emergency-locksmith-service/): licence number and "all work insured" in the header.
- [Lardner Locksmiths: eviction locksmith](https://www.lardnerlocksmiths.com/eviction-locksmith-croydon/): a page aimed at landlords and agents, a steady source of repeat work.
- [Master Locksmiths Association: prices](https://www.locksmiths.co.uk/locksmith-prices/): the price checklist customers compare against.

#### 106 · Eco Cleaning Company (`clean`)
**For:** a small, often woman-owned cleaning business using non-toxic products, doing regular home cleans, move-in/move-out and rental turnovers.
**Templates:** front-page · page-services (regular / one-off / move-in-out / rental turnover / office) · page-what-we-use · page-pricing · page-book · page-service-areas · page-policies · page-faq · page-gift-cards · page-careers
**Patterns (~40):** services by frequency (weekly, fortnightly, monthly, one-off), "a basic clean includes" list, optional extras (inside fridge, dishes, laundry), products we use (named brands and ingredients), booking with package presets (move-in/out, new baby, after the party, pets included), service areas by county or postcode, policies (lockouts, 24-hour cancellation, illness), gift cards, laundry pickup and delivery add-on, community giving, careers.
**Content model:** companion `service` (name, frequency, duration, from-price, includes, extras), `area`, `product` (name, what it's used for, certification).
**Plugins:** Simply Schedule Appointments (recurring bookings), WooCommerce (gift cards), Jetpack Forms.
**Signature:** a plain policies page covering lockouts (the cleaner waits 20 minutes, then it counts as a cancellation), 24-hour cancellation and illness (seen on: [Angela's Green Cleaning](https://www.angelasgreencleaning.com/policies)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Booking presets for life events: move-in/out, new baby, after the party, pets included (seen on: [HolisticallyClean](https://www.holisticallyclean.com/book-online))
- Gift cards for a clean (seen on: [HolisticallyClean](https://www.holisticallyclean.com/gift-card))
- Service areas split by county with their own pages (seen on: [Earthwise Cleaning Co](https://earthwisecleaningco.com/service-areas))
- "What we use" list with product names and safety-data links, for households with babies, pets or allergies
- Staff cards with first name, photo and pronouns, sent before the first visit
**Style: Care-label utility**
- Type: Headings: Sen 800 at clamp(3rem, 9vw, 8rem); body: Sen 400/18px; care codes, durations and prices: Azeret Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1F2421, accent #3D6FB6 (laundry blue, buttons and links), surface #E7EEEA (eucalyptus tint), line #1F2421, soft #9CB8A6 for dividers.
- Layout: laundry-label logic: each service is a label with a symbol row (what's included drawn as care-label style icons made for the theme), duration and price. Policies set as numbered clauses because they are clauses. Labels 6px radius, buttons 0, inputs 2px.
- Imagery: close photos of real products on a real shelf and cleaners' hands at work; no sparkle overlays or gloved-thumb stock.
- Motion: none on scroll; the booking step changes with a View Transition. Reduced motion: instant.
- Why it fits now: plain, labelled, material-first design reads as honest for household products, as on [MUJI](https://www.muji.eu).
**Style variations:** Rinse: #E9F0F8 bg, blue accent · Linen: #F3F1EC bg, black type · Night shift: #1F2421 bg, eucalyptus text.
**Real-world basis:** [Angela's Green Cleaning: services](https://www.angelasgreencleaning.com/green-cleaning-services), [Angela's Green Cleaning: policies](https://www.angelasgreencleaning.com/policies), [HolisticallyClean: book online](https://www.holisticallyclean.com/book-online), [Earthwise Cleaning Co: service areas](https://earthwisecleaningco.com/service-areas), [Earthwise Cleaning Co: laundry pickup](https://earthwisecleaningco.com/laundry-pickup-delivery-service)
**Refs:**
- [Angela's Green Cleaning: policies](https://www.angelasgreencleaning.com/policies): lockout, cancellation and illness rules in plain words.
- [Angela's Green Cleaning: services](https://www.angelasgreencleaning.com/green-cleaning-services): what a basic clean includes, plus optional extras.
- [HolisticallyClean: book online](https://www.holisticallyclean.com/book-online): booking packages named after real situations.

#### 107 · Removals / Man-with-a-Van (`haul`)
**For:** a family-run removals firm or a one-van operator doing house moves, small moves, packing and storage.
**Templates:** front-page · page-house-removals · page-man-and-van · page-packing · page-storage · page-van-hire · page-quote · page-moving-checklist · page-faq · page-reviews · page-areas
**Patterns (~40):** step-by-step quote form (from / to, property type, number of bedrooms, large items, small items, boxes, floor and lift access), packing service levels, storage options, van hire, moving home checklist (4–6 weeks before, 2 weeks, moving day), FAQ (insurance, what we won't move), reviews, trade-body badge (BAR or similar), areas, response-time promise ("we reply within 24 hours Mon–Fri").
**Content model:** companion `service` (name, from-price, crew size), quote requests as Jetpack Forms responses.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (multistep form with file upload for room photos), Cal.com (video survey slot).
**Signature:** a multistep quote form that builds a rough inventory (property type, large items, small items, boxes, floor level) before asking for contact details (seen on: [Hart Home Removals](https://harthomeremovals.co.uk/free-instant-quote/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Moving home checklist by weeks-before-the-move (seen on: [David Gilkes & Sons](https://www.davidgilkes.com/domestic-removals/moving-home-checklist))
- Downloadable moving checklist and a stated reply time (seen on: [Berkshire Removals](https://www.berkshire-removals.co.uk/free-quote/))
- Packing service page with levels from fragile-only to full pack (seen on: [David Gilkes & Sons](https://www.davidgilkes.com/packing-service))
- "Available dates this month" strip so customers see gaps before asking
- Insurance and "items we can't take" (paint, gas bottles, plants across borders) in one plain list
**Style: Freight stencil**
- Type: Headings: Allerta Stencil 400 at clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 10rem); body: Hanken Grotesk 400/18px; dates, crate numbers and prices: IBM Plex Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #151515, accent #F2B705 (tape yellow, buttons and step numbers), surface #C8A97E (cardboard), line #151515.
- Layout: the quote form is the home page hero, laid out like a shipping manifest with numbered fields; services below as a table of crew size, van size and from-price. Panels 0 radius, buttons 0, inputs 0 with 2px borders.
- Imagery: the real vans and crew loading, boxes labelled by room, tape and blankets; no couples laughing on sofas.
- Motion: form steps change with a View Transition; the progress rule fills without easing. Reduced motion: instant steps.
- Why it fits now: workwear and logistics branding uses stencil type, box brown and tape yellow as a straightforward, durable look, as seen across [Carhartt WIP](https://www.carhartt-wip.com).
**Style variations:** Cardboard: #C8A97E bg, black type · Night move: #151515 bg, tape yellow · Blanket: #2E4057 bg, white type.
**Real-world basis:** [Hart Home Removals: instant quote](https://harthomeremovals.co.uk/free-instant-quote/), [Berkshire Removals: free quote](https://www.berkshire-removals.co.uk/free-quote/), [Berkshire Removals: van hire](https://www.berkshire-removals.co.uk/van-hire/), [David Gilkes & Sons: moving checklist](https://www.davidgilkes.com/domestic-removals/moving-home-checklist), [David Gilkes & Sons: packing](https://www.davidgilkes.com/packing-service)
**Refs:**
- [Hart Home Removals: instant quote](https://harthomeremovals.co.uk/free-instant-quote/): a step form that builds the inventory the quote depends on.
- [David Gilkes & Sons: moving checklist](https://www.davidgilkes.com/domestic-removals/moving-home-checklist): useful content that brings people back in the weeks before the move.
- [Berkshire Removals: free quote](https://www.berkshire-removals.co.uk/free-quote/): short form with bedrooms field, reply-time promise and checklist download.

#### 108 · Handyman / Odd Jobs (`fix`)
**For:** a one-person handyman business doing small repairs, flat-pack, shelves, doors, fences and snag lists within a few towns.
**Templates:** front-page · page-jobs-i-do · page-prices · page-book · page-areas · single-area · page-before-and-after · page-about · page-faq
**Patterns (~35):** "jobs I do" list grouped by room, jobs I don't do (gas, major electrics) with who to call instead, hourly rate, half-day and day rates, minimum charge, "text me a photo" call to action, booking by appointment slots, same-week availability line, insurance and registration line, before-and-after photos per job, town pages, review embed.
**Content model:** companion `job` (room, task, typical time, photo before, photo after), `area`.
**Plugins:** Cal.com embed or Simply Schedule Appointments, Jetpack Forms (photo upload).
**Signature:** "Text me your job with a photo" as the main call to action, backed by a note that every job is documented with before and after photos (seen on: [Mr Odd Job](https://mroddjobhandyman.com)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Online appointment booking with slot length shown (seen on: [Mr Odd Job](https://mroddjobhandyman.com/appointments))
- Insurance and registration stated in the first screen (seen on: [Mr Odd Job](https://mroddjobhandyman.com))
- Rate card: hourly, half day, day and minimum charge, with a tip to batch small jobs into one visit (UK price context: [Taskrabbit cost guide](https://www.taskrabbit.co.uk/cost-guides/general-handyman))
- "Jobs I don't do" list that refers gas and major electrical work to registered trades
- Printable snag-list template the customer fills in before the visit
**Style: Soft neo-brutalism (price tags)**
- Type: Headings: Rubik 900 at clamp(3rem, 10vw, 9rem); body: Rubik 400/18px; rates and times: Rubik Mono One for prices only.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #FFE14D (price-tag yellow), surface #FFB8A8 (soft coral, job cards), second #BDE3FF (soft blue, booking panel), line #111111.
- Layout: jobs as tag-shaped cards with a punched hole and a 3px black outline plus a hard 4px offset shadow; rate card as three hanging tags. Cards 10px radius, tags use a clipped corner, buttons 4px, photos 0.
- Imagery: phone photos of real jobs, before and after, square; a portrait of the handyman with their own van.
- Motion: tags press down on click (80ms); no scroll effects. Reduced motion: no press offset.
- Why it fits now: chunky outlined blocks with hard shadows feel approachable and direct for one-person businesses, as on [Gumroad](https://gumroad.com).
**Style variations:** Hardware: #FFE14D bg, black type · Workbench: #2B2B2B bg, yellow tags · Paint pot: #BDE3FF bg, black type.
**Real-world basis:** [Mr Odd Job](https://mroddjobhandyman.com), [Mr Odd Job: appointments](https://mroddjobhandyman.com/appointments), [Handyman Connection](https://www.handymanconnection.com), [Mr. Handyman](https://www.mrhandyman.com), [Taskrabbit: handyman cost guide](https://www.taskrabbit.co.uk/cost-guides/general-handyman)
**Refs:**
- [Mr Odd Job](https://mroddjobhandyman.com): insured, same-week, upfront pricing and before-and-after documentation stated in the owner's own voice.

#### 109 · Chimney Sweep & Stove Installer (`flue`)
**For:** a HETAS-registered sweep who also installs wood burners and flue liners, working a rural patch with a seasonal rush in autumn.
**Templates:** front-page · page-chimney-sweeping · page-stove-installation · page-stove-servicing · page-chimney-maintenance · page-faq · page-book · page-areas · page-contact
**Patterns (~35):** sweep booking (online or phone), sweep certificate explained (for insurers), HETAS registration badge with number, stove installation process (survey, liner, hearth, certificate of compliance), stove servicing, bird guards and cowls, FAQ (how often to sweep, signs you need a sweep, what to do before we arrive), areas covered, seasonal booking note, reviews.
**Content model:** companion `service` (name, from-price, duration), `area`.
**Plugins:** Simply Schedule Appointments or Cal.com, Jetpack Forms.
**Signature:** a sweep FAQ that answers how often to sweep and the warning signs (soot falling, fire hard to light, smoke back into the room), used as the lead-in to booking (seen on: [Wye Dean Chimney Sweep](https://www.wyedeanchimneysweep.uk/professional-chimney-sweep/chimney-cleaning-questions/)).

- "Before we arrive" checklist: no fire for 24 hours, clear the hearth, move ornaments

**Style: Victorian trade-card letterpress**
- Type: Headings: Abril Fatface 400 at clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 9rem); secondary display: Alfa Slab One for prices; body: Bitter 400/18px.

- Imagery: black and white photos of flues, brushes and finished hearths; a letterpress-style brush-and-rods mark.

- Why it fits now: wood-type letterpress is a living craft style for posters and small trades, as practised by [Hatch Show Print](https://www.hatchshowprint.com).

- Imagery: close-ups of tacks, hessian and horsehair during the strip-down; finished pieces on a plain backdrop, square.

### XI. Health, wellbeing & beauty

> **Shared ground for 111–124 (from the sites studied):** every practice publishes a fees or prices page, a cancellation clause, and a free first call, screening or consultation. Booking almost always runs on a dedicated clinical or studio system (Cliniko, Jane, IntakeQ, SimplePractice, Mindbody, Momence, Vetstoria, Zenoti), so these themes embed the owner's existing booker, or fall back to **Simply Schedule Appointments** / **Cal.com** for solo practitioners. None of these themes stores health data. Forms only collect contact details plus a "reason for enquiry" select. That rule is written into every theme's README.

<a id="111"></a>
#### 111 · Therapist / Counsellor (`session`)
**For:** solo counsellors and psychotherapists, and 2–8 person group practices (UKCP/BACP in the UK, LPC/LCSW in the US) who fill their diary through directories and want their own site to do the explaining.
**Templates:** front-page · page-approach · archive-therapist · single-therapist · page-fees · page-first-meetings · page-issues (hub) · single-issue · page-faq · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** fees & cancellation policy block (session length / fee / notice period / why the policy exists), sliding-scale range with "how we set your fee" note, fee-by-clinician-tier table (senior / associate / trainee), "First meetings" explainer (assessment, then matching to a therapist), numbered intake path (call → message → 20-min screening → first session), intake open/closed banner, "Issues we work with" list (anxiety, bereavement, trauma…), therapist profile (modality, registration body + number, languages, days available), professional-body row (UKCP / BACP / BPS, or state licence), out-of-network + superbill note, Good Faith Estimate notice (US), crisis numbers footer.
**Content model:** `therapist` (tier, modalities, registration body, registration no., languages, pronouns, accepting_new: yes/no, fee range), `issue` taxonomy linking therapists to issue pages.
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (enquiry form that asks only for a name, contact and preferred time; no clinical details), Query Filter (therapists by issue and language), Simply Schedule Appointments or Cal.com embed for the free screening call.
**Signature:** a practice-wide **intake status banner** plus a numbered "How to get started" path. One site setting (intake open / waitlist / closed) is bound to the banner, to every therapist card, and to the contact form's intro text, so a closed practice stops collecting enquiries it can't answer. (seen on: [Therapy Center of Philadelphia: How to Get Started](https://therapycenterofphila.org/how-to-get-started/))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Accepting new clients: yes / waitlist / no" flag on each therapist card, bound to `accepting_new` (operational). (seen on: [Therapy Center of Philadelphia](https://therapycenterofphila.org/how-to-get-started/))
- A sliding-scale explainer with the real range, how the fee is agreed, and a line on "pay what you can" places with trainees (trust & proof). (seen on: [Helping Hands Psychotherapy: Fees](https://www.hhptherapy.com/fees))
- A cancellation policy written in plain English that explains why the notice period exists (care & aftercare). (seen on: [The Koan Practice: Fees & cancellation](https://koan-psy.com/our-fees-cancellation-policies/))
- A persistent footer block with crisis numbers (Samaritans 116 123, NHS 111 option 2, or 988 in the US) and the line "This practice cannot respond to emergencies". A "Leave this site" quick-exit link goes to a neutral page (accessibility & inclusion). None of the practices studied had one, so this is a deliberate addition.
- A printable one-page "fees & policies" sheet: the fees page with print CSS, for clients who want paper (owner tools).
**Style: Quiet clinical-humanist, large-print**
- Type: headings Lustria 400 (tracking left at the face's default); body Atkinson Hyperlegible 400 at 19px / 1.65; small meta Atkinson Hyperlegible 700 at 15px.
- Palette: bg #F7F8F6 (cool paper), text #1F2A2E, accent #2F6B5E (deep eucalyptus, used for links and the single primary button), surface #E4EBE7, line #B9C6C0, crisis box #8E2A24 (used only in the crisis footer).
- Layout: left-aligned single column at 64ch for prose. Fees sit in a real two-column table, not cards. Therapist cards are a list with a portrait on the left and facts on the right. There is no hero headline; the page opens with one sentence on who the practice is for, then the fees link and intake status. Buttons have 4px radius, images 0, inputs 2px. Nav is a plain text row with no hamburger on desktop.
- Imagery: the therapy rooms photographed empty in daylight (chair, window, plant), plus honest head-and-shoulders portraits. No hands-on-knees stock, no brains, no puzzle pieces.
- Motion: none on scroll. Details/accordion open with a 150ms height transition, which is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. View Transitions between the therapist list and profile.
- Why it fits now: accessibility-first typography (Atkinson Hyperlegible's 2024 "Next" release) has become a visible design choice rather than a compliance afterthought, and a calm practice benefits most from it. Example: [Braille Institute: Atkinson Hyperlegible](https://brailleinstitute.org/freefont).
**Style variations:** Daylight: #F7F8F6 bg, eucalyptus #2F6B5E links · Evening: #1E2624 bg, #D6E2DC text, no glow · Print: black on white, serif headings only.
**Real-world basis:** [Koan: Fees & cancellation](https://koan-psy.com/our-fees-cancellation-policies/), [Koan: First meetings](https://koan-psy.com/first-meetings/), [HHP: Fees & insurance](https://www.hhptherapy.com/fees), [LA Psychotherapy Group: Fees](https://lapsychotherapygroup.org/fees-insurance), [Therapy Center of Philadelphia: How to get started](https://therapycenterofphila.org/how-to-get-started/)
**Refs:**
- [Helping Hands Psychotherapy: Fees & Insurance](https://www.hhptherapy.com/fees): the fee table, sliding scale, out-of-network list, Good Faith Estimate and FAQ, all on one page.
- [The Koan Practice: Our fees & cancellation policies](https://koan-psy.com/our-fees-cancellation-policies/): a UK sliding scale (£70–100) and a 48-hour cancellation policy that explains its reasons.
- [Therapy Center of Philadelphia: How to Get Started](https://therapycenterofphila.org/how-to-get-started/): a numbered intake path with an open/closed intake status.

<a id="112"></a>
#### 112 · Physio / Osteopath Clinic (`mobility`)
**For:** one- or two-room physio, osteo and sports-injury clinics with 2–6 practitioners and their own Cliniko or Jane account.
**Templates:** front-page · page-fees · page-packages · page-insurance · page-what-to-expect · archive-condition · single-condition · archive-practitioner · page-book · page-cancellation-policy
**Patterns (~45):** fee list (initial assessment vs follow-up, by 30/45/60 min), pre-paid packages ("3 × 30 min follow-ups £240"), new-patient deposit note, concessions line (over-65s, students, Blue Light Card), insurers accepted row (Bupa / AXA / Aviva, with "pay and claim" explainer), "What to expect at your first consultation" (consultation → examination → treatment), conditions hub (back pain, neck pain, shoulder, sports injury, post-surgery, TMJ), practitioner card (HCPC / GOsC number, special interests), Cliniko/Jane booking embed, opening hours + map, "Refer a friend" note.
**Content model:** `condition` (body area, typical sessions, related practitioners), `practitioner` (profession, register + number, interests, days in clinic), `service` (duration, price, deposit, insurer-eligible flag).
**Plugins:** Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (clinic map). Booking is the clinic's own Cliniko or Jane embed. For clinics without one: Simply Schedule Appointments.
**Signature:** a **"Pricing & bookings" group**: Fees, Packages, Insurances and the Cancellation policy share one sub-nav and sit next to an embedded Cliniko booking frame, so price, policy and the slot picker live on one path. (seen on: [Complement Osteo & Physio: Book your session](https://complement-osteo.com/book-your-session))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- A refundable new-patient deposit line ("£25, refunded with 24h notice") printed under the booking button (buying confidence). (seen on: [Pure Health Osteopath Clinic: Prices](https://osteopath.clinic/prices/))
- A concessions and "refer a friend" row on the prices page (conversion helpers). (seen on: [Pure Health Osteopath Clinic: Prices](https://osteopath.clinic/prices/))
- An insurance-shortfall clause in the cancellation policy, so insured patients know what they owe if a claim is refused (trust & proof). (seen on: [Complement: Cancellation policy](https://complement-osteo.com/cancellationpolicy))
- An exercise-sheet library: printable PDFs attached to each condition page for home rehab (care & aftercare).
- Step-free access, lift and parking notes on the contact page (local & practical).
**Style: Anatomical-chart Swiss**
- Type: headings Gantari 800, set large (display 5.5rem, 4.5× body); body Gantari 400 at 18px; labels and fees IBM Plex Mono 500 with tabular figures.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111418, accent #E0A100 (saffron, used for the booking action only), surface #EEF1F4, line #C9D0D6, navy #253551 for the footer band.
- Layout: a 12-column grid with hairline column rules visible in the header. Conditions are listed as a numbered body-area index (Neck, Shoulder, Lower back…) set against a simple line diagram of a figure, with each area linking to its page. Fees form a ruled table. Buttons are square (0 radius) and inputs 2px. Nav is a text bar with "Book" set apart on the right.
- Imagery: black-and-white treatment photos cropped tight on hands, joints and equipment. Line-drawn anatomy diagrams in #111418 only. No smiling stock runners.
- Motion: body-area index items highlight their region on the diagram on hover/focus (an SVG fill change, instant). No scroll effects.
- Why it fits now: the medical-poster and instructional-diagram look is back in clinic and wellness branding because it signals expertise without gloss. Example: [Complement Osteo & Physio: Fees](https://complement-osteo.com/fees).
**Style variations:** Chart: white, saffron #E0A100, ink #111418 · Theatre: #253551 bg, white type, saffron rules · Tape: #F2F2EE bg, kinesiology-blue #1D6FA3 accent.
**Real-world basis:** [Complement: Fees](https://complement-osteo.com/fees), [Complement: Packages](https://complement-osteo.com/packages), [Docklands Osteopathy: What to expect](https://docklandsosteopathyclinic.co.uk/what-to-expect/), [Pure Health: Prices](https://osteopath.clinic/prices/), [Bodytonic: Prices](https://bodytonicclinic.co.uk/prices/)
**Refs:**
- [Pure Health Osteopath Clinic: Prices](https://osteopath.clinic/prices/): a small-clinic price page with deposit, passes, concessions and referral in a few lines.
- [Complement Osteo & Physio: Packages](https://complement-osteo.com/packages): shows how pre-paid follow-up bundles are presented next to single fees.
- [Docklands Osteopathy Clinic: What to expect](https://docklandsosteopathyclinic.co.uk/what-to-expect/): a first-visit explainer broken into consultation, examination and treatment.

<a id="113"></a>
#### 113 · Independent Dental Practice (`smile`)
**For:** single-site private or mixed NHS/private dental practices with 1–4 dentists and a hygienist.
**Templates:** front-page · page-fee-guide · single-treatment (with cost section) · archive-treatment · page-emergency · page-membership · archive-team · page-new-patients · page-complaints · page-book
**Patterns (~50):** fee guide grouped by category (General / Hygiene / Cosmetic / Orthodontics / Implants) with "from £" prices, new-patient vs existing-patient prices, "a full written estimate is provided before treatment" note, emergency page (what counts as an emergency, same-day slots, symptom list with instructions), membership plan table (monthly tiers, what each includes, family discount), finance note, free implant/aligner consultation offer, dentist card (GDC number, special interests), regulator line (CQC regulated, GDC registered), smile gallery (before/after with consent note), complaints procedure page, opening hours.
**Content model:** `treatment` (category, from-price, typical visits, finance-eligible flag, cost page text), `team_member` (role, GDC no., interests), `plan` (monthly price, inclusions).
**Plugins:** none beyond the practice's own booking system link. Jetpack Forms for "request a call back".
**Signature:** a **fee guide with a cost page per treatment**. The index lists every treatment with a from-price, and each treatment page carries its own "What affects the cost" section plus the same price bound from `treatment` meta, so the price is edited once and stays consistent across the site. (seen on: [Dental Clinic London: Fee guide](https://www.dentalclinic.london/fee-guide))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- An emergency symptom list with time-critical instructions ("knocked-out tooth: call within 30 minutes") and a tap-to-call button that stays pinned on mobile (care & aftercare). (seen on: [Dental Clinic London: Emergency dentist](https://www.dentalclinic.london/emergency-dentist))
- A membership plan table with family discount, written as a comparison list rather than "Most popular" cards (conversion helpers). (seen on: [London Dental Centre: Membership](https://thelondondentalcentre.co.uk/dental-membersip))
- A regulator line with real registration numbers (CQC location ID, GDC numbers per dentist) linked to the public registers (trust & proof). (seen on: [Dental Clinic London](https://www.dentalclinic.london/fee-guide))
- A complaints procedure page, ready-made from a template, because UK practices are expected to publish one (owner quality of life).
- A "nervous patients" page covering sedation options, signals you can use in the chair, and quiet appointment times (accessibility & inclusion).
**Style: Clinical tile signage**
- Type: headings Quicksand 700 (display 5rem); body Red Hat Text 400 at 18px; prices in Red Hat Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #0E2A33, accent #00857C (enamel teal, primary action), surface #E6F2F1 (tile), line #BFD9D6, emergency #B8461B (only on the emergency bar and page).
- Layout: a strict 8px baseline grid that echoes tiled surgery walls. Treatment categories appear as a wide ruled index with the price right-aligned. The emergency bar runs full width under the header, and its hours are bound to the practice's opening hours. Cards are not used; sections are separated by 1px teal rules. Buttons 6px radius, images 0.
- Imagery: the real surgery, reception and staff in clean even light. Before/after pairs shown at the same crop. No floating teeth renders and no stock smiles.
- Motion: a before/after slider (drag, arrow-key operable) on gallery items. No scroll animation.
- Why it fits now: independent practices are competing with chains on transparency, and a published price-led layout reads as honest. Example: [London Dental Centre: Fees](https://thelondondentalcentre.co.uk/fees).
**Style variations:** Tile: white, teal #00857C · Night surgery: #0E2A33 bg, #E6F2F1 text · Mint: #E6F2F1 bg, ink #0E2A33, accent #B8461B.
**Real-world basis:** [Dental Clinic London: Fee guide](https://www.dentalclinic.london/fee-guide), [Dental Clinic London: Emergency](https://www.dentalclinic.london/emergency-dentist), [Hakimi Dental: Fees](https://hakimidentalclinic.co.uk/fees/), [London Dental Centre: Fees](https://thelondondentalcentre.co.uk/fees), [London Dental Centre: Membership](https://thelondondentalcentre.co.uk/dental-membersip)
**Refs:**
- [Hakimi Dental Clinic: Fees](https://hakimidentalclinic.co.uk/fees/): a WordPress fee table by category with "Book now" per section. This is the right scale for a small practice.
- [Dental Clinic London: Emergency dentist](https://www.dentalclinic.london/emergency-dentist): an emergency landing page with a symptom list, same-day slots and a phone call to action.
- [London Dental Centre: Dental membership](https://thelondondentalcentre.co.uk/dental-membersip): membership tiers and what each covers.

<a id="114"></a>
#### 114 · Doula / Independent Midwife (`birth`)
**For:** solo birth and postnatal doulas, independent midwives and small doula collectives who cover a named set of hospitals and postcodes.
**Templates:** front-page · page-birth-doula · page-postnatal-doula · page-packages · page-about · archive-birth-story · page-faq · page-areas-covered · page-access-fund · page-discovery-call
**Patterns (~40):** support timeline (antenatal → on-call from 38.5 weeks → early labour → birth → the golden hour → postnatal), named packages with prices, "a note about doula fees" (why on-call work costs what it does), payment terms (deposit to secure your due month, instalments), backup doula explainer, "areas I cover" with hospitals and birth centres, availability by due month, discovery call booking, birth stories (with consent), gift vouchers, access fund / reduced-cost places, free download (hospital bag list).
**Content model:** `package` (price, inclusions, on-call window, visits), `due_month` availability (month, status: open / limited / full), `birth_story` (birth setting, year).
**Plugins:** Cal.com embed (free discovery call), Jetpack Forms (enquiry with due date), GiveWP or Jetpack Donations (access fund, where the collective runs one).
**Signature:** **booking by due month**: a strip of the next 12 months, each marked open / one space / fully booked, bound to `due_month` records and repeated on the enquiry form so parents know before they write. It generalises the "fully booked" notice seen on real doula sites. (seen on: [Woomly: Independent midwife & doula packages](https://www.woomly.london/independent-midwife-doula-east-west-london-uk-hackney-islington-wanstead-buckhursthill))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Package prices tiered by when you book (0–12 weeks, 13–25 weeks…), with an "all packages include" list (buying confidence). (seen on: [Woomly](https://www.woomly.london/independent-midwife-doula-east-west-london-uk-hackney-islington-wanstead-buckhursthill))
- A backup-doula answer and payment-instalment terms in the FAQ (trust & proof). (seen on: [Barefoot Birthing: Birth doula](https://barefootbirthing.com/birth-doula/))
- An access fund block: "apply for a reduced-cost place" and "donate to the fund" side by side (community). (seen on: [Womb & Bloom](https://www.wombandbloom.co.uk/))
- Gift vouchers for grandparents and friends (conversion helpers). (seen on: [The Baby Experience: Doula](https://www.thebabyexperience.co.uk/whatwedo-babyexperience-services/doula))
- A printable "packing for labour" checklist PDF offered as a free download (care & aftercare). (seen on: [The Baby Experience: Doula](https://www.thebabyexperience.co.uk/whatwedo-babyexperience-services/doula))
**Style: Warm plum editorial**
- Type: headings Eczar 600 (display 5rem); body Rethink Sans 400 at 18px / 1.6; timeline labels Rethink Sans 700 at 15px.
- Palette: bg #F6F1F3 (pale rose-grey), text #2A1E22, accent #7A2E3B (deep plum-red), surface #E8DCE3, line #CDB9C3, calm green #3F5E4A for "open" states.
- Layout: the support timeline is the backbone of the front page: one vertical line down the left third with phases as stops and the copy on the right. Packages are a two-column comparison list. Birth stories use an editorial layout with a pull-quote and a location/year running head. Buttons 20px radius, images 0 with a 1px line, inputs 4px.
- Imagery: warm documentary photos of hands, bellies, newborns and home settings, used with written consent, in natural colour. No silhouettes at sunset.
- Motion: the timeline stop for "now" (based on a parent-entered due date, stored only in the browser) is highlighted. No scroll animation.
- Why it fits now: doula collectives are presenting themselves as community institutions ("your village") rather than wellness brands, and an editorial rather than spa look fits that. Example: [Womb & Bloom](https://www.wombandbloom.co.uk/).
**Style variations:** Rose: #F6F1F3 bg, plum #7A2E3B · Night feed: #221A1D bg, #EADDE3 text · Linen: #FFFFFF bg, ink #2A1E22, green #3F5E4A.
**Real-world basis:** [Barefoot Birthing: Birth doula](https://barefootbirthing.com/birth-doula/), [Woomly: Packages](https://www.woomly.london/independent-midwife-doula-east-west-london-uk-hackney-islington-wanstead-buckhursthill), [Womb & Bloom](https://www.wombandbloom.co.uk/), [The Baby Experience: Doula](https://www.thebabyexperience.co.uk/whatwedo-babyexperience-services/doula), [The Hackney Doula: Services](https://www.thehackneydoula.com/services)
**Refs:**
- [Barefoot Birthing: Birth doula](https://barefootbirthing.com/birth-doula/): a solo WordPress doula page with a phase timeline, two priced packages and an FAQ covering backup, payment and hospitals.
- [The Baby Experience: Doula](https://www.thebabyexperience.co.uk/whatwedo-babyexperience-services/doula): two doula profiles, "a note about doula fees" and instalments.
- [Womb & Bloom](https://www.wombandbloom.co.uk/): a collective's homepage with an access fund block.

<a id="115"></a>
#### 115 · Dietitian / Nutritionist (`plate`)
**For:** registered dietitians and nutritionists in solo or small group practice (non-diet, eating disorders, gut health, sports), often licensed in one or two states or regions.
**Templates:** front-page · page-approach · page-services · single-specialty · page-rates-insurance · page-faq · archive-team · single-team · page-resources · page-discovery-call
**Patterns (~40):** philosophy statement ("Am I the right dietitian for you?"), specialty pages (eating disorders, IBS, PCOS, diabetes, sports), fee range + session-package ladder (3 / 6 / 10 sessions), in-network insurers list, "insurance script" download (questions to ask your insurer), superbill note, sliding-scale spots, Good Faith Estimate notice, "what to expect" (assessment → goals → education), licensure line (states or regions covered), client portal link (SimplePractice / IntakeQ), free discovery call, resource freebie.
**Content model:** `specialty` (conditions, related team members), `team_member` (credentials, licences by state, specialties, accepting_new), `resource` (PDF download).
**Plugins:** Cal.com embed (discovery call), Jetpack Newsletter (freebie and newsletter), Query Filter (team by specialty and state).
**Signature:** a **rates & insurance page with a downloadable "insurance script"**: step-by-step questions to ask your insurer about nutrition-therapy benefits, placed next to the in-network list and the booking link, so clients can check cover before they commit. (seen on: [Side by Side Nutrition: Rates & insurance](https://sidebysidenutrition.com/rates-and-insurance))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- A session-package ladder showing the saving per session, next to single-session fees (buying confidence). (seen on: [Rachael Hartley Nutrition: Nutrition coaching](https://www.rachaelhartleynutrition.com/nutrition-coaching))
- A superbill / self-pay / in-network comparison in one short table (trust & proof). (seen on: [The Intuitive Dietitian: Services](https://www.theintuitivedietitian.com/services))
- A "Client portal" link in the header for existing clients, separate from "Book a call" for new ones (owner quality of life). (seen on: [Demi Maropoulos Nutrition Counseling](https://dmnutritioncounseling.com/))
- A licensure line listing the states or regions the dietitian can legally see clients in, shown on every booking button (local & practical).
- A no-weight-numbers content rule in the demo copy and imagery, with "content notes" on any post that mentions weight (accessibility & inclusion).
**Style: Recipe-card editorial**
- Type: headings Corben 400 (display 5.25rem); body Figtree 400 at 18px / 1.6; small caps-free labels in Figtree 600 at 15px.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #20251F, accent #C9452B (tomato, primary actions), leaf #3D6B35 (links), surface #F1EEE6 (index-card stock, used only for card patterns), line #D8D2C4.
- Layout: specialties are laid out as ruled index cards with a heading, three plain lines of "who it's for", and a link; spans vary (one wide, two narrow). Rates use a ruled table like a recipe ingredient list. The front page opens with the philosophy statement set large, then "who I work with", then fees. Buttons 3px radius, images 0.
- Imagery: food photographed overhead on everyday plates and tables, as real meals rather than styled bowls. Portraits of the dietitian in their consulting room. No scales, tape measures or before/after bodies.
- Motion: none on scroll. Package ladder rows highlight on hover and focus.
- Why it fits now: non-diet practices are moving away from wellness pastels towards a warmer, cookbook-like editorial register, and several run on WordPress block themes already. Example: [Demi Maropoulos Nutrition Counseling](https://dmnutritioncounseling.com/).
**Style variations:** Index card: #FFFFFF, tomato #C9452B · Pantry: #F1EEE6 bg, leaf #3D6B35 · Plain plate: black on white, Corben only in headings.
**Real-world basis:** [Rachael Hartley: Nutrition coaching](https://www.rachaelhartleynutrition.com/nutrition-coaching), [Side by Side: Rates & insurance](https://sidebysidenutrition.com/rates-and-insurance), [The Intuitive Dietitian: Services](https://www.theintuitivedietitian.com/services), [Demi Maropoulos Nutrition Counseling](https://dmnutritioncounseling.com/), [Nutrition Studio PNW: FAQ](https://www.nutritionstudiopnw.com/faq)
**Refs:**
- [Side by Side Nutrition: Rates & insurance](https://sidebysidenutrition.com/rates-and-insurance): an insurance script, in-network list and booking on one page.
- [Rachael Hartley Nutrition: Nutrition coaching](https://www.rachaelhartleynutrition.com/nutrition-coaching): transparent fee ranges and a package ladder with a superbill note.
- [Demi Maropoulos Nutrition Counseling](https://dmnutritioncounseling.com/): a one-page solo site on a WordPress block theme with a client portal, discovery call and "Am I the right dietitian for you?".

<a id="116"></a>
#### 116 · Speech & Language Therapist (`speak`)
**For:** independent SLTs and small SLT practices working with children, schools and adults (stammering, voice, stroke, dementia).
**Templates:** front-page · page-children · page-adults · archive-condition · single-condition · page-assessments · page-fees · page-schools · page-resources · page-team
**Patterns (~45):** assessment-package ladder (quick first look → report → full assessment → bespoke), free 20-minute phone consultation, therapy session fees, report and travel fees ("free locally, then £X per hour"), payment terms, "can you claim the cost?" (insurance), free screening form, "enrolling is as easy as 1-2-3", working-with-schools offer, parent workshops and holiday groups, conditions list (DLD, autism, stammering, selective mutism, speech sounds, voice), therapist card (HCPC + RCSLT numbers), resources hub.
**Content model:** `condition` (age group, typical assessment), `package` (what's included, price, report yes/no), `resource` (age, format: PDF / video).
**Plugins:** Jetpack Forms (screening intake: child's age, school, main concern), Cal.com embed (free phone consultation), Query Filter (resources by age and condition).
**Signature:** an **assessment-package ladder**: four options from "50-minute session + email summary" to "two sessions + detailed report + feedback meeting", each with what the family actually receives, so parents choose a depth of assessment rather than guessing. (seen on: [ISLTS: Pricing](https://islts.co.uk/pricing/))
**Nice-to-haves:**
- A free screening page leading into an intake form (conversion helpers). (seen on: [Dallas Reading and Language Services: Free screenings](https://speechtherapydallas.com/free-screenings/))
- A travel-fee line with the free local area named by postcode (local & practical). (seen on: [Apple Tree SLT: Fees](https://appletreeslt.co.uk/fees/))
- A "Can you claim the cost?" paragraph on the fees page (buying confidence). (seen on: [Peter Piper Picked: Fees](https://peterpiperpicked.co.uk/fees/))
- A symbol-supported (Widgit-style) "What happens at your first visit" page for children, with photos of the room and the therapist (accessibility & inclusion).
- Printable home-practice sheets attached to resource posts (content & tools).
**Style: Readable-first picture book**
- Type: headings Lexend 700 (display 5rem; Lexend was designed to improve reading fluency); body Andika 400 at 20px / 1.7 (a face built for early literacy, with single-storey a and g); labels Lexend 500 at 16px.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1B1F2A, accent #1C5D99 (primary action), speech-bubble yellow #FFD23F (surface blocks with ink text only), line #C9CFD8, soft green #2E7D4F for "free" labels.
- Layout: very large tap targets (56px). The front page splits into two doors, "For children" and "For adults", as two big blocks with photos. Condition pages follow a fixed three-part pattern: what it is, how we assess, how therapy works. Speech-bubble shapes (a CSS border-radius plus tail) are used for quotes from parents only. Buttons 12px radius, images 8px, inputs 8px.
- Imagery: real therapy moments (picture cards, play, mirrors) photographed at child height, with consent. Hand-drawn line icons for conditions, drawn by the therapist or a local illustrator. No stock clip-art children.
- Motion: none. An optional "read aloud" button uses the browser's speech synthesis on condition pages.
- Why it fits now: readability-led type (Lexend, Andika, Atkinson) is being adopted by education and health services as a visible part of the brand. Example: [Lexend](https://www.lexend.com/).
**Style variations:** Classroom: white, #1C5D99 + #FFD23F · Quiet: #F3F5F8 bg, no yellow, blue links · High contrast: #000000 text on #FFFFFF, 22px body.
**Real-world basis:** [ISLTS: Pricing](https://islts.co.uk/pricing/), [Apple Tree SLT: Fees](https://appletreeslt.co.uk/fees/), [Peter Piper Picked: Fees](https://peterpiperpicked.co.uk/fees/), [Dallas: Cost of service](https://speechtherapydallas.com/costs-of-service/), [Dallas: Free screenings](https://speechtherapydallas.com/free-screenings/)
**Refs:**
- [ISLTS: Pricing](https://islts.co.uk/pricing/): assessment options and specialist assessments with a free call first.
- [Dallas Reading and Language Services: Cost of service](https://speechtherapydallas.com/costs-of-service/): pre-paid session packages with per-session saving, plus private-pay and insurance tabs (WordPress).
- [Apple Tree Speech & Language Therapy: Fees](https://appletreeslt.co.uk/fees/): travel fees, payment terms and school work on one page.
