<a id="174"></a>
#### 174 · Running Club (`stride`)
**For:** local running and athletics clubs (England Athletics-affiliated or social run crews) with weekly club runs, track sessions and a club championship.
**Templates:** front-page · page-club-runs · page-beginners · page-track-sessions · archive-route · single-route · page-results · page-club-championship · page-age-grading · page-kit · page-running-safely · page-join · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** club run schedule by weekday (meeting point, time, pace groups), beginners pathway (Couch to 5k, Beginners, 10k Improvers) with entry criteria, track session details, named routes library with distance and map, results by race, club championship rules and standings, age-grading calculator, kit page, running safely guidance and risk assessment, join and membership fees, AGM notices.
**Content model:** `route` (distance, surface, start point, map embed, season: winter/summer), `session` (weekday, time, venue, type), `result` (race, date, runner, time, age grade), `race` (date, distance, championship y/n).
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (this week's sessions, upcoming races), Query Filter (routes by distance), Jetpack Forms (join), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap; Strava club and route embeds.
**Signature:** an age-grading calculator next to the results, so runners of any age can compare performances (seen on: [Serpentine: Age grading comparison](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/age-grading-comparison/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Beginners pathway with a clear "if you already run 10k in 55 minutes, join the main sessions" rule (seen on: [Serpentine: Beginner runners](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/beginner-runners/)).
- Library of named club-run routes by season (seen on: [Dulwich Runners: Wednesday night routes](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/wednesday-night-routes)).
- Running safely guidance and the club's risk assessment (seen on: [Dulwich Runners: Running safely](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/running-safely)).
- Club kit page with how to order (seen on: [Dulwich Runners: Kit](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/kit)).
- Session change notices on the day (AGM, bank holidays, darkness) (seen on: [Serpentine: AGM and changes to club run](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/annual-general-meeting-and-changes-to-club-run-16-september-2026/)).
- Printable club championship scoring sheet.
**Style: Race-bib kinetic type**
- Type: headings Nippo 700 (Fontshare, a sports-jersey face) at large sizes; body Hanken Grotesk 400/18px; times, paces and distances Big Shoulders Text 700 set like bib numbers.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #121212, club vest colour #E4002B (swappable), hi-vis #D7F205 used only on the "tonight's run" strip, surface #F1F1EE, line #121212.
- Layout: the front page opens with "Tonight" as a strip (session, meeting point, time), then the week as a timetable. Results as dense tables; routes as a list with distance in big numerals and a small map. Diagonal vest-stripe band used once, at the top.
- Imagery: club runs at night and in rain, head torches and reflective kit, finish-line photos; blur from real movement is allowed, fake speed lines are not.
- Motion: none on scroll; the timetable scrolls horizontally with scroll-snap on small screens.
- Why it fits now: run clubs have become a social scene again since 2023, and run crews brand themselves like fashion labels rather than athletics clubs ([Midnight Runners: London](https://www.midnightrunners.com/cities/london)).
**Style variations:** Vest: club colour stripe · Night run: #121212 bg, hi-vis strip · Track: rubber red #B5452B surface
**Real-world basis:** [Serpentine: Beginner runners](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/beginner-runners/) · [Serpentine: Paddington track sessions](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/events/paddington-track-sessions/) · [Dulwich Runners: Results](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/results) · [Dulwich Runners: Club championships](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/club-championships) · [Midnight Runners: London](https://www.midnightrunners.com/cities/london)
**Refs:**
- [Serpentine: Age grading comparison](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/age-grading-comparison/): a WordPress club running a real age-grading tool.
- [Serpentine: Beginner runners](https://www.serpentine.org.uk/beginner-runners/): a staged on-ramp for new runners with entry criteria.
- [Dulwich Runners: Wednesday night routes](https://www.dulwichrunners.org.uk/wednesday-night-routes): named routes by season; the model for `route`.

<a id="175"></a>
#### 175 · Cycling Club (`peloton`)
**For:** local road, gravel and racing cycling clubs with weekly club runs, intro rides, a race series and club kit.
**Templates:** front-page · page-riding-with-us · page-intro-ride · archive-event · single-event · page-racing · archive-result · page-women · page-club-kit · page-club-rules · page-join · page-committee
**Patterns (~40):** ride groups by pace (A/B/C with average speeds), fixed meeting points and set routes, monthly introductory ride with briefing time, pre-ride kit checklist (mudguards in winter, multi-tool, pump, emergency contact), regroup and etiquette rules, race series page (crits, time trials), results per event, women's rides, club kit and member discounts, events calendar (sportives, audax, gravel), weekly roundup newsletter, club rules, committee list.
**Content model:** `ride` (weekday, start point, time, group, pace, route link, distance), `event` (date, type: race/sportive/social), `result` (event, rider, category, position), `route` (distance, elevation, Strava/RideWithGPS link).
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (this weekend's rides), Jetpack Forms (intro ride sign-up), Jetpack Newsletter (weekly roundup), The Events Calendar optional; Strava route and club embeds.
**Signature:** ride groups listed by pace with fixed meeting points, set routes and regroup etiquette, so a new rider can pick a group before turning up (seen on: [Dulwich Paragon: Riding with Dulwich Paragon](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/riding-with-dulwich-paragon/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Intro ride page with a kit checklist and a cancellation line for months with no ride (seen on: [Dulwich Paragon: Monthly introductory ride](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/monthly-introductory-ride/)).
- Women's rides page (seen on: [Dulwich Paragon: Women's cycling](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/women/)).
- Club kit and member discounts at local shops (seen on: [Dulwich Paragon: Club kit and member benefits](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/club-kit-and-member-benefits/)).
- Results pages for the club's hosted race (seen on: [Dulwich Paragon: Wally Gimber 2026 results](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/wally-gimber-2026-results/)).
- Weather call ("Ride is on / Ride cancelled: ice") set on the morning by a ride leader, shown on the front page.
**Style: Road-racing editorial photography**
- Type: headings BenchNine 700 at large sizes, in capitals for ride names only; body Newsreader 400/18px for ride reports; distances, speeds and times Barlow 500 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #161616, club colour #E6007E (swappable), tarmac #2B2B2B, bar-tape white #F5F5F3, line #161616.
- Layout: magazine-like: ride reports as long reads with big photos between paragraphs; the "Ride with us" page as a timetable table (day, group, pace, start, distance). Club colour band on the header. Square corners throughout.
- Imagery: rides photographed from the wheel or roadside in real weather, café stops, the velodrome; strong crops at 16:9 and 4:5; no stock racers on empty mountain roads.
- Motion: none on scroll; ride group rows expand to show the route map (details element).
- Why it fits now: club riding culture is now shaped by editorial cycling media, with condensed sans headlines and serious photography ([Rapha Cycling Club](https://content.rapha.cc/gb/en/rcc)).
**Style variations:** Club colours: pink band on white · Winter kit: #2B2B2B bg, white · Velodrome: pale blue #DCE8F0 surface
**Real-world basis:** [Dulwich Paragon: Riding with Dulwich Paragon](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/riding-with-dulwich-paragon/) · [Dulwich Paragon: Crystal Palace Crits](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/cpcrits/) · [Southborough and District Wheelers: Events calendar](https://www.southborough-wheelers.co.uk/Events/Calendar) · [Rapha Cycling Club](https://content.rapha.cc/gb/en/rcc)
**Refs:**
- [Dulwich Paragon: Riding with Dulwich Paragon](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/riding-with-dulwich-paragon/): a WordPress club with pace groups, start points and etiquette on one page.
- [Dulwich Paragon: Monthly introductory ride](https://www.dulwichparagon.com/monthly-introductory-ride/): the on-ramp for new riders with a kit checklist.
- [Rapha Cycling Club](https://content.rapha.cc/gb/en/rcc): the editorial photography and type register the theme adapts with free fonts.

#### 176 · Climbing / Bouldering Gym (`crimp`)
**For:** independent climbing walls and bouldering gyms with one or two sites, courses, kids' clubs and a café.
**Templates:** front-page · page-first-visit · page-prices · page-memberships · page-concessions · page-route-setting (areas map) · archive-course · single-course · page-kids-and-families · page-groups · page-events · page-accessibility · page-faqs · page-how-to-find-us
**Patterns (~45):** first-visit paths (brand new / have experience / with a child; bouldering only vs ropes), online registration and acknowledgement of risk, prices table (peak / off-peak / concession), memberships and punchcards, wall-by-wall area map with climbing type per area (top rope, boulder, auto belay, lead), route-setting schedule ("new sets this week"), courses (intro to bouldering, learn to lead), kids' clubs and junior rules (ages, supervision, competency test), groups and inclusion sessions, gift cards, etiquette guide, opening hours with bank-holiday changes.
**Content model:** `area` (wall name, climbing type, grade range, last reset date), `course` (level, dates, price, spaces), `price` (type, peak/off-peak, concession), `session` for clubs.
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (next courses, recently reset areas), Jetpack Forms (group bookings), WooCommerce (gift cards, shop) optional; waivers and bookings usually stay in the gym's own system and are linked.
**Signature:** a wall-by-wall area map that shows the climbing type in each area and links to setting news (seen on: [The Castle Climbing Centre: Route setting](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/route-setting)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- First-visit page that splits by experience and asks for the risk form before arrival (seen on: [The Castle Climbing Centre: First visit](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/first-visit)).
- Concession memberships (seen on: [The Climbing Hangar: Concession memberships](https://www.theclimbinghangar.com/concession-memberships)).
- Inclusion sessions for refugees and women (seen on: [The Climbing Hangar: Refugees Rock](https://www.theclimbinghangar.com/refugees-rock)).
- Accessibility and visual guide to the building (seen on: [The Castle Climbing Centre: Accessibility and visual guide](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/accessibility-and-visual-guide)).
- Junior rules by age (seen on: [Mile End Climbing Wall: First visit](https://www.mileendwall.org.uk/first-visit)).
- "Reset this week" flag on areas, computed from the last reset date; indoor etiquette guide (seen on: [Depot Climbing: Indoor climbing etiquette](https://www.depotclimbing.co.uk/blog/indoor-climbing-etiquette/)).
**Style: Topo guide and hold colours**
- Type: headings Sora 800 at large sizes; body Figtree 400/18px; grades and wall names JetBrains Mono 600.
- Palette: bg #F4F3EF (chalk), text #1A1A1A, hold orange #FF7A00, hold teal #00A6A6, hold pink #F2548C, line #1A1A1A. Hold colours are used as small tags only, one per circuit, as in the gym.
- Layout: the area map is the centrepiece: a line-drawn plan of the gym with numbered areas, and a list beside it (area, type, grades, reset date). Prices as a table. First-visit as three clear paths.
- Imagery: climbers on real problems shot from below with chalk in the air, hands and holds in close-up, the setting team at work; no glossy lifestyle shots.
- Motion: hovering a list row highlights its area on the plan (SVG fill change); static under reduced motion.
- Why it fits now: bouldering is one of the fastest-growing activities in UK cities, and gyms that explain the space and first visit clearly win new climbers ([The Castle Climbing Centre](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/)).
**Style variations:** Chalk: pale page, black lines · Circuit: hold-colour tags on white · Night session: #1A1A1A bg, chalk type
**Real-world basis:** [The Castle Climbing Centre: Route setting](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/route-setting) · [The Castle Climbing Centre: First visit](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/first-visit) · [Mile End Climbing Wall: First visit](https://www.mileendwall.org.uk/first-visit) · [Depot Climbing: Key information](https://www.depotclimbing.co.uk/key-information/) · [The Climbing Hangar: First climb](https://www.theclimbinghangar.com/first-climb)
**Refs:**
- [The Castle Climbing Centre: Route setting](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/route-setting): areas by name and climbing type; the model for `area`.
- [The Castle Climbing Centre: First visit](https://www.castle-climbing.co.uk/first-visit): experience-based paths and the risk form before arrival.
- [Depot Climbing: Key information](https://www.depotclimbing.co.uk/key-information/): a WordPress gym with registration, passes, prices and hours on one page.

#### 177 · Martial Arts Dojo (`dojo`)
**For:** judo, karate, aikido, BJJ and mixed dojos with age-banded classes, gradings and an instructor team.
**Templates:** front-page · page-timetable · archive-discipline · single-discipline · page-gradings · page-instructors · page-memberships · page-trial-class · page-visitor-information · page-club-rules · page-dojo-hire · page-events · page-faqs
**Patterns (~40):** timetable by age band and discipline (mini, junior, senior; judo, karate, BJJ), grade-restricted class flags ("7th Kyu +", "Brown and black belts"), term-time-only marks on kids' classes, grading table (kyu, belt colour, minimum time between gradings), grading dates, governing-body licence note, instructor profiles with grade and coaching qualifications, free trial class with arrival instructions, visitor day and week passes, what to bring (gi rental, flip-flops, padlock), club rules and etiquette, dojo hire.
**Content model:** `class` (discipline, age band, weekday, time, grade restriction, term-time only y/n), `grade` (rank, belt colour, minimum interval), `instructor` (grade, qualifications, disciplines), `grading` (date, discipline).
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (next grading), Query Filter (timetable by discipline and age), Jetpack Forms (trial booking) or Simply Schedule Appointments.
**Signature:** a grading table that maps each kyu grade to its belt colour and minimum time between gradings, linked to the next grading date (seen on: [The Budokwai: Gradings](https://budokwai.co.uk/gradings)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Free trial class page with "arrive 10 minutes early" and what happens next (seen on: [Roger Gracie Academy: Trial class](https://rogergracie.com/trial-class)).
- Visitor passes for travelling students with a what-to-bring list (seen on: [Roger Gracie Academy: Visitor information](https://rogergracie.com/visitor-information)).
- Term-time-only flags and grade restrictions in the timetable (seen on: [The Budokwai: Timetable](https://budokwai.co.uk/timetable1)).
- Instructor profiles with grades (seen on: [The Budokwai: Instructors](https://budokwai.co.uk/instructors)).
- Dojo hire page (seen on: [The Budokwai: Dojo hire](https://budokwai.co.uk/dojo-hire)).
- Printable timetable for the dojo noticeboard and parents' fridges.
**Style: Ink and tatami grid**
- Type: headings Shippori Mincho B1 800 at large sizes; body Zen Kaku Gothic New 400/18px; grades and times IBM Plex Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #111111, sumi ink #1E1E1E, tatami green #7C8B5B, hinomaru red #BC002D (one mark per page), line #D9D6CE.
- Layout: a strict grid based on tatami proportions (2:1 blocks); the timetable is the main element on the front page as a week grid; grading table in belt colours as thin bars, not badges. Wide margins, left-aligned.
- Imagery: black-and-white photos of real classes, throws caught mid-air, bowing lines at the start of class; no stock kicks against white.
- Motion: none; timetable filters swap rows instantly.
- Why it fits now: long-running dojos such as the Budokwai (founded 1918) are showing their history and etiquette openly, which is what parents and adult beginners look for ([The Budokwai](https://budokwai.co.uk/)).
**Style variations:** Tatami: green blocks on white · Sumi: #111111 bg, white type · Gi: off-white #F4F2EC page, red mark
**Real-world basis:** [The Budokwai: Timetable](https://budokwai.co.uk/timetable1) · [The Budokwai: Gradings](https://budokwai.co.uk/gradings) · [The Budokwai: Club rules](https://budokwai.co.uk/club-rules) · [Roger Gracie Academy: Trial class](https://rogergracie.com/trial-class) · [Roger Gracie Academy: Visitor information](https://rogergracie.com/visitor-information)
**Refs:**
- [The Budokwai: Gradings](https://budokwai.co.uk/gradings): kyu grades, belt colours and intervals in one table.
- [The Budokwai: Timetable](https://budokwai.co.uk/timetable1): a dense multi-discipline timetable with age bands and grade restrictions.
- [Roger Gracie Academy: Visitor information](https://rogergracie.com/visitor-information): visitor passes, booking window and what to bring.

#### 178 · Boxing Gym (`ring`)
**For:** amateur boxing clubs and independent boxing gyms offering fitness boxing, competitive squads and community programmes.
**Templates:** front-page · page-classes · page-times-and-prices · page-trainers · single-trainer · page-programmes (women, seniors, juniors, adaptive) · page-events · page-wall-of-fame · page-history · page-faq · page-contact · Woo shop
**Patterns (~40):** class timetable (fitness boxing, technique, sparring, juniors), times and prices (first trial class, pay as you go, monthly plans, yearly registration fee), trainer profiles, programme pages (women's boxing, senior boxing, non-contact class for neurodiverse members), events and shows (club shows, championships, clinics), wall of fame of club champions, club history, gallery, what to bring (wraps, gloves, water), FAQ, shop.
**Content model:** `class` (type, level, weekday, time, contact/non-contact), `trainer` (qualifications, specialisms), `boxer` (name, weight class, titles, years) for the wall of fame, `event` (date, type: show/clinic/championship).
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (upcoming shows), Simply Schedule Appointments or Cal.com (trial class, PT), WooCommerce (merch) optional, Jetpack Forms.
**Signature:** a wall of fame of the club's champions, with names, titles and years (seen on: [Repton Boxing Club: Wall of fame](https://www.reptonboxingclub.co.uk/wall-of-fame) and [Gleason's Gym: Champions](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/gleasons-champions)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Cheap first trial class, then pay-as-you-go and plans explained on one page (seen on: [East London Boxing: Times and prices](https://eastlondonboxing.co.uk/times-and-prices/)).
- Programme pages for women, seniors and neurodiverse members (seen on: [Gleason's Gym: Non-contact boxing class](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/non-contact-boxing-class-neurodiverse)).
- Trainer directory with specialisms (seen on: [Gleason's Gym: Trainers](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/trainers)).
- Membership rates with a prepay offer (seen on: [Gleason's Gym: Gym rates](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/gym-rates)).
- Events and clinics list with dates (seen on: [Gleason's Gym: Events](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/events)).
- "What to bring to your first session" list and a note on hand-wrap sales at the desk.
**Style: Fight-poster letterpress**
- Type: headings Bebas Neue 400 at poster scale for show titles and at smaller sizes elsewhere; body Public Sans 400/18px; weights, times and prices Public Sans 700 tabular.
- Palette: bg #F0ECE2 (poster stock), text #141414, fight red #C1121F, corner blue #1D4E89, gold belt #C9A227 (wall of fame only), line #141414.
- Layout: event pages built like a boxing bill: stacked names, "vs", weight class, date and venue in blocks of different sizes; the timetable and prices as bold tables. Square corners; thick rules.
- Imagery: black-and-white gym photography (bags, ring ropes, wraps, sweat), club champions in archive photos; no stock boxer silhouettes.
- Motion: none; poster blocks are static and printable.
- Why it fits now: boxing gyms from Gleason's to local amateur clubs use the fight poster as their identity, and it prints straight onto the gym wall ([Gleason's Gym](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/)).
**Style variations:** Red corner: red headers · Blue corner: blue headers · Fight night: #141414 bg, gold type
**Real-world basis:** [Gleason's Gym: Gym rates](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/gym-rates) · [Gleason's Gym: Women's boxing](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/womens-boxing) · [East London Boxing: Times and prices](https://eastlondonboxing.co.uk/times-and-prices/) · [Repton Boxing Club: Wall of fame](https://www.reptonboxingclub.co.uk/wall-of-fame)
**Refs:**
- [East London Boxing: Times and prices](https://eastlondonboxing.co.uk/times-and-prices/): a WordPress gym with a trial class, pay-as-you-go and plans clearly priced.
- [Repton Boxing Club: Wall of fame](https://www.reptonboxingclub.co.uk/wall-of-fame): a historic amateur club's champions; the `boxer` archive.
- [Gleason's Gym: Non-contact boxing class](https://www.gleasonsgym.com/non-contact-boxing-class-neurodiverse): programme pages that open boxing to new groups.

#### 179 · Swim School (`lane`)
**For:** independent swim schools teaching babies, children and adults in hired school and hotel pools.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-programme · single-programme · page-class-search · archive-venue · single-venue · page-awards · page-faqs · page-teachers · page-vouchers · page-terms
**Patterns (~40):** programme ladder by age (baby, toddler, pre-school, swim academy, adults), class finder (venue / day / time / level / spaces), venue page (pool temperature, parking, changing, step-free), award scheme / badges by stage, "what to bring" (swim nappies, towel), term dates and fees, trial lesson offer, teacher profiles with qualifications, FAQs (missed lessons, illness, goggles), gift vouchers, swimwear shop.
**Content model:** `programme` (age range, stage, duration, ratio), `class` (venue, day, time, level, spaces left, term), `venue` (address, pool temp, parking, changing notes), `teacher` (qualifications).
**Plugins:** Query Filter (class finder by venue/day/level), Advanced Query Loop (current term), Simply Schedule Appointments or an external booking link, WooCommerce (vouchers, swimwear) optional.
**Signature:** a class search by venue, day and level that shows available spaces, feeding a waiting list when full (seen on: [Puddle Ducks: Class search](https://www.puddleducks.com/class-search)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Award scheme page showing each stage's badge and skills, so parents know what "Stage 3" means (seen on: [Swimtime: Award scheme](https://www.swimtime.org/swim-lessons-award-scheme)).
- Programme pages by age with duration and what babies learn at each step (seen on: [Puddle Ducks: Dippers and Dabblers](https://www.puddleducks.com/programmes/baby-pre-school/dippers-and-dabblers)).
- FAQs on illness, missed lessons and goggles (seen on: [Puddle Ducks: FAQs](https://www.puddleducks.com/faqs)).
- Adult lessons page for nervous adult beginners (seen on: [Swimtime: Adult swimming lessons](https://www.swimtime.org/services/adult-swimming-lessons)).
- Pool temperature, changing-room layout and step-free access per venue.
- Gift vouchers for grandparents.
**Style: Pool-tile Swiss grid**
- Type: headings Quilon 700 (Fontshare) at large sizes; body Quilon 400/18px; lane numbers and times Big Shoulders Text 700 for pool signage.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #0E2233, pool blue #0077C8, tile white #F2F7FA (surface), lane rope red #E03C31, line #BFD7E6.
- Layout: an 8-column grid that echoes pool tiles (thin grid lines visible in section backgrounds, used only on the class finder); the programme ladder as lanes (one row per age, left to right). Class results as a timetable table.
- Imagery: underwater photos of real lessons (with consent), bright and sharp; poolside shots of teachers; no studio babies on white.
- Motion: none on scroll; lane rows highlight on hover; View Transitions between programme and class finder.
- Why it fits now: parents compare swim schools on phones by venue and day, and the best franchises lead with class search and clear stages ([Puddle Ducks](https://www.puddleducks.com/)).
**Style variations:** Lido: pool blue header, white · Deep end: #0E2233 bg, white type · Lane rope: red and white rules
**Real-world basis:** [Puddle Ducks: Class search](https://www.puddleducks.com/class-search) · [Swimtime: Award scheme](https://www.swimtime.org/swim-lessons-award-scheme) · [Turtle Tots UK](https://www.turtletots.com/uk) · [Water Babies](https://www.waterbabies.co.uk/)
**Refs:**
- [Puddle Ducks: Class search](https://www.puddleducks.com/class-search): the class finder is the whole business; copy its filters.
- [Swimtime: Award scheme](https://www.swimtime.org/swim-lessons-award-scheme): stages and badges explained for parents.
- [Puddle Ducks: FAQs](https://www.puddleducks.com/faqs): practical answers on illness, goggles and missed lessons.

#### 180 · Rowing / Sailing Club (`oar`)
**For:** amateur rowing and sculling clubs and small dinghy sailing clubs run by volunteer committees.
**Templates:** front-page · page-learn-to-row · page-membership · page-fees · page-squads · page-racing (head races / regattas) · archive-result · page-calendar · page-currents-and-tides · page-duties · page-venue-hire · page-safety · page-find-us
**Patterns (~40):** learn-to-row course box (course dates, free introductory session, cost), membership categories and fees, squads (development, masters, racing, juniors, coxes), race calendar (heads and regattas), results list, currents and tides guide for the stretch of river, duties / safety-boat rota explainer, sailing instructions and local rules (PDF), fleet list, club history and honours boards, venue / clubroom hire, safety and welfare.
**Content model:** `course` (start, end, intro session date, price, spaces), `race` (date, event, crew/boat, result), `squad` (coach, training times), `document` (SIs, local rules, safety plan).
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (next course, upcoming races), Jetpack Forms (learn-to-row sign-up, venue hire), The Events Calendar optional.
**Signature:** a learn-to-row page with fixed course dates, a required free introductory session and a clear route into the squads (seen on: [Furnivall Sculling Club: Learn to row](https://www.furnivall.org/learntorow)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Currents and tides explainer for the club's stretch of water, written by members (seen on: [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Currents and tides](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/currents-and-tides/)).
- Duties page (safety boat rota, work days) so new members know what's expected (seen on: [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Duties](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/duties/)).
- Fees table by membership category (seen on: [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Fees](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/fees/)).
- Results archive by race (seen on: [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Results](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/results/)).
- Head race list for the season (seen on: [Furnivall Sculling Club: Head races](https://www.furnivall.org/head-races)).
- Venue hire page for the clubroom and balcony (seen on: [Thames Rowing Club](https://www.thamesrc.co.uk/)).
**Style: Boathouse heritage (blazer and regatta)**
- Type: headings Imbue 600 (condensed didone) at large sizes; body Libre Franklin 400/18px; results and times Libre Franklin 500 with tabular figures.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #10202E, club colour #7A1F2B (maroon, swappable per club), blade white #F7F5EF, river #2D4A5A, line #D6D3CA.
- Layout: honours-board typography: gilt-style centred names only on the honours pattern, everything else left-aligned on a two-column grid. Results and fees as ruled tables. Blade-stripe motif (the club's colours) as a thin band under the header.
- Imagery: crews on the water in early light, boathouse interiors, archive photos of old eights; slim panoramic crops (3:1).
- Motion: none; hover on a race row shows the crew list inline (details element).
- Why it fits now: historic clubs lean into heritage while opening up with learn-to-row programmes, and the oldest clubs show it well ([Leander Club](https://www.leander.co.uk/)).
**Style variations:** Blade: club colours band · Dawn: river blue header · Honours: maroon bg, cream serif
**Real-world basis:** [Furnivall Sculling Club: Learn to row](https://www.furnivall.org/learntorow) · [Furnivall Sculling Club: Membership](https://www.furnivall.org/membership) · [Thames Rowing Club: Join us](https://www.thamesrc.co.uk/join-us) · [Thames Rowing Club: Rowing](https://www.thamesrc.co.uk/rowing-at-thames) · [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Currents and tides](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/currents-and-tides/)
**Refs:**
- [Furnivall Sculling Club: Learn to row](https://www.furnivall.org/learntorow): dated courses, intro session rule and route to squads.
- [Ranelagh Sailing Club: Duties](https://www.ranelaghsc.co.uk/duties/): a WordPress club site that explains duties, fees, tides and results plainly.
- [Thames Rowing Club: Join us](https://www.thamesrc.co.uk/join-us): membership paths for a large volunteer-run club.

#### 181 · Surf School (`swell`)
**For:** independent surf schools on one or two beaches, often also running SUP, coasteering and surf hire.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-lesson · single-lesson · page-surf-cam · page-surf-hire · page-clubs · page-adaptive-surfing · page-beach-safety · page-faqs · page-booking-conditions · page-gift-vouchers · page-where-to-stay
**Patterns (~40):** lessons list (half day, two lessons, weekend, 5-day course, private) with price and what's included, live surf cam embed, "what's included" list (board, wetsuit, 2 hours base-to-base), minimum age and swimming ability, group discount note ("book 4, £5 off each"), kids' summer camp, women's surf club, adaptive surfing sessions, beach safety guide, booking conditions (cancellation, weather), gift vouchers, where to stay nearby.
**Content model:** `lesson` (duration, price, min age, group size, includes), `club` (day, level), `faq`.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce for vouchers (or Bookeo/FareHarbor embed for bookings), Jetpack Forms (group enquiries).
**Signature:** a live surf cam page tied to the lesson pages, so people can see the conditions before booking (seen on: [Surf South West: Live surf cam](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/live-surf-cam/) and [Harlyn Surf School: Webcam](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/harlyn-webcam/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "What's included" and price panel with a multi-person discount (seen on: [Harlyn Surf School: Surf lessons](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/surf-lessons/)).
- Adaptive surfing page for disabled surfers (seen on: [Surf South West: Adaptive surfing](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/adaptive-surfing-devon/)).
- Women-only surf club with its own sessions (seen on: [Big Blue Surf School: Sirens ladies surf club](https://www.bigbluesurfschool.com/clubs/sirens-ladies-surf-club/)).
- Booking conditions covering weather cancellations and refunds (seen on: [Big Blue Surf School: Booking conditions](https://www.bigbluesurfschool.com/booking-conditions/)).
- Beach safety page (flags, rips, lifeguards) (seen on: [Harlyn Surf School: Beach safety](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/beach-safety/)).
- Gift vouchers (seen on: [Harlyn Surf School: Gift vouchers](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/gift-vouchers/)).
**Style: Sun-faded tide table**
- Type: headings Styro 800 (Fontshare), used big and short; body Satoshi 400/18px (Fontshare); times and prices Chivo Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #F4F1E8 (salt-bleached paper), text #1E2B2F, sea #1B6F7A, sunset coral #EF6F4C, sand #E3D3B0, line #1E2B2F.
- Layout: the front page opens with the surf cam still and today's lesson times in a tide-table layout (big mono numbers); lessons as a two-column list with price right-aligned; FAQs as plain headings, not an accordion.
- Imagery: film-look photos of real lessons with grain and a warm fade, shot from the water; board-rack and van details; no drone-only hero.
- Motion: the cam still refreshes every 60 seconds (no autoplay video); nothing else moves.
- Why it fits now: surf schools sell on trust and conditions, and the strongest lead with the live cam and plain lesson facts ([Surf South West](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/)).
**Style variations:** Salt: bleached paper, teal · Sunset: coral headers · Winter: #1E2B2F bg, sand type
**Real-world basis:** [Surf South West: Half day lessons](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/learn-to-surf/half-day-surf-lesson/) · [Harlyn Surf School: Surf lessons](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/surf-lessons/) · [Big Blue Surf School: Surf lessons](https://www.bigbluesurfschool.com/surf-lessons/) · [Surf South West: Q&A](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/questions-and-answers/) · [Lusty Glaze: Surf cam](https://www.lustyglaze.co.uk/surf-cam/)
**Refs:**
- [Harlyn Surf School: Surf lessons](https://www.harlynsurfschool.co.uk/surf-lessons/): a WordPress school with inclusions, price, minimum age and group discount on one page.
- [Surf South West: Live surf cam](https://www.surfsouthwest.com/live-surf-cam/): the cam as a sales tool.
- [Big Blue Surf School: Sirens ladies surf club](https://www.bigbluesurfschool.com/clubs/sirens-ladies-surf-club/): clubs that turn one-off lessons into regulars.

#### 182 · Personal Trainer (`pt`)
**For:** independent personal trainers and small PT studios selling 1:1 sessions, packages and online coaching.
**Templates:** front-page · page-personal-training · page-online-coaching · page-prices · page-assessments · archive-coach · single-coach · page-apply · page-faqs · archive (articles) · page-contact
**Patterns (~35):** services list (1:1 PT, small group, online coaching, nutrition), price list with packs (single / 10 / 25 sessions, senior trainer rates), assessment menu (strength and movement profile, VO₂), coach profile (qualifications, specialisms, availability), coaching application form (goals, history, injuries), what a first session looks like, FAQs, articles by topic, podcast list, location and studio photos.
**Content model:** `coach` (qualifications, specialisms, accepting clients y/n, rate tier), `service` (format, duration, price, pack sizes), `article` categories.
**Plugins:** Simply Schedule Appointments or Cal.com embed (consultation booking), Jetpack Forms (application), WooCommerce only for selling packs online.
**Signature:** a transparent price page listing single sessions and 10/25-session packs per trainer tier (seen on: [Matt Roberts: Prices](https://mattroberts.co.uk/prices/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Coaching application form that asks goals, training history and injuries before a call (seen on: [Stronger By Science: Coaching application](https://www.strongerbyscience.com/coaching/application/)).
- Individual coach pages with qualifications and specialisms (seen on: [Stronger By Science: Coach Colby Sousa](https://www.strongerbyscience.com/coaching/colby-sousa/)).
- Assessment page describing what's measured and why (seen on: [Matt Roberts: Strength and movement profile](https://mattroberts.co.uk/strength-movement-profile/)).
- "Accepting new clients / waitlist" toggle per coach.
- FAQ covering cancellations and missed sessions (seen on: [Bret Contreras: FAQs](https://bretcontreras.com/faqs/)).
- Printable rate card PDF generated from the price page.
**Style: Lab report performance data**
- Type: headings Oxanium 700 at large sizes, used sparingly; body Hanken Grotesk 400/18px; measurements and prices IBM Plex Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #151515, chalk #EFEFEA (surface), signal orange #FF5A1F, steel #4A5A66, line #151515.
- Layout: the price list as a proper table with packs in columns; coach pages as a spec sheet (photo, qualifications, specialisms, availability in mono). Front page: one sentence on who the trainer helps, then prices, then the application. No transformation-photo grid.
- Imagery: real sessions in the actual studio, shot with harsh gym light and kept un-retouched; equipment close-ups; no shirtless before/after.
- Motion: none on scroll; table rows highlight on hover; the application form steps with View Transitions.
- Why it fits now: clients now expect evidence-based coaching and clear pricing up front rather than hype ([Stronger By Science: Coaching](https://www.strongerbyscience.com/coaching/)).
**Style variations:** Chalk: chalk surface, black type · Signal: orange headers · Gym floor: #151515 bg, chalk type
**Real-world basis:** [Matt Roberts: Personal training](https://mattroberts.co.uk/personal-training/) · [Matt Roberts: Team](https://mattroberts.co.uk/team/) · [Stronger By Science: Coaching](https://www.strongerbyscience.com/coaching/) · [Bret Contreras: FAQs](https://bretcontreras.com/faqs/)
**Refs:**
- [Matt Roberts: Prices](https://mattroberts.co.uk/prices/): a WordPress PT studio publishing all its prices and packs.
- [Stronger By Science: Coaching application](https://www.strongerbyscience.com/coaching/application/): application-first online coaching; copy the questions.
- [Bret Contreras: FAQs](https://bretcontreras.com/faqs/): a trainer's WordPress site with articles and FAQs.

#### 183 · Esports Team (`clutch`)
**For:** semi-pro and grassroots esports organisations, university teams and small orgs with rosters across a few titles.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-team · single-team (roster per title) · single-player · archive-match · page-schedule · page-partners · page-community · page-safeguarding · archive (news) · Woo shop · single-product
**Patterns (~40):** roster per game (player, handle, role, country), player profile (setup, socials, stream link), match schedule and results (opponent, event, score, VOD), Twitch live embed, partners wall, pro-kit / jersey drop, community page (Discord, events), women-in-gaming programme, safeguarding policy, careers, wallpapers download, news.
**Content model:** `team` (game, league), `player` (handle, role, country, team, status: active/benched/alumni), `match` (date, opponent, event, score, VOD URL), `partner`.
**Plugins:** WooCommerce (merch), Advanced Query Loop (upcoming vs past matches), Query Filter (by game).
**Signature:** separate roster pages per game title, each with player cards and handles (seen on: [Karmine Corp: Valorant roster](https://www.karminecorp.fr/pages/nos-joueurs-valorant)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Safeguarding page with a named lead, needed for orgs with junior players (seen on: [Guild Esports: Safeguarding](https://www.guildesports.com/safeguarding)).
- Women-in-gaming programme page (seen on: [Guild Esports: The Lobby](https://www.guildesports.com/womeningaming)).
- Downloadable wallpapers for fans (seen on: [Fnatic: Wallpapers](https://fnatic.com/company/wallpapers)).
- Pro-kit collection page for the season's jersey (seen on: [Fnatic: 2026 Pro Kit](https://fnatic.com/collections/pro-kit-2026)).
- Match times shown in the visitor's local timezone.
- Fan roadtrip / watch-party events page (seen on: [Karmine Corp: LEC Summer Roadtrip](https://www.karminecorp.fr/pages/lec-summer-roadtrip-2026)).
**Style: Kit-launch sportswear editorial**
- Type: headings Goldman 700 at large sizes; body Figtree 400/18px; handles and scores Reddit Mono 500.
- Palette: bg #F5F5F2, text #0F0F0F, team colour #0047FF (swappable per org), kit white #FFFFFF, warning yellow #FFE14D, line #0F0F0F.
- Layout: light, fashion-editorial pages: roster as big player photos in a 3-column grid with handle in mono beneath; match schedule as a plain table with local time; the shop styled like a kit launch lookbook. No dark neon HUD, no angled clip-path panels.
- Imagery: players photographed in the org's kit against flat colour backdrops, like a football kit launch; event photos from LAN days.
- Motion: player photos swap to an action shot on hover (instant, no zoom); View Transitions between roster and player page.
- Why it fits now: leading orgs now present as fashion and lifestyle brands with kit drops and lookbooks, not neon gamer UIs ([Karmine Corp](https://www.karminecorp.fr/)).
**Style variations:** Home kit: team blue on white · Away kit: yellow on off-white · Third kit: #0F0F0F bg, white
**Real-world basis:** [Karmine Corp: Valorant roster](https://www.karminecorp.fr/pages/nos-joueurs-valorant) · [Guild Esports: Teams](https://www.guildesports.com/teams) · [Fnatic: Community](https://fnatic.com/community) · [Guild Esports: Safeguarding](https://www.guildesports.com/safeguarding)
**Refs:**
- [Karmine Corp: Valorant roster](https://www.karminecorp.fr/pages/nos-joueurs-valorant): roster pages per title, with the shop and fan events around them.
- [Guild Esports: Teams](https://www.guildesports.com/teams): a mid-size org with teams, safeguarding and a women-in-gaming programme.
- [Fnatic: Wallpapers](https://fnatic.com/company/wallpapers): small fan-service extras that keep supporters coming back.

#### 184 · Athlete Personal Site (`athlete`)
**For:** professional and semi-pro athletes in climbing, running, cycling and outdoor sports who need a bio, highlights, partners and a press kit.
**Templates:** front-page · page-bio · archive-highlight · single-highlight · page-results · page-speaking · page-press · page-partners · archive (updates) · page-contact · Woo shop (optional)
**Patterns (~30):** highlights list (ascents, races, records with date and grade/time), bio (short and long versions), results table by season, speaking page with topics and booking contact, press kit (bios, approved photos, media contacts by region), press and podcast appearances list, partners wall with links, updates/journal, Strava or training log embed, shop (book, merch).
**Content model:** `highlight` (date, type: ascent/race/record, grade or time, location), `result` (event, date, position, time), `press_item` (outlet, date, type: article/podcast/film, link), `partner`.
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (latest highlights), Query Filter (press by type), WooCommerce optional; Strava embed.
**Signature:** a press page with media contacts by region, downloadable photos and a list of press, podcast, book and film appearances (seen on: [Adam Ondra: Press info](https://www.adamondra.com/press-kit/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Highlights archive of key ascents or races with dates (seen on: [Adam Ondra: Highlights](https://www.adamondra.com/highlights/)).
- Speaking page with topics and a booking route through an agent (seen on: [Alex Honnold: Speaking](https://www.alexhonnold.com/speaking)).
- Press list by outlet (seen on: [Alex Honnold: Press](https://www.alexhonnold.com/press)).
- Short, medium and long bios for organisers to copy, plus approved photo credits.
- Partners page with the gear actually used.
- Foundation or cause page for athletes who run one (seen on: [Alex Honnold](https://www.alexhonnold.com/)).
**Style: Expedition photo journal**
- Type: headings Bonny 500 (Fontshare) at large sizes; body General Sans 400/18px (Fontshare); dates, grades and times Martian Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #161616, rock grey #8A8A84, ochre #C98A2B (accent), glacier #DCE6EA (surface), line #161616.
- Layout: photo-led: each highlight is a full-width photograph with a caption row of mono facts (date, grade, location); bio and press set in a narrow column. Press kit as a plain list of files with sizes.
- Imagery: expedition and race photography by named photographers, full bleed, credited in every caption; no logo-heavy sponsor collages.
- Motion: none; images use native lazy loading and the core lightbox.
- Why it fits now: athletes are building their own channels away from social platforms and use photo-led personal sites with a proper press area ([Adam Ondra](https://www.adamondra.com/)).
**Style variations:** Summit: white, ochre accents · Basecamp: glacier surface · Night ascent: #161616 bg, white
**Real-world basis:** [Adam Ondra: Highlights](https://www.adamondra.com/highlights/) · [Adam Ondra: Press info](https://www.adamondra.com/press-kit/) · [Alex Honnold: Speaking](https://www.alexhonnold.com/speaking) · [Emily Harrington: Speaking](https://emilyharrington.com/speaking) · [Tommy Caldwell](https://www.tommycaldwell.com/)
**Refs:**
- [Adam Ondra: Press info](https://www.adamondra.com/press-kit/): the best athlete press page: contacts by region and appearances by type.
- [Adam Ondra: Highlights](https://www.adamondra.com/highlights/): highlights as dated entries; the `highlight` model.
- [Alex Honnold: Speaking](https://www.alexhonnold.com/speaking): a simple speaking page with a booking route.

### XVIII. Faith & spirituality

<a id="185"></a>
#### 185 · Small Congregation / Place of Worship, any faith (`gather`)
**For:** small churches, synagogues, mosques, gurdwaras, temples and meeting houses run by clergy and volunteers.
**Templates:** front-page · page-services (service or prayer times) · page-whats-on · single-event · archive-sermon (sermons, talks, thought for the week) · page-life-events · page-community · page-venue-hire · page-giving · page-visit-us · page-safeguarding · page-clergy-and-staff
**Patterns (~45):** service times block (Sunday 11am, in person and online), prayer-times table (Begins / Jamā'ah per prayer, monthly), what's-on list with filters (services / music / exhibitions / groups), sermon or thought-for-the-week archive with audio, livestream / live audio link, life events pages (birth, bar/bat mitzvah, marriage, funerals, conversion), community groups (20s–30s, LGBTQ+, youth, drop-in), venue hire, giving / donate, visit us (history, access, what to expect), safeguarding contacts, newsletter sign-up.
**Content model:** `service` (day, time, format: in person/online/both, livestream URL), `prayer_time` (date, prayer, begins, congregation) imported monthly, `sermon` (date, speaker, reading, audio), `event` with category taxonomy, `group`.
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar or companion `event` + Advanced Query Loop, Query Filter (what's on by category), Seriously Simple Podcasting (sermon audio), GiveWP (giving), Polylang (multilingual congregations).
**Signature:** a daily times table for worship: prayer times with "Begins" and "Jamā'ah" columns for mosques, or a service block with livestream link for churches and synagogues (seen on: [East London Mosque: Prayer times](https://www.eastlondonmosque.org.uk/prayer-times) and [St James's Piccadilly: Sunday service](https://www.sjp.org.uk/sunday-service/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- What's-on filters by type (services / music / exhibitions / LGBTQ+) (seen on: [St James's Piccadilly: What's on](https://www.sjp.org.uk/whats-on/?_filter=services)).
- Life-cycle pages for births, weddings, illness and bereavement, with who to contact (seen on: [Alyth: Care and life cycle](https://www.alyth.org.uk/care-life-cycle/)).
- Live audio or livestream page for people who can't attend (seen on: [East London Mosque: Live audio](https://www.eastlondonmosque.org.uk/live-audio)).
- Venue hire page with rooms and rates (seen on: [St John's Waterloo: Venue hire](https://stjohnswaterloo.org/venue-hire/)).
- Resources and sermons archive (seen on: [Alyth: Resources and sermons](https://www.alyth.org.uk/about/resources-sermons/)).
- Step-free access, hearing loop and "what to expect at your first visit" on the visit page; printable monthly timetable PDF.
**Style: Parish noticeboard editorial serif**
- Type: headings Prata 400 at large sizes (as seen on St John's Waterloo); body Mulish 400/18px; times and dates Mulish 700 with tabular figures.
- Palette: bg #FFFFFF, text #1F1B16, stone #EAE6DF (surface), liturgical colour #6E1E2B (swappable: green, purple, gold), brass #A07A2C, line #CFC8BC.
- Layout: a noticeboard front page: this week's times on the left in a big table, what's on to the right, one image of the building. Pages are single-column with generous margins. Service and prayer tables are real tables with sticky header rows.
- Imagery: the building and its people in natural light, details of stone, glass and textiles; community events with consent; no stock praying hands.
- Motion: none; today's row in the times table is highlighted server-side.
- Why it fits now: arts-led congregations use editorial type and photography to look like the cultural venues they also are ([St John's Waterloo](https://stjohnswaterloo.org/)).
**Style variations:** Ordinary time: green accent · Advent: purple accent · Stone: warm grey surface, black type
**Real-world basis:** [East London Mosque: Prayer times](https://www.eastlondonmosque.org.uk/prayer-times) · [St James's Piccadilly: Sunday service](https://www.sjp.org.uk/sunday-service/) · [St James's Piccadilly: Thought for the week](https://www.sjp.org.uk/thought-for-the-week/) · [Alyth: Resources and sermons](https://www.alyth.org.uk/about/resources-sermons/) · [New London Synagogue: Celebrate life with us](https://www.newlondon.org.uk/celebrate-life-with-us/) · [St John's Waterloo: Worship](https://stjohnswaterloo.org/worship/)
**Refs:**
- [East London Mosque: Prayer times](https://www.eastlondonmosque.org.uk/prayer-times): the monthly prayer table with begins and congregation times; copy its columns exactly.
- [St James's Piccadilly: What's on](https://www.sjp.org.uk/whats-on/?_filter=services): a WordPress church with filtered listings.
- [Alyth: Care and life cycle](https://www.alyth.org.uk/care-life-cycle/): life-cycle pages that tell members who to call and when.

<a id="186"></a>
#### 186 · Meditation Centre (`sit`)
**For:** urban meditation centres, zendos and sanghas offering drop-in sits, courses, retreats and online practice.
**Templates:** front-page · page-weekly-schedule · page-learn-to-meditate · archive-course · single-course · archive-talk (dharma talks) · page-online-practice · page-retreats · page-teachers · page-community-groups · page-ethics · page-support-us
**Patterns (~35):** weekly schedule (daily lunchtime sit, evening classes, weekend), learn-to-meditate / newcomers session, course listings (dated, beginner/ongoing), events filtered by type (zazen / class / sesshin / engaged practice), dharma talk archive with audio (podcast), online zendo link and times, affinity groups (people of colour, LGBTQIA+, under-30s, recovery), teachers, ethics statement, dana / membership / donate.
**Content model:** `session` (weekday, time, format, drop-in y/n), `course` (start date, weeks, level, price or dana), `talk` (date, teacher, audio), `event` with type taxonomy, `group`.
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar (or companion `event` + Advanced Query Loop), Seriously Simple Podcasting (talks), GiveWP (dana / membership), Query Filter.
**Signature:** a weekly schedule page with a daily drop-in sit at a fixed time, followed by dated classes and courses (seen on: [London Buddhist Centre: Meditation](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/explore/meditation)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Newcomers' session page that explains what happens, what to wear and where to sit (seen on: [Village Zendo: Learn to meditate](https://villagezendo.org/events/learn-to-meditate/)).
- Affinity group pathways (people of colour, LGBTQIA+, under-30s, recovery) (seen on: [London Buddhist Centre: What's on](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/whats-on)).
- Dharma talk podcast archive (seen on: [Brooklyn Zen Center: Podcast](https://brooklynzen.org/podcast/)).
- Online sitting times shown in the visitor's timezone (seen on: [Village Zendo: Online zendo](https://villagezendo.org/online-zendo)).
- Dana (pay what you can) explained alongside suggested amounts; "Class full, join waitlist" state on courses.
**Style: Quiet signage**
- Type: headings Murecho 500 at large sizes (a quiet, Japanese-drawn sans); body Murecho 400/19px with 1.6 line-height; times in Murecho 500 tabular.
- Palette: bg #FAFAF7, text #232323, ink blue #25405F, saffron #D9912B (small accents), cushion grey #E6E4DE, line #CFCCC4.
- Layout: very few elements per screen: this week's schedule as a big, calm table; lots of white space but a strict left edge; no hero image, just the name of today's session and time.
- Imagery: the empty shrine room, cushions, shoes at the door, a few portraits of teachers in available light.
- Motion: none at all; even hover is a colour change only.
- Why it fits now: people looking to meditate want a calm timetable, not a wellness brand, and the London Buddhist Centre's plain, signage-like type does exactly that ([London Buddhist Centre](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/)).
**Style variations:** Morning: pale page, ink blue · Evening: #232323 bg, warm white · Saffron: saffron rules and links
**Real-world basis:** [London Buddhist Centre: Meditation](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/explore/meditation) · [London Buddhist Centre: What's on](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/whats-on) · [Village Zendo: Learn to meditate](https://villagezendo.org/events/learn-to-meditate/) · [Brooklyn Zen Center: Zen practice](https://brooklynzen.org/zen-practice/)
**Refs:**
- [London Buddhist Centre: Meditation](https://www.londonbuddhistcentre.com/explore/meditation): weekly schedule with a daily drop-in, then dated classes.
- [Village Zendo: Learn to meditate](https://villagezendo.org/events/learn-to-meditate/): a WordPress zendo's newcomer page.
- [Brooklyn Zen Center: Zen practice](https://brooklynzen.org/zen-practice/): practice overview with events filtered by type.

<a id="187"></a>
#### 187 · Tarot / Astrology Practitioner (`arcana`)
**For:** independent tarot readers and astrologers offering readings and consultations, writing horoscopes and running workshops.
**Templates:** front-page · page-book (readings and FAQ) · archive-horoscope · single-horoscope · taxonomy-sign · archive-card (card meanings) · single-card · page-workshops · page-birth-chart · page-shop · page-about · page-newsletter
**Patterns (~35):** readings menu (length, format: video/phone/in person/recording, price), booking FAQ (returning clients, gift readings, sliding scale), weekly or monthly horoscope with one page per sign, card meanings library (Major Arcana, then suits), birth-chart tool link, workshops and courses, podcast episodes, deck shop (with maker info), newsletter archive, ethics/disclaimer.
**Content model:** `horoscope` (period, sign, text), `card` (arcana, suit, number, upright, reversed, keywords), `reading` (duration, format, price), `sign` taxonomy.
**Plugins:** Cal.com embed or Simply Schedule Appointments (booking), WooCommerce (decks, gift readings), Jetpack Newsletter.
**Signature:** a weekly horoscope with a deep-linkable view for each sign (seen on: [Jessica Lanyadoo: Weekly horoscope](https://www.jessicalanyadoo.com/weekly-horoscope)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Booking FAQ that covers returning clients, gifted readings and whether the sliding scale is open (seen on: [Alice Sparkly Kat: Book](https://alicesparklykat.com/book)).
- "Not scheduling consultations right now" state that swaps the booking button for a waitlist (seen on: [Jessica Lanyadoo: FAQ](https://www.jessicalanyadoo.com/faq)).
- Card meanings library, card by card (seen on: [Little Red Tarot: Tarot card library](https://littleredtarot.com/learn-tarot/library/)).
- Referral list of other endorsed astrologers when fully booked (seen on: [The Astrology Podcast: Consultations](https://theastrologypodcast.com/consultations/)).
- Gift reading vouchers; birth-time guidance ("check your birth certificate") before booking.
**Style: Esoteric editorial serif with mono**
- Type: headings Boska 500 (Fontshare) at large sizes; body Sentient 400/18px (Fontshare); dates, degrees and card numbers Martian Mono 400.
- Palette: bg #F6F2EA, text #1C1A1F, deep oxblood #5B1A24, verdigris #3E7A6E, gold leaf #B8913A, line #1C1A1F.
- Layout: a periodical, not a mystic shop: the horoscope index is a 12-row table (sign, dates, first line); each sign page is one column with the period in mono. Card library as a numbered list with small card scans. Hairline rules, square corners.
- Imagery: real scans of decks (with permission) and hand-drawn chart wheels; no nebula backgrounds, no purple starfields.
- Motion: none; the sign selector is a simple list, not a spinning wheel.
- Why it fits now: the most read astrologers present their work as serious editorial writing with serif and mono type ([Chani Nicholas: Aries](https://www.chaninicholas.com/signs/aries)).
**Style variations:** Almanac: warm paper, black ink · Oxblood: oxblood headers · New moon: #1C1A1F bg, paper type
**Real-world basis:** [Alice Sparkly Kat: Book](https://alicesparklykat.com/book) · [Jessica Lanyadoo: Weekly horoscope](https://www.jessicalanyadoo.com/weekly-horoscope) · [The Astrology Podcast: Consultations](https://theastrologypodcast.com/consultations/) · [Little Red Tarot: Tarot card library](https://littleredtarot.com/learn-tarot/library/) · [Chani Nicholas: Aries](https://www.chaninicholas.com/signs/aries)
**Refs:**
- [Jessica Lanyadoo: Weekly horoscope](https://www.jessicalanyadoo.com/weekly-horoscope): one horoscope, twelve linkable views.
- [Little Red Tarot: Tarot card library](https://littleredtarot.com/learn-tarot/library/): a WordPress reader's card-meanings library and deck shop.
- [Alice Sparkly Kat: Book](https://alicesparklykat.com/book): honest booking FAQ with gift readings and sliding-scale status.

#### 188 · Retreat Centre (`retreat`)
**For:** small meditation, yoga and spiritual retreat centres with residential programmes, personal retreats and venue hire.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-retreat · single-retreat · page-personal-retreats · page-rates · page-financial-assistance · page-accommodation · page-daily-timetable · page-getting-here · page-retreat-faq · page-venue-hire · page-teachers · page-donate
**Patterns (~40):** retreat programme list (dates, teacher, length, places left), rates table (by room type, with dana note), financial assistance / bursary page, personal (self-led) retreats, accommodation and rooms, daily timetable (wake-up bell to lights out), getting here (train, taxi, lift share), retreat FAQ (what to bring, silence, phones), venue hire with availability calendar, teachers, donate / dana, booking conditions.
**Content model:** `retreat` (start, end, teacher, type: silent/led/personal, places, price band), `room` (type, price, accessible y/n), `teacher`.
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar + Event Tickets (or companion `retreat` + Advanced Query Loop), GiveWP (dana), MotoPress Hotel Booking Lite (rooms for personal retreats), Jetpack Forms (bursary application, lift share).
**Signature:** a rates page with a clear financial-assistance route and an explanation of dana (generosity) for teachers (seen on: [Gaia House: Retreat rates](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/booking-conditions/retreat-rates/) and [Financial assistance](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/booking-conditions/financial-assistance/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Lift share board for guests travelling from the station (seen on: [Gaia House: Lift share board](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/getting-here/lift-share-board/)).
- Published daily timetable so guests know what a day looks like (seen on: [Samye Ling: Travel info and daily timetable](https://samyeling.org/visiting/travel-info-daily-timetable/)).
- Venue hire availability calendar (seen on: [Trigonos: Venue hire availability](https://www.trigonos.org/venue-hire-availability-calendar)).
- "Places left / waitlist" state on each retreat.
- Retreat FAQ covering silence, phones and what to bring, plus a printable packing list (seen on: [Gaia House: Retreat FAQ](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/retreats/retreat-faq/)).
**Style: Landscape-led quiet serif**
- Type: headings Gilda Display 400 at large sizes (as on Trigonos); body Literata 400/18px; dates and prices Literata 500 small caps with tabular figures.
- Palette: bg #FBFAF6, text #25302B, slate #56676B, moss #5C7148, lichen #D9DDCB (surface), line #C6C9BA.
- Layout: a big landscape photo per retreat with the facts (dates, teacher, price band, places) set beside it in a narrow column; the programme as a year list grouped by month. Rates as one clear table; FAQ as headings.
- Imagery: the house and land through the seasons, rooms as they are, weather included; no yoga-pose stock.
- Motion: none; month headings stick while scrolling the programme.
- Why it fits now: retreat centres win bookings with honest pictures of place and plain facts about cost and support ([Trigonos](https://www.trigonos.org/)).
**Style variations:** Winter: slate header, pale page · Meadow: moss accents · Night silence: #25302B bg, lichen type
**Real-world basis:** [Gaia House: Retreat rates](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/booking-conditions/retreat-rates/) · [Gaia House: Personal retreats](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/retreats/personal-retreats/) · [Samye Ling: Travel info and daily timetable](https://samyeling.org/visiting/travel-info-daily-timetable/) · [Trigonos: Venue hire availability](https://www.trigonos.org/venue-hire-availability-calendar) · [Findhorn: Experiences](https://www.findhorn.org/experiences)
**Refs:**
- [Gaia House: Retreat rates](https://gaiahouse.co.uk/booking-conditions/retreat-rates/): a WordPress retreat centre with rates, dana and financial assistance side by side.
- [Samye Ling: Travel info and daily timetable](https://samyeling.org/visiting/travel-info-daily-timetable/): the daily timetable and travel on one page.
- [Trigonos: Venue hire availability](https://www.trigonos.org/venue-hire-availability-calendar): an availability calendar for group hire.

### XIX. Travel & outdoors

<a id="189"></a>
#### 189 · Walking Tour Guide (`guide`)
**For:** a solo Blue Badge or city guide, or a small collective of 3–10 guides, running scheduled public walks and private tours in one city.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-walk · single-walk · page-walks-by-date · archive-guide · single-guide · page-private-tours · page-gift-vouchers · page-faq · page-contact
**Patterns (~40):** "walks by date" day schedule (time / walk / meeting point / guide), walk detail header (duration, price by adult / student / child / concession, days and start time), meeting-point block ("Tower Hill Tube, by the coffee stand") with map, "just turn up or book ahead" note, guide profile card (Blue Badge / City of London Guide credentials, languages), walks by era (Roman / Medieval / Tudor / Victorian) and by area, private and group tour enquiry form, gift voucher block, cancellation and accessibility notes, press quote strip, walk podcast episode list.
**Content model:** `walk` (duration, meeting_point, meeting_lat/lng, price tiers, weekdays, start_time, booking_url), `departure` (walk, date, time, guide, spaces) linked to a walk, `guide` (credentials, languages, bio), taxonomies `era` and `area`.
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (upcoming departures by date), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (meeting-point pin), Jetpack Forms (private tour enquiry), optional FareHarbor or Cal.com embed for paid booking.
**Signature:** a "Walks by date" page that lists each day's departures in time order with walk title, meeting point (down to the station exit) and the named guide linked to their profile, driven by `departure` posts and Advanced Query Loop (seen on: [London Walks](https://www.walks.com/our-walks/walks-by-date/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "No need to book, just turn up" line on walks that allow it, next to the online booking link (seen on: [London Walks: Jack the Ripper](https://www.walks.com/our-walks/jack-the-ripper-walking-tour/)).
- Non-running dates on the walk page ("Not on 24–25 December") that hide those departures automatically (seen on: [London Walks: Jack the Ripper](https://www.walks.com/our-walks/jack-the-ripper-walking-tour/)).
- Gift vouchers for any amount, emailed to the recipient or printed for a card, valid 24 months, with a redeem page (seen on: [London Guided Walks: gift voucher](https://londonguidedwalks.co.uk/gift-voucher/)).
- Accessibility paragraph per walk (terrain, flat or stepped, pace, comfort breaks) plus a plain 48-hour cancellation rule (seen on: [Oxford Official Walking Tours: ghost tour](https://www.oxfordofficialwalkingtours.org/tours/oxford-ghost-tour/)).
- schema.org `TouristTrip` and `Event` markup on each departure so dates show in search.
**Style: Editorial serif revival (pocket guidebook)**
- Type: Headings: Martel 600 upright, 76–96px, line-height 1.0; body: Martel 400/19px, 68ch measure; times and meeting points: IBM Plex Mono 500 16px, normal case.
- Palette: bg #ECEEE8 (pale sage guidebook paper) / text #1B1A17 / accent #DC241F (Underground-map red, used only for times and "meet at") / surface #DDE1D8 / line #1B1A17.
- Layout: two-column book spread on desktop, left column a fixed "departure board" of times, right column long text; hairline rules between entries instead of cards. Radii: 0 on images and lists, 2px on buttons and inputs. Home page opens on today's walks, not a hero image. Top nav: Walks / By date / Guides / Private tours.
- Imagery: guides photographed on location mid-talk, 4:5 portrait crops, lightly desaturated; archival engravings and old street maps as full-bleed section breaks.
- Motion: View Transitions between the date list and a walk page (title carries across); horizontal date strip with scroll-snap; everything static under prefers-reduced-motion.
- Why it fits now: small publishers and guidebook makers have moved back to bookish, serif-led layouts that read as local and trustworthy, e.g. [Hoxton Mini Press](https://www.hoxtonminipress.com/).
**Style variations:** Night walk: #121212 bg, sodium #F2A33A times · Blue Plaque: #1F3F7A panels, white serif · Tube Map: white bg, line colours per era
**Real-world basis:** [London Walks: Jack the Ripper walk](https://www.walks.com/our-walks/jack-the-ripper-walking-tour/), [London Walks: guides](https://www.walks.com/guides/), [London Guided Walks: calendar](https://londonguidedwalks.co.uk/calendar/), [Oxford Official Walking Tours: ghost tour](https://www.oxfordofficialwalkingtours.org/tours/oxford-ghost-tour/)
**Refs:**
- [London Walks: walks by date](https://www.walks.com/our-walks/walks-by-date/): the daily schedule with time, meeting point exit and linked guide name; the core of the theme.
- [London Walks: our guides](https://www.walks.com/guides/): character-driven guide bios with credentials (Blue Badge, City guide) up front.
- [Oxford Official Walking Tours: Oxford Ghost Tour](https://www.oxfordofficialwalkingtours.org/tours/oxford-ghost-tour/): a clear walk page: exact meeting point, price tiers, duration, accessibility, cancellation, booking widget.

#### 190 · Adventure Operator: kayak, hiking, climbing trips (`expedition`)
**For:** a small licensed outdoor company (2–15 staff) running guided day trips and multi-day kayak, hiking or climbing expeditions from one base.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-trip · single-trip · page-departures · archive-guide · page-booking-terms · page-kit-list · page-faq · page-find-us · page-reviews
**Patterns (~45):** trip listing (region, days/nights, grade colour, next departure), grading key (e.g. Green / Blue with what each means in hours and experience), departures table (trip / dates / spaces left / Sold out), day-by-day itinerary, "what's included / not included" lists, kit list with "we supply / you bring", group-size price table (1 person / 2–4 / 5+), deposit and cancellation terms, guides with qualifications (British Canoeing / SCA coach level, Mountain Leader), wildlife you may see, weather and tide note, find-us block with directions.
**Content model:** `trip` (activity, region, days, nights, grade, price_from, included, not_included, itinerary rows, carbon_kg, itinerary_pdf), `departure` (trip, start_date, end_date, spaces, status), `guide` (qualifications), taxonomies `activity`, `region`, `grade`.
**Plugins:** Advanced Query Loop (future departures ordered by date), Query Filter (activity / region / grade), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (put-in and base location), Jetpack Forms (enquiry), optional FareHarbor embed or WooCommerce deposits.
**Signature:** a departures table that lists every upcoming date for every trip with the number of spaces remaining and a "Sold out" state, filterable by date, region and grade (seen on: [Wilderness Scotland: sea kayaking](https://www.wildernessscotland.com/adventure-holidays/sea-kayaking/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- Carbon footprint in kg shown on every trip, next to the grade (seen on: [Wilderness Scotland: sea kayaking](https://www.wildernessscotland.com/adventure-holidays/sea-kayaking/)).
- Downloadable PDF itinerary per trip, generated from a bound file field (seen on: [Wilderness Scotland: sea kayaking](https://www.wildernessscotland.com/adventure-holidays/sea-kayaking/)).
- Licence and accreditation row with real numbers: AALS licence, WiSe wildlife-safe operator, coach level (seen on: [Sea Kayak Scotland](https://www.seakayakscotland.com/)).
- Price-by-group-size table so solo paddlers see the real cost before enquiring (seen on: [Sea Kayak Scotland: booking charges](https://www.seakayakscotland.com/booking-charges/)).
- "Free pickup and drop-off" and "bring shoes that can get wet" practical notes on each trip (seen on: [Rockhopper Scotland: multi-day trips](https://www.rockhopperscotland.co.uk/all-activities/guided-multi-day-kayak-trips/)).
**Style: Field-manual utility (outdoor spec sheet)**
- Type: Headings: Kanit 800, 80–104px, sentence case; body: Public Sans 400/18px; dates, grid refs and spaces left: Space Mono 400 17px.
- Palette: bg #F2F1EC / text #16201B / accent #E4572E (safety orange, only for spaces left and Book) / grade green #2F7D4A / grade blue #2359A6 / line #16201B.
- Layout: dense 12-column grid; trip pages read like a spec sheet with a left rail of facts (days, grade, group size, price) and the itinerary on the right; tables with 1px ruled rows. Radii: 0 on tables and images, 3px on buttons, 50% only on grade dots. Nav by activity, then region.
- Imagery: real trip photos only, wide 3:2 landscape crops with people small in the frame; mono caption with place name and grid reference.
- Motion: departures table updates in place when filters change (Interactivity API, no reload); hover shows an underline only; reduced-motion removes row transitions.
- Why it fits now: outdoor brands have swapped adrenaline hype for quiet, technical, Japanese-influenced utility, e.g. [Snow Peak](https://www.snowpeak.com/).
**Style variations:** Tide Table: navy #0F2A44 bg, white mono · Bothy: kraft #C9B48A paper, black type · Summit: white bg, single orange
**Real-world basis:** [Wilderness Scotland: sea kayaking](https://www.wildernessscotland.com/adventure-holidays/sea-kayaking/), [Rockhopper: multi-day kayak trips](https://www.rockhopperscotland.co.uk/all-activities/guided-multi-day-kayak-trips/), [Sea Kayak Scotland: booking and charges](https://www.seakayakscotland.com/booking-charges/), [Clearwater Paddling: our trips](https://www.clearwaterpaddling.com/Our-Trips)
**Refs:**
- [Wilderness Scotland: sea kayaking holidays](https://www.wildernessscotland.com/adventure-holidays/sea-kayaking/): trip listings with next departure, grade and duration, plus a departures table with spaces left and Sold out.
- [Rockhopper Scotland: guided multi-day kayak trips](https://www.rockhopperscotland.co.uk/all-activities/guided-multi-day-kayak-trips/): honest included / not-included lists and a booking calendar for a tiny operator.
- [Sea Kayak Scotland: booking charges](https://www.seakayakscotland.com/booking-charges/): per-person price by group size, the pricing small operators actually use.

#### 191 · "Visit Our Town" Tourism Site (`visit`)
**For:** a volunteer-run town partnership, chamber of trade or tiny tourism office promoting one market town or village.
**Templates:** front-page · archive-listing · single-listing · taxonomy-listing-category · page-street (one per high street) · archive-event · single-event · page-plan-your-visit · page-getting-around · page-access · page-submit-event
**Patterns (~50):** "What's on this week" list, event categories (Market / Music / Arts / Nature / Community), directory entries (category, name, two-line description, phone, website), Where to stay / Eat and drink / Shopping / What to do with sub-categories (B&Bs, holiday cottages, tea rooms, pubs), street guide (every business on Fore Street in walking order), getting around (train, bus, ferry, parking, bike parking), downloadable town map with self-guided heritage trail, add-your-event form, annual events calendar (carnival, festival), local groups and societies list, "advertise with us" block.
**Content model:** `listing` (address, phone, website, lat/lng, street, street_order, opening notes), taxonomies `listing_category` and `street`; events from The Events Calendar.
**Plugins:** The Events Calendar (free list/month views, iCal export), Out of the Block: OpenStreetMap (directory and street maps), Query Filter (listing categories), Jetpack Forms (submit-an-event and listing request forms).
**Signature:** a street-by-street guide: each high street gets its own page listing its shops, cafes and services in walking order, so visitors can plan a walk up the street rather than scroll a flat directory (seen on: [Visit Totnes: Fore Street](https://visittotnes.co.uk/fore-street/)).
**Nice-to-haves:**
- "Add to Google Calendar / download .ics" on every event (seen on: [Visit Marfa: events](https://www.visitmarfa.com/events)).
- "Hide cancelled / postponed events" filter so the list stays honest (seen on: [Discover Frome: events](https://www.discoverfrome.co.uk/events/)).
- Printable town map with a self-guided heritage walk, plus where to pick up paper copies (seen on: [Visit Totnes: getting around](https://visittotnes.co.uk/plan-your-visit/getting-around/)).
- Access page: toilets, pavement gradients, a flat riverside mile, ramp-access community bus (seen on: [Visit Totnes: disabled access](https://visittotnes.co.uk/see-and-do-tax/disabled-access/)).
- Seasonal and tidal transport notes ("river boat April–October, depends on tides").
**Style: Riso town poster**
- Type: Headings: Lilita One 400, 88–120px, tracking -0.02em, set like a fête poster; body: Hanken Grotesk 400/18px; opening hours and categories: Space Mono 700 16px, normal case.
- Palette: bg #FBF7EE (newsprint) / text #1D1D1B / riso fluorescent pink #FF48B0 (events) / riso teal #00838A (directory) / riso yellow #FFE800 (highlight, one use per page) / line #1D1D1B.
- Layout: poster-like home page with this week's events as a big typographic list, not cards; directory as a ruled 3-column list with 2px black rules between entries; category filters as plain text links. Radii: 0 on lists and images, 999px only on the map pins. Nav: Plan / Stay / Eat / Shop / What's on.
- Imagery: local photos printed as two-colour riso duotones (pink + teal) with grain and slight misregistration; hand-drawn town map as SVG.
- Motion: no scroll effects; hover changes a rule colour; map pins open a simple popover; nothing to disable under reduced-motion.
- Why it fits now: towns and small festivals are dropping glossy tourist-board templates for zine and small-press identities that look made locally, e.g. [Nieves](https://www.nieves.ch/), the Zurich zine publisher.
**Style variations:** Market Day: yellow #FFE800 bg, black type · Harbour: #0E4C6B bg, white type · Parish: newsprint bg, green #2F6B3A ink
**Real-world basis:** [Visit Totnes: Fore Street](https://visittotnes.co.uk/fore-street/), [Visit Totnes: getting around](https://visittotnes.co.uk/plan-your-visit/getting-around/), [Discover Frome: events](https://www.discoverfrome.co.uk/events/), [Discover Grassington: where to eat and drink](https://discovergrassington.co.uk/where-to-eat-drink/), [Visit Marfa: events](https://www.visitmarfa.com/events)
**Refs:**
- [Visit Totnes: Fore Street](https://visittotnes.co.uk/fore-street/): a street as the unit of navigation, with every business in order.
- [Discover Frome: events](https://www.discoverfrome.co.uk/events/): The Events Calendar on WordPress with local categories, calendar subscriptions and a "submit an event" route for residents.
- [Discover Grassington: where to eat and drink](https://discovergrassington.co.uk/where-to-eat-drink/): plain, useful directory entries with phone, email and website for a small village.
